**Job Description**
 In today’s world it’s important to work for a company that has clear purpose, giving back to communities and supporting what is truly important in the world.
   

  

 When considering a career move its vital to work for a business that is aligned to your values and goals, a place where you can belong. See what WSP stands for in 2026 and beyond…
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 WSP ME team has ambitions to significantly expand our energy team. We are seeking a Proposal Writer \& Graphic Designer with core expertise in areas mentioned below.
   

  

 Role relating to Proposal Writer \& Graphic Designer for Advisory team focused on Energy \& Generation Sector.
   

  

 This includes (but not limited to):
   

  

 Creative Development
   

  

* Design visually compelling proposals, document covers, presentations, diagrams, infographics, and marketing collateral.
* Translate complex technical and strategic content into clear, engaging visuals.


**Collaboration \& Strategy**
* Work closely with engineers, proposal managers, and marketing teams to align design outputs with business goals.
* Maintain brand consistency across all deliverables and platforms.


**Leadership \& Project Management**
* Guide and mentor junior designers, ensuring quality and consistency.
* Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, meeting tight deadlines and shifting priorities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of professional experience in graphic design, including 2\+ years in a lead role.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere Pro), including AI\-powered features like Adobe Firefly.
* Strong experience in motion graphics, video editing, UI/UX, and interactive design.
* Excellent communication, creative thinking, and team collaboration skills.
* Experience with SharePoint and digital asset management systems is a plus
* Self\-motivated and eager learner, aptitude to grow and develop within the field.


**BGV:**
* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 With approximately
 **4,000 talented people** 
 across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru \& Mumbai offices) in India and more than
 **73,000 globally** 
 , in 550
 **offices across 40 countries** 
 , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.

**About Boston Institute of Analytics** 




 The Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA) is a global education organization specializing in training programs in data science, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies. We are expanding our marketing team and looking for a creative graphic designer who can help strengthen our digital brand presence through impactful visual communication.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a creative and detail\-oriented graphic designer with experience in digital and social media design. The ideal candidate should be passionate about visual storytelling and capable of creating engaging designs and motion content that enhance brand communication across multiple platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design creative visuals for social media platforms, including Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube
* Create banners, ad creatives, marketing posts, and promotional graphics
* Develop motion graphics, reels, and short\-form video content for digital campaigns
* Design branding materials such as brochures, presentations, and marketing collateral.
* Collaborate closely with the marketing team to maintain brand consistency
* Adapt designs based on feedback while meeting project timelines
* Stay updated with current design trends, tools, and social media content formats



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 1–3 years of experience in Graphic Design, preferably in digital marketing or social media content creation
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, etc.)
* Strong portfolio demonstrating social media creatives, branding work, or video content
* Good understanding of typography, color theory, layout design, and visual hierarchy
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Basic video editing or animation skills will be an added advantage



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Opportunity to work in the fast\-growing EdTech and AI industry
* Exposure to branding, performance marketing, and digital campaigns
* Collaborative and creative work environment
* Scope to enhance design, motion graphics, and marketing skills



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Boston Institute of Analytics is committed to fair and inclusive hiring practices. All qualified applicants will be considered based on skills, experience, and role requirements.
 



  





**Apply Now** 




 If you are passionate about design, creativity, and digital storytelling, we would love to review your portfolio and connect with you.
 



  





**Apply with your updated resume and portfolio link.**

 At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.
   

  

 Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
   

  

****Job Description****
 Develop IIoT systems, ensuring seamless integration and functionality within the Advantage\+Elite monitoring system. Oversee the installation of prototype IIoT devices and networks in industrial settings to ensure system compatibility and efficiency in data collection and processing.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Designing, developing, and implementing IoT devices and systems with software and network interfaces using .NET and Azure.
* Creating and maintaining robust IoT architectures that ensure secure and reliable data flow between devices and platforms.
* Data\-Driven AI Development – Transforming raw data into actionable insights through model selection, feature engineering, and performance tuning
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, hardware engineers, and data scientists, to define system requirements and deliver comprehensive IoT solutions.
* Testing and validating IoT systems to ensure stability, efficiency, and security, and to troubleshoot and resolve any technical issues.
* Providing technical support and documentation for IoT systems, including user guides and technical specifications.
* Monitoring the performance of IoT systems and making necessary adjustments or upgrades to hardware and software components.


****Education:****
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical \& Electronics/Controls/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent.


****Requirements:****
* Minimum 5 years of design experience in a relevant industry.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and strong presentation skills
* Specialized knowledge of networking products, tools, standards, processes and technology.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems
* Advanced creativity and innovation skills.
* Strong sense of ownership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and work both autonomously, and as part of a highly cohesive team
* Experience in Agile software design process and Test\-Driven Development methodologies.
* Familiarity and experience with AI and it’s use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools.


 Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

title: Senior Interaction Designer
description:
Are you ready to be part of an exciting team and provide a significant impact on user\-centered design at NVIDIA? We love gaming and gamers. We are looking for dedicated, upbeat and multifaceted designer with excellent analytical abilities. Do you love to game? Are you a product designer\- passionate and highly motivated about solving complex problems and delivering excellent design solutions?
   

  

 Senior Interaction Designer in the User Experience (UX) team at NVIDIA works with a group of passionate design professionals. We dream to redefine the way millions of users use hardware, software and services. We collaborate with the Marketing, Software Development, Quality Assurance and Documentation teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Be an outstanding design lead\- innovative, fast, creative, communicative and able to stand on your feet in meetings.
* Work with user researchers, interaction designers, engineers, product managers and visual designers to craft the best possible design.
* Chip in positively to craft design assets visually, verbally and in writing.
* Build user journey maps and information architecture for apps.
* Provide constructive design commentary and evaluative critique.
* Deliver clear, detailed design specifications to define end users' experience.


**What We Need To See**
* 12\+ years of proven experience in industry as interaction designer role.
* Degree in Human\-Computer Interaction Design, Product Design or comparable.
* Proven experience in conceptual design, prototyping, tactical UI design and the software development process are required.
* Design portfolio of user experience projects for one or more areas such as Desktop, Mobile, Web Applications\- Win, Android, MacOS, iOS
* Experience with crafting sketches, mind maps and storyboards for brainstorming.
* Use of metrics and user research data to influence design direction.
* Ability to consider and apply business objectives to design work.
* Proficient in manual and AI prototyping tools such as Figma, Claude Design
* Experienced and proficient with the latest AI and documentation tools.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Masters in Design degree from outstanding design institutes like IIT/ NID.
* Have a background in engineering, product or visual design.
* Leading global design projects to deliver pioneering user experience.
* Have used and maintained a user experience design system.
* Planned and conducted user research studies.

 **join Novac Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd., one of India’s Top 100 Best Companies to Work For** 
 and a proud member of the renowned Shriram Group.
 



  





 We are a digital transformation and cloud solutions company with deep expertise in Financial Services, Insurance, Retail, and Learning domains—driving innovation and crafting tailored solutions to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
 



  





**Instructional Designer** 









**Domain:** 
 eLearning \& Learning Technology
 



  





**Location:** 
 Perungudi, Chennai
 



  





**Experiences:** 
 2 years \- 5 years
 



  





**Qualification:** 
 Any Graduate/Post Graduate
 



  





**Work Mode:** 
 Full Time
 



  





**Website:** 
 https://www.novaclearning.com
 



  





**Job Description:** 




  





 We’re looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Instructional Designer with 2–5 years of experience to design engaging e\-learning content and blended learning experiences. This role is ideal for someone who combines instructional design expertise with a passion for learner\-centric innovation and digital storytelling.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Learning Design \& Development
 



  




* Conduct basic to intermediate needs analysis to align learning solutions with business and learner goals
* Design and develop interactive, application\-focused training content for digital and blended formats
* Create compelling instructional materials, visuals, and assessments using modern instructional strategies
* Lead or support storyboarding, content authoring, and multimedia development for self\-paced and instructor\-led programs
* Apply instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) to build engaging and effective learning experiences
* Write in clear, learner\-friendly language tailored to diverse audiences and roles



 Collaboration \& Content Creation
 


* Work independently or within curriculum teams to develop and test instructional materials
* Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to translate complex topics into impactful training content
* Partner with senior designers and multimedia teams to conceptualize visuals, animations, and audio/video scripts
* Review peer\-developed content and contribute ideas for new courses and learning programs
* Support promotional efforts by crafting course descriptions and rollout content



 Tools \& Technology
 


* Design and build digital learning modules using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or similar
* Maintain organized documentation throughout the project lifecycle, including version control and asset tracking
* Contribute to the development of Instructor\-Led Training (ILT) materials and virtual classroom assets



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 



  




* 2–5 years of experience in instructional design, e\-learning development, or digital learning
* Familiarity with instructional design principles and adult learning theories
* Hands\-on experience with authoring tools and multimedia platforms
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Essentials
 
 :** 




  





**Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Analytical mindset** 
 with excellent problem\-solving skills and a proactive, self\-motivated approach

description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**
 ServiceTitan strives to be the best place our Titans have ever worked, so they can do the best work they’ve ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team is central to this mission. We solve real world problems in the home services industry. We are passionate about bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional problems and workflows. Our ambitious team of visual designers work closely with product designers, marketers, design technologists, and product managers, along with thousands of our users to help make their lives easier through technology. We embrace creative design thinking and processes to ship dozens of new templates and features each month. We measure our success based on our customer’s success. We strive for real impact.
   

  

 We are in search of a talented Senior Visual Designer who possesses the desire to solve complex problems with data\-informed solutions and is experienced working with AI technology and innovating with AI designs. This individual will be a core member of our expanding design team, contributing to the development of a best\-in\-class Enterprise SaaS product with desktop, tablet, and mobile interfaces. They will bring interfaces and illustrations to life through thoughtful micro\-interactions, motion design, and contribute to our growing design system for scalable use. Visual Designers at ServiceTitan produce visually stunning and captivating work that resonates with our users. They are creative thinkers who delve into the "why" behind design choices and communicate this through their visual creations. They are responsible for breathing life into design solutions that align with both our wider Product strategy and Marketing efforts.
   

  

 Reporting to the Group Manager, Visual Design, the Senior Visual Designer possesses a balanced toolkit of real\-world design experience, creativity, a background in design theory, and an excitement around contributing to Product branding.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join one of LA’s fastest growing companies and have your thumbprint on the product that is actively disrupting the Home Services industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Work closely with our Design System team to ensure and grow best practices and guidance around ServiceTitan’s Visual Design language pillars.
* Help shape the visual design language in the Product through UI design, data visualization, and motion design.
* Solid understanding of animation principles (easing, timing, choreography) and how motion supports usability
* Design and document motion/animation behaviors for developer handoff
* Utilize AI\-assisted ideation/concepting, generative image tools, prompt\-driven asset production, and use these tools to accelerate generation of high\-quality work
* Support the XD team with assets that promote an exceptional visual language throughout Product; illustrations, iconography, landing pages, feature announcements, app assets, and more.
* Design creative solutions that are engaging, inclusive, intuitive, and solve real problems.
* Work collaboratively with the team to create work guided by ServiceTitan’s Visual Design language pillars.
* Partner with product designers, design technologists, visual designers, and product managers to develop and ship work.
* Mentor junior designers on UI and motion craft, providing hands\-on feedback on interface design, animation principles, and design system usage to help them grow
* Strive to resonate with the home services industry and audience, while advocating for creative excellence
* Advocates for design quality and consistency across the product, setting a high craft bar through both execution and mentorship
* Be an active advocate for creativity: come up with unique and creative ideas regularly, and be excited for growth
* Leverage visual frameworks and patterns based on brand guidelines across Marketing and Product


**What You'll Bring**
* A design portfolio showcasing relevant real\-world UI and Visual design work.
* Experience shipping with AI tools and software
* Experience designing motion for UI and illustrations
* Experience working with a Design System
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across diverse cultures and time zones.
* Proficient in visual design foundations including layout, typography, iconography, color theory, and composition.
* Exceptional ability to establish and maintain relationships across teams and functions.
* Experience giving design feedback and a genuine desire for personal growth.


**Bonus**
* Experience designing for AI products


 ‌
   

  

**Be Human With Us:**
 Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
   

  

**Use of AI Technology:**
 We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Stripe is investing in building out its Creative Design team within the Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) to reach users across the globe. The team designs comprehensive ad campaigns tailored for various platforms, ensuring that every visual element aligns with our marketing goals and engages our audience effectively. We create net\-new creative content and localize and adapt our work to meet the unique cultural and linguistic needs of different regions, presenting our message effectively in global languages.
   

  

 In addition to advertising and web content, we produce high\-quality designs for presentations and collateral aimed at large users and executive audiences. Our designs enhance the clarity and impact of our messages, making complex information accessible and engaging—whether for a client pitch or an executive strategy session.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Designers at Stripe's SDC bring a passion for captivating storytelling and great design. They use design systems to tell compelling stories to a variety of audiences, and are well\-versed at expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible design systems that achieve bar\-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale. They are user\-focused, business\-savvy, empathetic, and inspiring. The ideal candidate excels across a variety of styles, crisply articulates design decisions, iterates quickly, and collaborates seamlessly with marketers, product managers, leaders, other designers, and cross\-functional partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ideate, design, and produce world\-class design solutions—both static and motion—across a range of deliverables including presentations, posters, brand art, and signage.
* Steward designers through large\-scale projects, providing art direction and ongoing guidance on creative strategy, execution, and localization.
* Work across a wide variety of mediums (physical, digital, and everything in between) to create immersive storytelling and creative content that brings Stripe's brand and product stories to life.
* Bring design concepts to life through storyboarding, comps, and creative presentations, iterating based on stakeholder feedback and internal testing.
* Collaborate with copywriters, static and motion designers, marketers, and ad operations to develop visionary concepts that engage a global audience.
* Mentor designers in best practices and ideation, fostering an environment where everyone learns and grows.
* Present ideas in a clear, focused way that builds consensus within the team and with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify and implement process improvements through automation and AI integration to enhance design quality and efficiency.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of relevant design and art direction experience, with a focus on technical or product\-driven companies.
* Strong track record of independently delivering high\-quality work and influencing the output of other designers and cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Figma, Canva, and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite (motion and statics).
* Experience managing or mentoring a team of designers.
* Ability to express and communicate a brand through distinct graphics, patterns, motion, interaction, and experiences.
* A hands\-on maker with the skills to effectively communicate concepts, direction, and decisions to teams and external partners.
* Ability to balance speed and quality, consistently delivering challenging, interesting, and pixel\-perfect work.
* Persuasive and receptive to feedback; able to clearly explain work, process, and decisions.
* Comfortable working flexible hours, including late evenings (IST), to collaborate in real time with global stakeholders.
* Highly detail\-oriented, with a drive for pixel\-perfect craft.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multidisciplinary creative comfortable working across different mediums and excited about experimenting with new technologies.
* Prior people management experience, with a track record of hiring, developing, and growing design talent.
* Experienced at facilitating stakeholder alignment and advocating for design quality.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

**6\. AI\-enabled Design Workflow** 



* Adopt an AI\-native approach to design by leveraging AI tools for ideation, image generation, motion graphics, video editing, presentation design and landing page creation.

**Requirements** 



* 5 to 10 years of experience in graphic design, visual communication or creative design.

* Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition and visual storytelling.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in fintech, edtech or digital\-first businesses will be an added advantage.

title: Design Operations & Client Delivery Lead
description:
Role Overview We are seeking a mature, commercially aware leader to help management run design operations, strengthen delivery discipline and serve as a trusted client contact. The candidate will coordinate people, projects and priorities while remaining capable of hands-on publication or graphic-design work when needed. 
 This is broader than a conventional Art Director position, combining client ownership, project management, people leadership, reporting, quality control and hands-on production expertise. 
 Core Responsibilities 1. Lead Design Operations and the Team Partner with management to plan, prioritize and run the full design-production workload across publication and non-publication accounts. Allocate work intelligently based on capability, capacity, urgency and client context, and track assignments through completion. Lead through credibility and sound judgment, earning the confidence of existing senior and experienced designers on the team. Coach newer team members, provide actionable feedback, raise quality standards and help individuals strengthen their technical and client-service skills. Anticipate capacity constraints, arrange backup coverage and resolve bottlenecks before they affect delivery. 
 2. Own Client Relationships and Delivery Act as a dependable client-facing representative for assigned design and publication accounts. Lead discovery conversations, clarify business needs, scope and specifications, and translate them into clear internal briefs. Coordinate team execution, review work before delivery and remain accountable for quality, timeliness and follow-through. Build client confidence through clear communication, realistic commitments and timely written updates. Apply commercial judgment to feasibility, timelines, revisions and scope, and identify additional support opportunities without overpromising. Own issues through resolution and protect the client relationship when requirements change or delivery risks emerge. 
 3. Manage Publication and Letter-Production Programs Oversee publication-setup workflows for long-established U.S. community publishers, including publications serving Amish readerships in Pennsylvania and the East Coast. Manage high-volume handwritten-letter programs that may exceed 1,200 letters per week across one or more publications. Coordinate the complete workflow: file intake and logging; AI/OCR-assisted transcription; human proofreading and correction; typesetting into Word or other required formats; client review; and release for print. Maintain accurate status tracking, naming conventions, version control, quality checkpoints and deadline visibility across every stage. Plan for volume spikes, weekend intake and urgent exceptions while protecting accuracy, confidentiality and deadlines. 
 4. Provide Hands-on Design and Production Support Create, revise and quality-check magazine advertisements, classifieds, newspaper ads, publication layouts and other print or digital collateral. Work proficiently in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, using other tools when appropriate to the assignment. Prepare print-ready files with correct dimensions, bleeds, trim, resolution, color profiles, fonts, links and export settings. Apply strong typography, hierarchy, layout, design thinking and brand judgment, and step into priority work or coaching reviews when needed. 
 5. Improve Processes, Controls and Automation Document and improve workflows, SOPs, checklists, templates, handoffs and quality-control standards. Use automation and AI to improve throughput without weakening human review, accountability or data protection. Investigate recurring errors or delays, determine root causes and implement measurable corrective actions. Use delivery, quality and workload data to recommend better processes, staffing decisions and client solutions. 
 Reporting and Management Visibility This position reports directly to the Head of Business Operations and must provide disciplined, proactive updates. Management should have a reliable view of client health, delivery performance, team conditions and emerging risks without having to chase for information. Immediate reporting: Raise client concerns, deadline threats, quality failures, staffing constraints and other material risks as soon as they become known. Weekly operating update: Report on client relationships, projects, deadlines, delivery confidence, workload, quality, employee feedback, coaching, decisions required and next-week priorities. Monthly management review: Summarize trends in client health, delivery performance, team development, process improvement, risks, opportunities and recommended actions. Meeting and escalation discipline: Schedule important discussions, capture decisions and owners, communicate early, propose solutions and close the loop on agreed actions. 
 Required Experience and Capabilities Typically 8+ years of progressive design or production experience with responsibility for projects, people or client delivery. At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.
   

  

 You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Product Designer at Coram AI, you’ll design the end\-to\-end experience for an AI\-native video security platform used by security and operations teams to monitor, investigate, and respond to real\-world incidents. You’ll turn complex workflows (live video, AI detections, multi\-site operations, access control, and incident response) into intuitive, high\-confidence product experiences.
   

  

 You’ll have significant ownership from day one: partnering closely with product managers and engineers, speaking directly with customers, and taking work from early concepts through polished, production\-ready designs. This is a high\-impact role for a systems\-minded designer who enjoys solving technically complex B2B problems, building scalable design foundations, and shipping quickly in an early\-stage environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product design process from early customer discovery and wireframing to high\-fidelity visual design, interactive prototyping, and developer handoff
* Design workflows for natural language video search, custom AI alert setup, interactive camera walls, and incident deep\-dive investigations
* Streamline critical operations like multi\-site security oversight, role\-based access control, visitor management, and emergency response coordination
* Build, expand, and maintain Coram AI’s UI component library and design system in Figma to ensure speed, accessibility, and visual consistency across desktop and mobile
* Talk directly with security operators, IT directors, and facility leaders to understand workflows, iterate on user feedback, and validate design solutions
* Collaborate daily with PMs and front\-end/AI engineers in a fast\-paced, high\-ship\-velocity environment


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation package
* Attractive Health benefits for you and family
* Flexible paid time off
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)
* Referral bonuses


**Skills And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a proven track record building complex B2B SaaS platforms, data\-dense web applications, or AI tools
* Clear case studies demonstrating end\-to\-end design execution, complex problem solving, high visual polish, and systemic UI thinking
* Expertise in component architecture, autolayout, prototyping, and design system governance
* Ability to understand technical constraints surrounding live\-video streams, real\-time telemetry, and AI detection models to design viable, elegant solutions
* Thrives in early\-to\-growth stage environments; proactive, self\-directed, and capable of executing independently with minimal guidance

 We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.
   

  

 Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

**Senior UX Designer \- Digital ProductsAbout The Role**

 **problem discovery and user research through information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, and implementation collaboration** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong UX fundamentals with a solid understanding of modern web technologies and has
 **hands\-on experience with React and front\-end UI development** 
 . You should be comfortable working closely with product managers, engineers, QA, and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into intuitive, scalable, and visually polished experiences.
   

  

 This is not a purely visual design role. We are looking for someone who can
 **think deeply about user problems, challenge requirements, simplify complex workflows, and translate those insights into exceptional product experiences.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end UX design process across multiple digital products and platforms.
* Translate business requirements, user needs, and complex workflows into intuitive and effective user experiences.
* Conduct user research, user interviews, usability analysis, and competitive/product research where appropriate.
* Develop user journeys, personas, information architecture, wireframes, interaction models, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
* Design intuitive workflows for complex enterprise and customer\-facing applications.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams from concept through implementation.
* Create and maintain reusable design systems, UI patterns, components, and interaction standards to ensure consistency across products.

* Translate designs into production\-quality UI in collaboration with engineering, with the ability to make hands\-on React/UI changes when required.
* Review implemented experiences and ensure the final product closely aligns with the intended UX and design specifications.
* Identify usability issues, friction points, and opportunities for simplification and continuously improve the product experience.
* Ensure designs follow responsive design, accessibility, usability, and modern web UX best practices.
* Present design concepts and rationale clearly to senior stakeholders and incorporate feedback effectively.
* Establish UX standards and best practices that can be applied consistently across the broader product portfolio.

* Proven experience designing complex web applications, SaaS products, enterprise platforms, or other digital products.

* Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility, interaction patterns, and modern UI/UX principles.
* Hands\-on experience developing or modifying web UIs using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Ability to understand existing React code and translate design requirements into practical, implementable UI solutions.
* Experience working with component\-based design systems and reusable UI components.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between UX design, front\-end architecture, APIs, and technical constraints.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments with cross\-functional engineering and product teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience creating and maintaining enterprise\-scale design systems.

* Experience working across multiple products, platforms, or business domains.

* Thinks like a UX practitioner first and is passionate about solving user problems rather than simply creating visually attractive screens.
* Can independently take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a well\-thought\-out user experience.

We’re looking for a
 **Staff Product Designer** 
 to join our Travel Team. Our ideal candidate is a practitioner who can untangle complex B2B workflows and bring them to life with high\-quality execution.
   

  

 In this role, you will take ownership of key areas within our Enterprise platform, moving from early\-stage discovery and logic mapping to high\-fidelity UI and rigorous developer handoff. We need a designer who is equally comfortable defining the "how it works" as they are the "how it looks."
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Lead the design process for specific Enterprise workstreams, including our ai workstream —from initial concept and user flows to final UI polish and developer\-ready documentation.
* Simplify Complex Systems: Translate intricate business requirements and dense data into clear, intuitive B2B interfaces. You’ll turn "information overload" into a streamlined user experience.
* Systems Thinking: Contribute to and evolve our design system. You’ll ensure that enterprise\-grade features remain consistent, accessible, and scalable across web and mobile.
* Influence through Narrative: Present complex concepts in an easily digestible narrative to influence partners and stakeholders. You don't just show screens; you tell the story of the user’s journey.
* Bridge the Gap to Engineering: Collaborate daily with developers to ensure your designs are implemented as intended. You care about the details of the final product as much as the initial prototype.
* Data\-Informed Advocacy: Use research and product analytics to validate your design decisions, working closely with our UXR and Content partners to build a well\-rounded vision.
* Global Collaboration: Work as part of a global team spanning Berlin, India, and San Francisco. You’ll facilitate design rituals and syncs that bridge time zones and cultures.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 7\-9 years of Product Design experience: Specifically within B2B, SaaS, or complex technical systems. You should be comfortable with deep hierarchies and power\-user workflows.
* Full\-Stack proficiency: A portfolio that demonstrates strength in both UX Architecture (logic, edge cases, user flows) and UI Design (layout, hierarchy, and interaction).
* Figma expertise: Proficiency in Figma is required; you use auto\-layout and components to build organized, scalable files.
* Shipped B2B Work: A proven track record of shipping impactful work in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
* Technical fluency: You understand the constraints of web and mobile. You speak the language of developers and know how to negotiate a design without sacrificing the user experience.
* An Iterative mindset: You believe that "done is better than perfect" but "perfecting" is what happens in the next sprint. You thrive on fast feedback cycles.
* Strong communication: You can explain the "why" behind a design decision just as easily as you can discuss high\-level product strategy.
* A Remote collaboration mindset: Excellent asynchronous communication skills. You thrive in a global environment where documentation, Slack, and proactive updates are key to team success.

* An added background in travel–or a deep interest in travel–is a significant plus!

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years building RTL that tapes out clean, not almost clean, actually clean, and you know the difference between a subsystem that works in simulation and one that survives silicon. The dopamine rush you get from first\-time\-right RTL is real, and it is what keeps you coming back to the hardest parts of digital design. You have driven multiple tape\-outs and learned that the architecture decisions you make in week two will either or sink the team in month six. You think in hierarchies, timing paths, and power domains without losing sight of what the block is actually supposed to do. Working with verification teams does not slow you down, it sharpens your thinking, and you write RTL that makes their job possible, not harder. You are comfortable owning a subsystem from spec to release, navigating ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and driving cross\-functional work without waiting for someone else to connect the dots. At Synopsys, you will work on complex IP and subsystems that power the semiconductor industry, and the RTL you write will matter.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the full lifecycle of complex subsystem design from requirements and architecture through RTL development, verification collaboration, implementation handoff, and final release
* Craft subsystem architecture and functional specifications, define micro\-architecture, and write production\-quality RTL using industry best practices
* Drive RTL quality checks including lint, CDC, RDC, and work closely with verification teams to ensure functional correctness and coverage closure
* Integrate and design around standard protocols including PCIe, DDR, UFS, USB, and AMBA\-based interconnects
* Implement low power design techniques across clock gating, power gating, and multi\-voltage domains, ensuring power intent is captured and verified
* Collaborate with logic synthesis, STA, and physical design teams to ensure timing closure, develop synthesis constraints, and resolve equivalence check issues
* Work with DFT teams to architect scan, MBIST, and other testability features into your subsystems from the start

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your RTL will tape out in production silicon used by leading semiconductor companies building next\-generation AI, automotive, and mobile SoCs
* The subsystems you architect will enable faster time\-to\-market for Synopsys IP customers who depend on proven, reusable, and robust design blocks
* Your attention to RTL quality and first\-time\-right design will reduce verification cycles, implementation iterations, and post\-silicon debug time across the product
* The protocols and low power techniques you implement will directly influence power, performance, and area outcomes in customer chips
* Your collaboration with cross\-functional teams will set the standard for how design, verification, and implementation work together on complex projects
* The design practices and methodologies you bring will influence how the team approaches architecture, coding standards, and release quality
* Your ability to drive projects to completion will unlock new IP releases and product milestones that depend on subsystem readiness

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical field
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RTL design experience with multiple tape\-outs under your belt, ideally in complex IP, subsystems, or SoC blocks
* Deep proficiency with Verilog or SystemVerilog and proven ability to write synthesizable, timing\-clean, low power RTL at scale
* Strong working knowledge of standard protocols such as PCIe, DDR, UFS, USB, or AMBA (AXI, AHB, APB)
* Hands\-on experience with low power design techniques including clock gating, power gating, retention, UPF, and multi\-voltage domain architecture
* Solid understanding of logic synthesis, constraint development (SDC), static timing analysis (STA), and equivalence checking flows
* Familiarity with DFT concepts including scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, and how testability requirements shape design architecture, experience working directly with DFT teams is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a high\-level requirement document and turn it into a clean subsystem architecture without needing every detail spelled out for you
* You write RTL that passes lint, CDC, and synthesis checks on the first pass because you think about those constraints while you code, not after
* You can sit in a room with verification engineers, implementation leads, and DFT architects and walk out with a plan that actually works for everyone
* You push back when a specification is ambiguous or a timeline does not account for real design complexity, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You are organized enough to manage multiple release phases, cross\-functional dependencies, and shifting priorities without dropping threads
* You care about the quality of what you release, not just hitting the schedule, and you know how to balance both

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field 6\+ years of experience in IT with focus on IAM and Microsoft technologies.
* Strong expertise in Active Directory (AD DS), AD Certificate Services (PKI), and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Experience with hybrid identity, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access.
* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Understanding of authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, Kerberos).
* Exposure to Microsoft 365 services.
* Experience working in global enterprise environments.

* Microsoft certifications (Azure, Security, Identity, M365\).
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API.

description:
Role & responsibilities Job Description Interior Designer Position Interior Designer — Studio Role Overview We are looking for an Interior Designer to join our studio team. The ideal candidate should have a good basic aesthetic sense, strong design understanding, and the ability to develop ideas into detailed drawings and 3D visualisations. The role will involve working closely with the design team, consultants, vendors, and site teams to ensure that designs are executed accurately and that project updates are communicated on time. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop interior design concepts, layouts, furniture designs, material selections, and detailing as per project requirements. Create and modify AutoCAD drawings for plans, elevations, sections, furniture details, and execution drawings. Develop SketchUp 3D models and produce good-quality 3D renders to communicate design intent. Understand materials, finishes, furniture, lighting, hardware, and basic construction details. Coordinate with senior designers and the studio team during the design development process. Coordinate with different site vendors, contractors, carpenters, fabricators, electricians, painters, etc. Visit project sites when required and understand site conditions and execution requirements. Communicate design requirements clearly to vendors and site teams. Check work at site against approved drawings and designs and highlight discrepancies. Share timely site updates , photographs, measurements, progress reports, and issues with the studio team. Follow up with vendors to ensure that work is progressing as per the agreed timelines. Identify execution issues and coordinate with the design team for appropriate solutions. Maintain organised drawings, revisions, material details, and project documentation. Work within project timelines and ensure that assigned design and site-related tasks are completed on schedule. 
 Required Skills Design & Aesthetic Sense Good basic aesthetic sense and understanding of proportions, colours, materials, textures, and finishes. Ability to understand and develop design references into practical interior solutions. Good attention to detail and willingness to learn and improve design skills. 
 Software Skills — Must Have AutoCAD — Mandatory SketchUp — Mandatory 3D Rendering — Mandatory Basic knowledge of Photoshop/Enscape/V-Ray/Lumion or similar software will be an added advantage. 
 Site & Coordination Skills Basic understanding of interior execution and construction processes. Ability to read and understand architectural and interior drawings. Ability to coordinate with multiple vendors and contractors at site. Good follow-up skills and ability to track pending work. Ability to identify basic site/execution issues and communicate them clearly. 
 Communication Skills Basic communication skills are essential. Should be comfortable speaking with vendors, contractors, site supervisors, and the internal design team. Should be able to clearly communicate drawings, design intent, changes, and execution requirements. Must provide regular and timely updates regarding site progress, pending work, and issues. 
 Desired Qualities Creative and design-oriented approach. Good attention to detail. Responsible and organised. Proactive in following up on work. Ability to manage multiple tasks and project timelines. Willingness to visit sites and take ownership of assigned work. Ability to work collaboratively within a studio environment. Practical approach towards design and execution. Good attitude towards learning and taking feedback. 
 Experience 0–3 years of experience in interior design preferred. Freshers with strong software skills, good aesthetic sense, and a willingness to learn may also be considered. 
 Key Performance Expectations The candidate will be expected to: Develop designs that are aesthetically strong and practically executable. Produce accurate AutoCAD drawings and detailed SketchUp models. Create quality 3D renders that clearly communicate the proposed design. Coordinate effectively with vendors and site teams. Ensure timely communication and regular site updates . Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion. Maintain quality and attention to detail from design development through execution.

description:
**Visual Designer** 




*Own the visual identity of a fast\-growing, Accel\-backed AI startup* 
 Fibr AI \| HSR Layout, Bangalore \| Full\-Time \| In\-office
 



  





 About the Role
 



 Got an eye for design and a love for making complex things look effortless? This is your shot to own the entire visual language of Fibr.ai, across marketing, brand, product storytelling, and social. Your work will directly shape how a fast\-growing AI startup shows up to the world. You'll work hand in hand with founders and the marketing team, turning bold ideas into visuals that are modern, memorable, and impossible to scroll past.
 



  





 What Working With Us Looks Like
 


* Your work won't just live inside Fibr's own brand. You'll often get to shape how other respected businesses present themselves visually, including reimagining their web presence end to end. That's a level of trust and credibility not every design role offers this early in a career.
* You'll work directly with founders and the marketing team, with real access to decision makers, fast feedback loops, and the chance to shape brand direction early on, not just execute a brief.
* You'll work across a rich mix of formats, from product explainers to campaign content to decks, and get to enjoy real variety in what you design day to day.
* You take creative briefs and run with them, bringing your own point of view while staying aligned with brand direction.
* You're a proactive problem solver, someone who spots what needs attention and acts on it rather than waiting to be asked.
* Great design here is a craft we shape together. You'll collaborate closely with the team to refine ideas until they truly land.
* As an early stage team, roles flex a bit. One week might be pure visual design, another might involve jumping in on a campaign asset. We love people who enjoy that kind of variety.
* We're building something long term, and we're looking for someone excited to grow with the company and the mission.



  





 Your Work Will Include (a.k.a. What You'll Get To Create)
 


1. Designing marketing graphics, campaign assets, website visuals, and product explainers
2. Creating social content, email graphics, ads, landing page assets, and presentation decks
3. Producing UI inspired visuals that bring our product story alive
4. Contributing to brand evolution, visual identity, and creative direction
5. *(Preferred)* 
 Creating short motion graphics, animations, and micro interactions
6. Collaborating with product teams to maintain a cohesive design system
7. Brainstorming creative concepts for launches, campaigns, and events



  





 Culture \& Values
 


* Founder close, low bureaucracy: We're a small, AI native team of about 30 people. You'll have direct visibility into decisions and direction, not layers of sign off.
* Ownership over instructions: We value people who take a problem and run with it, not just execute tasks.
* Craft over speed alone: We care about getting things right. Design here is refined collaboratively, not rushed and forgotten.
* We celebrate the people, not just the output
* We build community, not just a workplace: in office meals, pantry snacks, and monthly turf sports evenings help the team stay connected outside of pure work.
* AI first mindset: we expect and encourage the use of AI tools across design, content, and workflows. This is core to how we operate, not an afterthought.
* Long term builders wanted: we're looking for people who want to grow with the company's mission, not just a role or a single manager.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 Must have skills:
 


1. About 2 years of experience as a visual designer, graphic designer, or brand designer
2. Strong design fundamentals: layout, typography, color, composition
3. Proficiency with Illustrator, Canva, and Figma
4. Ability to think visually and translate product concepts into clean, modern graphics (bonus if you also know Framer)
5. A self starter mindset, comfortable taking a brief and running with it, and equally comfortable asking for direction when needed
6. Enjoys collaborating closely with the team to shape and refine ideas until they land well
7. Creativity, attention to detail, and a product focused design mindset
8. Ability to deliver high quality work across multiple formats (web, social, presentations)
9. Comfortable working with AI tools for design (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, etc.)
10. Experience with AI image generation, prompt crafting, and AI assisted creative workflows
11. Strong work ethic and reliability, someone the team can count on
12. Portfolio and resume required; a portfolio of past work is highly preferred



  





 Preferred but not mandatory:
 


1. Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Premiere, or similar)
2. Hands on experience with Framer (big plus), or familiarity with Webflow and website design principles
3. Experience designing for SaaS, AI, or tech products
4. Prior startup or fast paced environment experience

* Implement real\-time video processing using GStreamer, FFmpeg, or DeepStream, with low\-latency streaming over RTSP, WebRTC, or HLS.
* Support dataset curation, annotation review, data augmentation, and retraining workflows to improve model quality over time.
* Collaborate with product, QA, and senior technical teams to translate business requirements into deployable analytics features.
* Contribute to benchmarking, validation, and performance measurement using clear metrics for accuracy, latency, and throughput.
* Engineer backend services and supporting utilities for multi\-camera orchestration, metadata handling, and monitoring.
* Maintain documentation, write unit and integration tests, and follow CI/CD best practices for model and service releases.


**Qualifications**
* B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, AI/ML, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 3\-5 years of professional experience in computer vision, video analytics, machine learning, or a related engineering role.
* Strong programming skills in Python and preferably C\+\+ along with good command of Linux development environments.
* Hands\-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Practical knowledge of video processing and CV tooling such as OpenCV, GStreamer, FFmpeg, or NVIDIA DeepStream.
* Experience deploying or optimizing models using TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO, or similar inference frameworks.
* Good understanding of object detection, tracking, and classification techniques, with the ability to evaluate model behavior using real\-world data.
* Working knowledge of performance profiling across CPU/GPU pipelines and an ability to troubleshoot latency or throughput bottlenecks.
* Exposure to REST/gRPC services, message queues, and containerized deployments using Docker.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, structured debugging skills, and comfort working in cross\-functional product environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, edge GPUs, NVRs, or other resource\-constrained deployment platforms.
* Exposure to action recognition, pose estimation, segmentation, face recognition, or license plate recognition.
* Familiarity with model benchmarking, experiment tracking, and validation workflows.
* Understanding of challenging deployment conditions such as crowding, occlusions, low light, and varied camera angles.
* Basic exposure to MLOps tooling such as MLflow, DVC, Weights \& Biases, or Kubeflow.
* Awareness of streaming protocols such as RTSP, WebRTC, HLS, or SRT.
* Interest in applied research, experimentation, and adapting recent computer vision approaches for production use.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Junior Service Designer (Systems & Operations Architecture)
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad \| (In\-Person Role)  

**Role Type:** Full\-Time (with a standard 3\-month probationary integration period)  

**Department:** Systems \& Service Design


**About TRD Studios**  

TRD Studios is a new\-age, integrated Management \+ Experience Studio. We specialise in transforming chaotic, fragmented enterprise operations into scalable, high\-margin architectures. As experts in Service and Systems Design, we approach organisational bottlenecks by looking beyond the physical machinery to understand the invisible structures governing human behaviour.


We firmly believe in Conway’s Law, which posits that organisations will inevitably design systems that mirror their own internal communication structures. Therefore, our interventions go far beyond designing traditional user interfaces or deploying out\-of\-the\-box software. We engineer human behaviour, establish unified command structures, and design pragmatic digital architectures that respect the physical realities of the workspace.


**The Role: Junior Service Designer**  

We are seeking a highly analytical, rigorous, and empathetic Junior Service Designer to join our Systems \& Operations Architecture team. While an intern observes and assists, a Junior Service Designer at TRD Studios is expected to take direct ownership of specific diagnostic workstreams and design deliverables. You will transcend traditional UX/UI design to architect real\-world operational ecologies.


Working under the guidance of our Lead Service Designers, you will untangle complex B2B and B2C operations. You will map the precise intersections where customer interactions (Frontstage), internal business processes (Backstage), information architecture, and physical material workflows collide. Your work will directly translate into the deployment of Minimum Viable Systems (MVS) designed to protect operational flow, eradicate undocumented “shadow queues,” and establish unified command structures for our enterprise clients.


**Core Responsibilities \& The 5D Framework**  

At TRD Studios, our methodology is anchored in the 5D Framework: Discover, Define, Design, Develop, and Deliver. As a Junior Service Designer, you will actively execute critical deliverables across these phases:


**1\. Discover: Deep\-Dive System \& Behavioural Mapping**


* **Operational Ecology Mapping:** Independently map the actual production, material, and information flow of our clients, capturing how the system truly behaves rather than relying on intended organisational charts.
* **Stakeholder \& Power Dynamics:** Conduct interviews to build Stakeholder Influence Maps. You will document informal power centers, identify how conflicts are resolved (or ignored via informal “common consensus”), and map the exact decision rights that override planned operations.
* **Value Stream Mapping (VSM):** Track the physical flow of materials and inventory to identify spatial congestion, supply chain visibility gaps, and the behavioural root causes of “over\-stocking traps”.


**2\. Define: Synthesising Systemic Constraints**


* **Problem Statement Formulation:** Translate chaotic shop\-floor symptoms into defined, actionable problem statements grounded in observed behaviour
* **Friction Point Prioritisation:** Compile and rank lists of operational pain points based on their systemic impact on overall throughput, setup\-time losses, and revenue.


**3\. Design \& Develop: Architecting Minimum Viable Systems**


* **Service Blueprinting:** Draft comprehensive, end\-to\-end “As\-Is” and “To\-Be” Service Blueprints that visualise the lines of interaction, lines of visibility, and internal support processes.
* **Operational Rulebooks \& Tools:** Take ownership of designing simple, algorithmic production Priority Rulebooks, Material Readiness Checklists, and physical Kanban boards to replace reactive firefighting.
* **Pragmatic Digital Architecture:** Translate designed physical processes into ERP Stage 1 requirements. You will ensure that digital interfaces respect environmental constraints of workers handling heavy machinery who cannot easily navigate complex touchscreens, requiring hybrid analog/digital handoffs.


**4\. Deliver: Scaling, Piloting, and Measurement**


* **Pilot Management:** Support the rollout of controlled production pilots on specific product families. You will observe daily shift\-locking standups, track early operational metrics, and iterate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) based on live human friction.
* **KPI Tracking \& Dashboards:** Help design and monitor weekly one\-page operations dashboards utilising core operational KPIs (e.g., on\-time delivery percentages, work order lead times, and machine utilisation).


**The Mindset \& Qualifications We Are Looking For**


* **Experience:** 0\-2 years of experience in Service Design, UX Strategy, Systems Engineering, or Industrial Design. A strong portfolio demonstrating complex systems mapping is required.
* **Systems Thinker:** You possess the ability to zoom out and view a business not as isolated departments, but as a complex, interconnected ecology.
* **Behavioural Empathy:** You understand that operational paralysis is rarely a pure technology issue; it is a symptom of informal communication, infinite Work\-In\-Progress (WIP) limits, and an absence of unified command.
* **Methodological Rigor:** Demonstrated proficiency in industry\-standard frameworks such as Service Blueprinting, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), RACI matrices, and deploying Minimum Viable Systems (MVS).
* **Analytical Detective:** You are comfortable diving into raw data, conducting stakeholder interviews, auditing legacy Excel architectures, and identifying the “invisible structures” that override the intended logic of a business.
* **Design Tool Proficiency:** High competency in tools like Figma, Miro, and mapping software to create highly granular, readable system overview maps, process charts, and UI mockups for internal dashboards.


**Why Join TRD Studios?** At TRD Studios, you will not be designing theoretical features in a vacuum. You will be exposed to the raw, unfiltered reality of enterprise operations. You will learn how to pragmatically bridge the gap between high\-level business strategy and ground\-level execution, working alongside experts to engineer real\-world business scale and operational resilience.


**To Apply or Inquire:** Please send your resume, a portfolio showcasing systems thinking, service blueprints, or operational design projects, and a brief introduction to our design team. **Contact us at** **\[email protected]** **if you have any questions on the role.**

description:
**Team**
**About Target**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
   

  

 Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are currently hiring for the Advanced AI Pyramid at Target. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll help shape how Target designs AI\-enabled and agentic experiences, from early interaction models through to patterns other teams can build on. This role focuses on tools and workflows used by technical and product teams building these experiences, while flexing to other guest and team member experiences as priorities evolve.
   

  

 You'll work through open, evolving problems alongside product and engineering, turning early ideas into direction a team can build against. Much of this work is systems\-level: a pattern needs to hold up across multiple teams and use cases, not just one screen
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and prototype agentic experiences: multi\-agent entry points, cross\-domain surfaces, and the moments where a system's reasoning needs to be visible and trustworthy.
* Build fast demonstrations that give internal teams something concrete to react to.
* Work directly with product teams adopting agentic AI. Take their early idea and shape it into a real product direction alongside their engineering counterparts.
* Design how trust and autonomy actually show up in an experience: guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop moments, and how the system's provenance is surfaced to the person using it.
* Hold your work to a high standard across journey maps, flows, and prototypes. Think about whether a pattern holds up beyond the specific team it started with.
* Few precedents exist for this kind of work, so you'll often be inventing the approach as much as the product. Look to the industry for what's working elsewhere, but expect to build new methods where nothing established fits.


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\+ years in product/UX design, with a portfolio that shows you can think past a single user and a single interface, beyond screen\-level craft alone.
* Direct exposure to AI/agentic product design, developer experience design, or adjacent work like complex workflow tools, platform/infrastructure UX, or design systems at enterprise scale. You should already be building in this space in some form, even outside a formal role.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You'll sometimes design against a model or platform that's still being finalized, which means structuring your own thinking first, then bringing that structure to the work itself.
* Advanced Figma proficiency and a working understanding of WCAG accessibility standards.


**Nice to Have**
* Some technical fluency \- API literacy, design\-to\-code tools, or comfort prototyping with code, so you can move fast without waiting on an engineer for every iteration.
* Experience contributing to a design system.
* The ability to walk someone through why you made a decision, beyond what the final screens look like.
* Writing, talks, side projects, or anything else that shows genuine interest in this space. Doesn't need to be public \- sharing it alongside your portfolio works too.


**A Note on Fit**
 Take this role if you'd rather help define how this practice works than step into one that's already set. You should be as interested in how trust and autonomy should feel as in what an agent can technically do. Expect to be building the ground you're standing on.

It is building a financial ecosystem that enables the mid-income group and the underserved segments to fulfil their financial aspirations. Fibe offers a range of financial products, including cash loans, long-term personal loans, and Impact loans for sectors like Healthcare, Education, Green Finance, Loan Against Mutual Funds, making affordability more accessible. This is a UI-first role: your visual craft needs to be strong, sharp, and consistent. UX thinking should back that craft up, not replace it. You should be someone who obsesses over spacing, type, hierarchy, and motion just as much as you think about user flows and edge cases. You'll also be expected to work fast using AI tools as part of your everyday process not as a novelty, but as a real part of how you design, explore, and ship. 
 What you'll do: Own design projects end to end from brief to research inputs to final, developer-ready UI Design high-quality visual UI for our app: clean layouts, strong typography, thoughtful use of color and motion Back every design decision with basic UX reasoning user flows, information hierarchy, usability Use AI tools (for ideation, exploration, content generation, research synthesis, or production speed) as a core part of your workflow. Work closely with product managers and engineers to make sure designs actually ship the way they were intended Contribute to and maintain our design system reuse patterns, flag inconsistencies, and help it scale as the product grows Present and defend your design decisions clearly, with reasoning, not just taste 
 What we're looking for (must-haves: 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer, with a portfolio that shows strong visual/UI craft first Solid understanding of UX fundamentals — flows, hierarchy, usability, basic research methods Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day design process (not just aware of them — actually using them to work faster or think better) Ability to take a project from 0 to 1 with minimal hand-holding Strong command over Figma; comfortable with the broader Adobe Creative Suite 
 Good to have (not deal-breakers): Experience designing for fintech or other high-trust, high-stakes products Experience working within or contributing to a design system Exposure to basic user research or usability testing What we're not looking for Someone who only does UX (flows/wireframes) without strong visual execution Someone who treats AI tools as optional or unfamiliar territory Someone who needs a fully scoped brief to start — we want people who can bring clarity to ambiguit
