description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: UX Designer 
 Experience: 6+ Years 
 Location: Bangalore 
 Work Mode: Hybrid 
 Employment Type: Full-time We are looking for an experienced UX Designer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing intuitive, user-centric digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in user research, interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, and usability testing. You will work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, developers, and other design teams to translate business requirements and user needs into engaging and effective digital experiences. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Understand business requirements, user needs, and product objectives to create effective UX solutions. Conduct user research, interviews, surveys, usability studies, and competitor analysis where required. Create user personas, user journeys, customer journeys, information architecture, and user flows. Design wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs. Develop intuitive and consistent user experiences across web and mobile applications. Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle. Conduct usability testing and incorporate user feedback to improve designs. Identify usability issues and recommend practical design solutions. Maintain and contribute to design systems, UI guidelines, and reusable design components. Present design concepts and solutions effectively to stakeholders and incorporate feedback. Work closely with development teams to ensure accurate implementation of designs. Stay updated with current UX/UI trends, design methodologies, and industry best practices. Balance user needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives while making design decisions. 
 
 Required Skills 
 6+ years of professional experience in UX/Product Design . Strong understanding of UX design principles, design thinking, and user-centered design methodologies. Hands-on experience with Figma is mandatory. Experience with wireframing, prototyping, interaction design, and information architecture. Strong knowledge of user research and usability testing techniques. Experience creating user flows, journey maps, personas, and prototypes. Good understanding of responsive design and mobile/web design principles. Experience working with design systems and reusable UI components. Ability to translate complex business requirements into simple and intuitive user experiences. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX design projects is required. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Experience working on enterprise applications or complex B2B products. Knowledge of UI design and visual design principles. Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development constraints. Experience collaborating with Design Systems teams. Exposure to accessibility standards and inclusive design practices. Experience with AI-enabled products or data-driven applications would be an advantage. 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field. 
 
 Key Competencies

 Our client strives to be the best place their teams have ever worked, so they can do the best work theyve ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team is central to this mission. They solve real world problems in the home services industry. They are passionate about bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional problems and workflows.

They embrace creative design thinking and processes to ship dozens of new templates and features each month. They measure their success based on their customers success. They strive for real impact.

This individual will be a core member of their expanding design team, contributing to the development of a best-in-class Enterprise SaaS product with desktop, tablet, and mobile interfaces.

Visual Designers at the clients place produce visually stunning and captivating work that resonates with their users. They are creative thinkers who delve into the "why" behind design choices and communicate this through their visual creations. They are responsible for breathing life into design solutions that align with both their wider Product strategy and Marketing efforts. 
 Reporting to the Group Manager, Visual Design, the Senior Visual Designer possesses a balanced toolkit of real-world design experience, creativity, a background in design theory, and an excitement around contributing to Product branding. 
 This is an opportunity to join one of LAs fastest growing companies and have your thumbprint on the product that is actively disrupting the Home Services industry.

Partner with product designers, design technologists, visual designers, and product managers to develop and ship work.  What you'll bring 
 A design portfolio showcasing relevant real-world UI and Visual design work. Experience shipping with AI tools and software Experience designing motion for UI and illustrations Experience working with a Design System Excellent communication and collaboration skills across diverse cultures and time zones. Proficient in visual design foundations including layout, typography, iconography, color theory, and composition. Exceptional ability to establish and maintain relationships across teams and functions. Experience giving design feedback and a genuine desire for personal growth.

description:

title: Sr. Product Engineer
description:
**About Venxr**
 VenXR is an AI\-driven AdTech startup building AdsGPT, redefining how brands plan, execute, and optimize ad campaigns through AI. We're a fast\-growing, lean team looking for a Product Engineer who can own features end\-to\-end, from idea to shipped product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Product Engineer who thinks like a builder, not just a coder. Someone who cares as much about
 *why* 
 we're building something as
 *how* 
 it's built, and takes real ownership of the product outcomes, not just the code they ship.
   

  

**Tech Stack**
 Frontend: React.js \| Backend: Python (Django) \| AI: Claude / LLM\-driven development
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Feature Ownership Own features from concept to deployment — writing clean, scalable code while staying closely tied to the product goal and user impact behind it.
* Full\-Stack Development Build and maintain front\-end interfaces in React.js and back\-end systems in Python/Django, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the product.
* Product Thinking Work closely with Product, Design, and Founders to shape specs, question assumptions, and suggest simpler or smarter ways to solve user problems.
* Rapid Iteration Ship fast, test in production, gather feedback, and iterate, balancing speed with code quality.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration Partner with Design and Data teams to bring dashboards, AI\-driven features, and data visualizations to life.
* System Design \& Architecture Contribute to technical architecture decisions, ensuring the codebase stays scalable as the product and team grow.
* Debugging \& Problem Solving Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, treating downtime or bugs as urgent, customer\-impacting problems.
* AI\-Native Development Actively build with AI — using Claude and other LLM tools not just to assist coding, but to develop AI\-powered features, prompt workflows, and intelligent product capabilities within AdsGPT itself.


**Requirements**
* 2–4 years of experience as a Product Engineer, ideally in a startup or B2B SaaS environment
* Strong proficiency in React.js for front\-end development
* Strong proficiency in Python, with hands\-on experience in Django for back\-end development
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and system design fundamentals
* Hands\-on experience building with AI tools (like Claude), not just using them for coding assistance, but developing core AI products.
* Experience working directly with Product/Design teams, not just executing tickets
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments with minimal hand\-holding
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for securely connecting LLMs to external tools and APIs.
* Experience building conversational AI interfaces or managing complex multi\-turn chatbot state across various platforms and channels.
* Experience in AdTech, MarTech, or data\-heavy SaaS platforms.
* Exposure to cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with LLM evaluation/monitoring tools (Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar).
* Experience with data visualization libraries (Recharts, D3\.js, Chart.js).
* Familiarity with compliance\-aware or explainable AI design in regulated domains.


**What We Look For In Candidates**
* Customer Obsession – A genuine curiosity about how your code impacts the customer's experience, not just whether it compiles.
* Ownership – You drive features to completion, chasing down blockers instead of waiting on them.
* Stakeholder Understanding \& Management – You know when to loop in Product, Design, or Business to unblock yourself fast.
* High Standards – You hold your own code to a higher bar, even when no one's checking.
* Disagree and Commit – You debate technical decisions hard, then commit fully once the call is made.
* Simplify Relentlessly – You reach for the simplest working solution, not the most "clever" one.
* Solidarity with the Team – You show up for your teammates, no invitation needed.
* Vitality – You bring real energy and resilience that keeps you (and others) going.


**Why Join Venxr?**
* Be part of a fast\-growing startup that puts data at the heart of every decision.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact, real\-world business challenges.
* Collaborative, transparent, and learning\-oriented work environment.
* Flexible work culture with a strong focus on career development.
* Comprehensive health benefits to support your well\-being.
* Team offsites and engagement activities to build stronger connections beyond work.
* Performance\-based incentives and rewards recognizing your contribution and impact.

title: Product Designer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 As a Product Designer, you'll own the design of complex, data‑rich experiences that support decision‑making for administrators and improve clarity and usability across our platform.
   

  

 You'll work as a senior individual contributor within a cross‑functional product team: Design, Product, Engineering, bringing product design expertise to your product area. While Product Management owns roadmap direction and prioritisation, you will play a critical role in informing decisions through research, design exploration, and user‑centred evidence, translating complexity into intuitive, accessible solutions.
   

  

 This role sits within a newly established team focused on analytics, dashboards, and reporting, where you'll elevate usability, interaction design, and data visualisation quality across StarRez products.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead complex design initiatives from discovery through delivery, translating multi‑role, data‑heavy workflows into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
* Conduct and contribute to continuous discovery activities, including customer interviews, usability testing, and concept validation, surfacing insights that inform product decisions and reduce delivery risk.
* Partner with Product to support clear problem framing, hypotheses, and measures of success, using research, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate design decisions and iterate solutions.
* Work iteratively, shipping improvements in stages and refining designs based on real‑world usage, feedback, and observed outcomes.
* Elevate data visualisation quality across dashboards and reporting experiences, ensuring information is clear, meaningful, and usable for diverse audiences.
* Strengthen the broader product experience by contributing to our design system and embedding accessibility best practices (WCAG 2\.2 AA) in collaboration with Engineering.
* Support stakeholder alignment through clear communication of UX decisions, improving usability and consistency through hands‑on critique, shared UI/UX patterns, and informal mentorship.
* Actively leverage AI‑powered tools and workflows within the design practice to accelerate exploration, iteration, and problem‑solving.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience designing complex SaaS or B2B digital products.
* Strong experience designing data‑rich interfaces, including dashboards, reporting tools, or complex operational systems.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to measurable product or business impact through improved usability, efficiency, or user satisfaction.
* Strong systems thinking and experience working across interconnected workflows or multi\-role platforms.
* Proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, and high\-fidelity execution.
* Experience leading discovery efforts and synthesizing insights into actionable product decisions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* A strong sense of shared ownership, you care about outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Ability to balance speed with rigor, making thoughtful decisions grounded in research, data, and sound judgment.


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in scale\-ups or growth\-stage product environments.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, testing tools, and assistive technologies.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, automation, or design\-to\-development optimisation practices.


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.* 
  

  

  

  

***Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:***
  

  

*StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.*

title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONINTERIOR DESIGNER CUM 3D VISUALISER

**Company:** Pipe Dreamers Collab  
**Position:** Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience : 1 \+ years**  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

ABOUT PIPE DREAMERS COLLAB

**Pipe Dreamers Collab** is an architecture, interior design and construction practice focused on creating thoughtful, sustainable and context\-responsive spaces.

Our approach combines **architecture, interiors, landscape and materiality** to create spaces that are functional, aesthetically refined and connected to their environment.

We are looking for a talented **Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser** who can contribute both creatively and technically to our design process.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser will be responsible for developing interior design concepts and transforming architectural and interior ideas into **high\-quality 3D models, realistic renders and compelling visual presentations**.

This is not purely a rendering role.

We are looking for someone who can **understand design, develop spaces, work with materials and translate concepts into strong visual outcomes**.

The role will involve visualisation across multiple scales, from:

**Interior Spaces → Buildings → Exteriors → Landscapes → Master Plans**

The ideal candidate should have strong practical proficiency in **SketchUp and professional rendering software such as D5 Render, Lumion, V\-Ray, Enscape or equivalent**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. INTERIOR DESIGN \& SPACE PLANNING

* Understand client requirements, lifestyle and functional needs.
* Develop interior concepts and design directions.
* Prepare furniture layouts and space\-planning proposals.
* Develop interior schemes for living, dining, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and other spaces.
* Assist in selecting appropriate furniture, finishes, materials, colours, textures and lighting.
* Develop design solutions balancing **function, aesthetics, comfort and practicality**.
* Explore different design options and alternatives.
* Assist the design team in taking projects from initial concept to final design.

2\. 3D MODELLING \& VISUALISATION

The candidate will be responsible for developing high\-quality 3D visualisations across **interior, architectural exterior, landscape and master\-planning projects**.

INTERIOR VISUALISATION

* Create accurate and detailed 3D interior models.
* Produce high\-quality, realistic interior renders.
* Develop realistic furniture, materials, textures, lighting and decorative elements.
* Prepare different material and design options for client presentations.
* Create detailed views that communicate the overall design intent.

EXTERIOR ARCHITECTURAL VISUALISATION

Produce high\-quality exterior renders for:

* Residential buildings
* Villas
* Commercial buildings
* Apartment projects
* Building facades
* Architectural massing and forms
* Entrance areas
* Courtyards
* Terraces
* Outdoor spaces
* Day and night views
* Landscape\-integrated architectural views

MASTER PLAN \& SITE VISUALISATION

Develop **master plan and site\-level 3D visualisations**, including:

* Overall site/master plan views
* Villa/community developments
* Building layouts
* Roads and pathways
* Landscape and open spaces
* Water bodies
* Parking areas
* Common amenities
* Recreational spaces
* Outdoor gathering areas
* Site features and structures
* Aerial and bird's\-eye views

LANDSCAPE VISUALISATION

* Integrate architecture and landscape realistically.
* Develop vegetation, trees, planting, terrain and outdoor elements.
* Create visually convincing landscape environments.
* Represent the relationship between buildings, open spaces and the surrounding context.

OTHER VISUALISATION

* Architectural walkthroughs
* Fly\-throughs
* Animations
* Design presentation videos
* Conceptual visualisations
* Material and lighting studies

3\. DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

* Translate concepts into detailed and presentable interior proposals.
* Explore materials, colours, textures, furniture styles and lighting schemes.
* Develop mood boards and material palettes.
* Assist in preparing client presentations.
* Participate in design discussions with the architects and design team.
* Make revisions based on feedback from the Chief Architect, designers and clients.
* Ensure that the final 3D visualisation accurately represents the approved design.

4\. MATERIAL \& PRODUCT SELECTION

The candidate should have an interest in and understanding of:

* Natural materials
* Wood and wood finishes
* Natural and engineered stone
* Tiles
* Glass
* Metal
* Paint and wall finishes
* Fabrics and upholstery
* Lighting fixtures
* Furniture
* Hardware
* Modular cabinetry
* Kitchen finishes
* Sanitaryware and bathroom materials

The ability to **research materials, products and finishes and incorporate them accurately into the visualisation** will be an advantage.

5\. WORKING DRAWINGS \& INTERIOR DETAILING

A basic understanding of interior detailing and construction is expected.

The candidate should be able to understand and assist with:

* Furniture layouts
* Ceiling layouts
* Flooring layouts
* Electrical and lighting layouts
* Wall elevations
* Joinery and cabinetry
* Kitchen layouts
* Bathroom layouts
* Material specifications
* Interior detailing

Experience in preparing or understanding **working drawings** will be an added advantage.

6\. SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTSMANDATORY

**Strong practical proficiency in 3D modelling and rendering software is mandatory.**

The candidate must have strong working knowledge of:

* **SketchUp – Mandatory**
* **D5 Render / Lumion / equivalent professional rendering software – Mandatory**

PREFERRED

* V\-Ray
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* AutoCAD
* Photoshop
* Illustrator

The candidate should be capable of independently handling the workflow:

**2D DRAWINGS → 3D MODELLING → MATERIALS → LIGHTING → LANDSCAPE → CAMERA COMPOSITION → RENDERING → POST\-PRODUCTION**

**Candidates without strong practical 3D modelling and rendering skills will not be considered.**

7\. MANDATORY SKILLS

The candidate must have:

* Strong **3D modelling skills**
* Strong **3D rendering skills**
* Proficiency in **SketchUp**
* Proficiency in **D5 Render, Lumion or equivalent**
* Good understanding of interior design principles
* Good spatial understanding
* Ability to read and understand architectural drawings
* Strong understanding of materials, textures and lighting
* Ability to create realistic architectural environments
* Strong visualisation and presentation skills
* Good sense of scale, proportion, composition and perspective
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work within deadlines

8\. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who combines:

**DESIGN THINKING \+ TECHNICAL SKILLS \+ VISUAL STORYTELLING**

You should be able to look at an empty room, building or site and understand:

**How should the space function?**  
**How should it feel?**  
**What materials should be used?**  
**How should the light interact with the space?**  
**How should the landscape complement the architecture?**  
**How can the entire idea be communicated through a compelling visual?**

We value candidates with a strong eye for:

* Composition
* Lighting
* Material realism
* Architectural proportions
* Furniture styling
* Landscape integration
* Atmosphere
* Photography and camera angles

An understanding of **minimal, contemporary, tropical and natural\-material\-based architecture and interiors** will be an added advantage.

9\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCEPreferred Qualification

* Degree / Diploma in Interior Design
* B.Arch / Architecture
* Diploma / Degree in Interior Architecture
* 3D Visualisation or related design fields

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**

Freshers with an exceptionally strong portfolio demonstrating genuine interior design and 3D visualisation skills may also be considered.

PORTFOLIO IS MANDATORY

Candidates must submit a portfolio demonstrating their **own work**.

The portfolio should preferably include:

* Interior renders
* Exterior architectural renders
* Master plan / site visualisations
* Landscape visualisations
* SketchUp models
* D5 / Lumion / V\-Ray / Enscape renders
* Material and lighting studies
* Before/after or design development work, if available

10\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

We are looking for someone who is:

* Creative and design\-oriented
* Technically strong
* Detail\-oriented
* Curious and willing to experiment
* Good at visual communication
* Fast and efficient
* Open to feedback
* Responsible with deadlines
* Comfortable working collaboratively
* Interested in architecture, interiors, materials and design
* Willing to continuously improve their visualisation skills

11\. ROLE \& REPORTING

The selected candidate will work closely with the **Chief Architect and Design Team**.

The role will involve active participation throughout the design process:

**CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT**  
↓  
**SPACE PLANNING**  
↓  
**MATERIAL \& DESIGN DEVELOPMENT**  
↓  
**3D MODELLING**  
↓  
**INTERIOR / EXTERIOR / MASTER PLAN VISUALISATION**  
↓  
**RENDERING**  
↓  
**CLIENT PRESENTATION**  
↓  
**DESIGN REFINEMENT**

The candidate will be expected to take ownership of assigned visualisation and interior design tasks and deliver work with a high level of **design quality, accuracy and presentation standards**.

12\. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

At Pipe Dreamers Collab, we don't see 3D visualisation as simply **making beautiful images**.

Visualisation is an important part of our **design development process**.

The visualiser is expected to understand the design, question it, explore alternatives and help communicate the architectural idea.

You will work across **interiors, architecture, landscape and master planning**, giving you the opportunity to understand projects at both the **human scale and the larger site scale**.

We are looking for someone who can bring together:

**INTERIOR DESIGN \+ ARCHITECTURE \+ 3D MODELLING \+ MATERIALS \+ LIGHTING \+ VISUAL STORYTELLING**

If you are someone who gets excited about transforming a **floor plan, sketch or architectural concept into a beautiful, functional and believable space**, we would like to hear from you.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

* Updated CV / Resume
* **Portfolio of Interior Design \& 3D Visualisation work**
* Examples of **SketchUp \+ D5 / Lumion** projects
* Details of software proficiency
* Current salary and expected salary
* Availability / Notice Period

**Subject: Application – Interior Designer Cum 3D Visualiser**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Principal Product Designer – Infrastructure**


### **Your opportunity**



As a Principal Product Designer on New Relic's Infrastructure design team, you'll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications — cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF\-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP\- and SVP\-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. You'll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.



We care more about how you think than what you've already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work — someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when it's ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.



You'll set craft and design\-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid\-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US\-based team.


### **What you'll do**


* **Infrastructure \& complex data visualization**: Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible — reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
* **System coherence \& fail\-safe UX**: Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root\-cause investigation.
* **Own the product vision**: Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go\-to\-market.
* **Go deep on the technology**: Build real fluency in the systems you're designing for — cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals — through direct conversations with engineers, hands\-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
* **User research**: Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
* **AI\-forward evolution**: Partner with engineering and product to bring AI\-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
* **Team leadership \& craft**: Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid\-level designers, and represent the team's design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
* **Design at scale**: Drive large\-scale, cross\-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth \& Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

### **This role requires**


* 12\+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data\-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
* Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology — evidence that you've taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
* Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
* Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component\-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems\-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
* Solid grasp of WCAG 2\.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
* Ability to connect design work to business outcomes — mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
* Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
* A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP\- or SVP\-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
* An external professional presence in the design community — conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic — consistent with the seniority of this level.

### **Bonus points if you have**


* Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer\-facing tooling.
* Prior exposure to designing for AI\-assisted or LLM\-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI\-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
* A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
* Strong facilitation skills for cross\-functional design sprints and workshops.

### **BUSINESS GOALS**



This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response — the gap between a high\-level "something's wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relic's Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI\-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio\-level vision for that complexity — one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well\-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean\-time\-to\-resolution.


**What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire?**



* Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio\-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.


* AI\-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human\-in\-the\-loop interaction models for AI\-assisted anomaly detection and root\-cause analysis in Infrastructure.


* Process maturation: help standardize cross\-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF\-based instrumentation).


* Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.


* Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth \& Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.

title: Product Designer - Physical Products
description:
**Design the tangible face of CricHeroes.**


At CricHeroes, we’ve revolutionized how grassroots cricketers play, record, and celebrate the game.


Now, we’re ready to bring that same innovation off the screen into the hands of players everywhere.


From smart equipment to thoughtful packaging, we want every CricHeroes product to *look, feel, and perform* like it belongs on the world stage.


And to do that, we’re looking for a **Product Designer** who can bridge creativity, usability, and engineering, designing cricket products that are both beautiful and functional.


###### **The Challenge**


We’re building the next generation of cricket gear and accessories, functional, sustainable, and distinctly CricHeroes.


You’ll help us turn early ideas into real, tangible products, from packaging concepts and physical form factors to manufacturing ready designs.


It’s a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of *aesthetics and utility*, and who’s excited to shape the design identity of a growing cricket brand.


###### **What We’re Looking For**


* **4–7 years of experience** in **industrial or physical product design**, ideally in **consumer goods, sports, or lifestyle products.**


* A strong portfolio showcasing concept to production design, from ideation sketches to prototypes and finished products.


* Proficiency in 3D modeling and rendering tools such as SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, KeyShot, etc.


* Understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, and ergonomics.


* Experience designing packaging systems that balance aesthetics, sustainability, and practicality.


* Attention to detail, coupled with the ability to think systemically across a product range.


* Strong communication and collaboration skills. You can work with engineers, marketers, and external vendors alike.


###### **What You’ll Do**


* Conceptualize and design physical products that embody CricHeroes’ identity, from cricket gear to branded accessories.


* Develop packaging and unboxing experiences that delight users and tell our brand story.


* Collaborate with cross functional teams to bring designs from sketch to prototype to production.


* Explore materials and manufacturing methods to achieve quality, scalability, and sustainability.


* Partner with vendors and suppliers to ensure designs meet cost, quality, and timeline expectations.


* Build and maintain CricHeroes’ physical product design language, ensuring consistency across products, packaging, and merchandising.


* Develop “design” as a differentiator for our products, whether it is trend forward external design elements or shaping the actual design of new products.


###### **About CricHeroes**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network with **50\+ million users**.


We help grassroots cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game through data and technology.


Now, we’re extending that mission into tangible products, the kind that every cricketer can see, touch, and be proud to use.


We believe in fewer rules, more ownership, and loads of candour.


You’ll join a team that values curiosity, craftsmanship, and the drive to make things that truly matter.


Ready to shape the look and feel of CricHeroes’ physical products?


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in

title: Product Designer
description:
**Job title field:** 
 Product Designer
 



**Workplace type:** 
 On\-site ·
 



**Job type:** 
 Full\-time ·
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi, Delhi, India
 



**Working Days** 
 : 6 Working Days
 



  





 We are FylFlix, an AI\-native accounting and compliance platform. FylFlix is the product; WFYI Technology Pvt. Ltd. is the company that builds it.
 



  





 We are building India's first agentic accounting harness — the runtime that lets an AI agent actually keep a company's books: read the ledger, write and run its own code in a sandbox, and check every result against the trial balance before it posts.
 



  





**You would be our first design hire.** 
 Not one of a team — the person who decides what design means here, and who grows into leading the function and building the team.
 



  





**WHERE WE ARE, IN NUMBERS** 



* **Already generating revenue** 
 from products and services live in market today.
* **Targeting ₹20 crore ARR inside twelve months** 
 — on our own revenue, from tools and services already launched, before we raise next.
* **Phase one ships December 2026\. Phase two ships March 2027\.** 
 An enterprise\-grade agentic ERP build lands by the end of December.



  





**THE MARKET** 



* Global ERP software is a
 **$106 billion market in 2026** 
 , forecast to reach
 **$281 billion by 2034** 
 . SMEs are already more than half of it — and the fastest\-growing half.
* There are roughly
 **400 million small and medium businesses on earth** 
 — 90% of all companies, 70% of all employment, and half of global GDP. Almost none of them can afford software that genuinely works.
* **Rillet** 
 is building roughly our thesis for the US alone. In August 2026 they raised
 **$100 million at a $1 billion valuation** 
 , two years out of stealth, on
 **$200M\+ total** 
 from ICONIQ, Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia. 600\+ customers, and
 **ARR doubled in three months** 
 . They are going straight at NetSuite.
* The incumbents — NetSuite, SAP, Sage, QuickBooks, Tally — were architected between the 1980s and the 1990s and priced for companies that could afford consultants to install them.
* **We are building this for the world.** 
 India is where we start, not where we stop: 7\.83 crore registered businesses, 1\.67 crore GST filers, and an incumbent turning over roughly $60 million on thirty\-year\-old software.
 **If an agentic ERP works at Indian price points and Indian compliance complexity, it works anywhere.**



**﻿**




**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



* Every module we have and every one we build next. New products from nothing, and existing ones that need to get better.
* The information architecture and navigation for our accounting suite — decided, defended, and stable.
* A component library our engineers build against without asking you questions.
* Voucher entry an accountant can drive from the keyboard at forty entries an hour without reaching for the mouse.
* The design language for everything that follows — payroll, expenses, reconciliation, the agentic layer.



  





**WHAT WE REQUIRE — please read before applying** 



* **3\+ years** 
 of full\-time product design experience after graduation. Internships and freelance do not count.
* **At least one design of yours is in production right now, used by thousands of people on a recurring basis.** 
 You must be able to name it, link it, and say roughly how many people use it. This is what we screen hardest on.
* **You code your own prototypes** 
 — React or Next.js, running in a browser. With or without AI assistance; we judge the output, not the method. A Figma file is not a prototype.
* Product design, not visual design. Flows, states, edge cases, empty screens, error handling — not brand systems or marketing pages.
* Data\-dense interface experience: dashboards, admin consoles, ERP or POS software, operations tools, complex forms and tables.



  





**STARTUP EXPERIENCE IS A REQUIREMENT, NOT A PREFERENCE** 




 We want people who have built inside a startup — ideally one
 **less than 4–5 years old** 
 when you were there. Being among the first 10–20 employees somewhere is the strongest signal we look for. If your entire career has been at large organisations with briefs handed to you, this will be an uncomfortable fit for both of us.
 



  





**WE ARE NOT FILTERING ON YOUR DEGREE.** 
 Design school, engineering college, or neither. What is in production and who uses it is the entire filter.
 



  





**THE HONEST PART** 



* **Compensation: ₹12–18 LPA fixed.**
* **Working days: six days a week, Monday to Saturday.** 
 We will move to five as soon as we are in a position to, and that is a commitment. But today it is six, and you should decide with that in front of you rather than find it out in month two.
* On\-site in New Delhi. Not remote, not hybrid.
* Relocating? We book and pay for your flight or train.



  





**WHAT YOU GET INSTEAD** 




 No bureaucracy — no approval chains, no committees. Full transparency on revenue, burn and runway; everyone here knows all three. And the chance to be the person who decided what this product looks like.
 



  





**DO NOT APPLY IF** 



* Your portfolio is concept work, unshipped case studies, or redesigns of famous apps.
* Nothing you have designed is currently used by strangers.
* You design in Figma and hand off.
* You are a brand, marketing or graphic designer moving into product.
* You want remote or hybrid, or a six\-day week does not work for you.

 We are looking for a seasoned UI/UX Team Lead with deep Angular expertise and a strong background in Change Management and Orchestration tooling. In this role, you will lead a team of frontend engineers to design and deliver enterprise\-grade Angular applications that drive change management workflows and orchestration processes — enabling teams to manage complex, multi\-step operations with clarity, control, and confidence.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Angular developers, code reviews.
* Architect and deliver scalable Angular applications that support change management workflows and orchestration\-driven operations.
* Design intuitive UI experiences for complex, multi\-step orchestration processes, ensuring clarity and control for end users.
* Define and enforce frontend coding standards, component architecture patterns, and testing strategies across the team.
* Integrate Angular applications with backend orchestration engines and workflow APIs, ensuring reliable and performant data flows.
* Lead performance optimization efforts including lazy loading, change detection tuning, bundle analysis, and build efficiency.

* Demonstrated ability to simplify and visualize complex, multi\-step processes into intuitive and responsive user interfaces.

* Proven track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across cross\-functional, distributed teams.


**What You'll Bring**

* Mentorship Passion — A genuine commitment to growing engineers at all levels through coaching, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
* Communication Skills — Ability to articulate complex technical and workflow concepts clearly for both engineering peers and business stakeholders.
* Problem\-Solving Mindset — A structured, methodical approach to diagnosing frontend challenges in complex, state\-heavy orchestration applications.
* Ownership \& Accountability — A strong sense of responsibility for team quality, delivery timelines, and engineering outcomes.
* Collaborative Spirit — An inclusive, team\-first mindset that thrives in cross\-functional environments alongside backend, DevOps, and product teams.
* Continuous Improvement — A habit of iterating, learning, and staying ahead of the evolving Angular and enterprise frontend ecosystem.

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. title: User Experience Designer
description:
PolkaDot is a creative agency that offers the full range of integrated services, from traditional to emerging media. We bring to the table a wealth of experience working with both corporate giants and sprightly startups.
 



  





 We are looking for a talented and experienced designer with exceptional problem\-solving abilities, clear communication skills, and solid design instincts who can translate business needs into fantastic customer\-focused solutions.
 



  





 The ideal candidate for this position will be able to visualize an experience in the abstract, break down complex use cases and then be able to drive the vision into solid design deliverables. You think first from the customer’s perspective, use research and data to influence your designs, set relentlessly high standards for yourself, and deliver best\-in\-class customer experiences. You thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment and embrace the idea that failure is a critical part of innovation. You balance your passion for inspired, compelling, elegant yet simple designs with a highly analytical nature, precise execution, and a relentless drive to design, build and deliver.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 • Use business requirements, usability findings, and market research to develop scenarios, use cases, and high\-level requirements
 



 • Design conceptual wireframes, dashboards, high\-fidelity mockups, information architecture diagrams, interaction specifications, and functional prototypes
 



 • Develop and nurture relationships across teams and disciplines to promote collaboration and efficiency
 



 • Translate abstract concepts into simple and elegant user interfaces
 



 • Present design work to the user experience team and product team for review and feedback
 



 • Quickly iterate on multiple design explorations to arrive at a simple but robust solution accounting for complex requirements
 



 • Proactively manage your own work queue, time, and expectations, meet deadlines, and communicate needs and tradeoffs if
 



    your schedule is in jeopardy
 



 • Manage ambiguity, work independently and collaboratively within a team, and switch rapidly between different projects in an agile environment
 



 • Understand target users through user research and drive toward collecting more data when needed.
 



  





**Basic qualifications** 




  





 • Bachelor's degree in design, human\-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent professional experience
 



 • 4\+ years of delivering experience in design solutions as a UX designer, interaction designer or information architect
 



 • An online portfolio or samples of work demonstrating experience creating great end\-to\-end, user\-centered design solutions and patterns,            across desktop and mobile devices
 



 • Fluent in English, with excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and analytical skills including the ability to communicate complex,      interactive design concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organization
 



 • Proficiency in designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision
 



 • Familiarity with the technical considerations needed when designing
 



 • Work as a part of the team with copywriters, designers, executives, etc
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 • Experience designing customer\-facing products
 



 • Experience working in a collaborative team, publicly white\-boarding, and working directly with developers for the implementation of designs
 



 • Ability to work gracefully and have a bias for action in a fast\-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
 



 • Capacity to own and drive the design process by independently defining requirements, scoping projects, and prioritizing tasks
 



 • Talent for crafting imaginative and innovative design solutions while maintaining user expectations through pattern consistency and interaction harmony
 



 • Understanding of the current state of technology and best practices
 



 • Strong practical knowledge of user\-centered design methodologies, usability principles, web\-based information architecture, and design—understand accepted UX process standards well enough to be entitled to selectively abandon them
 



 • Demonstrated strong visual design expertise with the ability to produce fresh, simple, elegant, and exceedingly usable layouts and
 



    interactions and iconography

title: UI/UX Developer
description:
**ABOUT CRACK THE CAMPUS:**




  





 Crack The Campus is an emerging EdTech platform focused on bridging the campus\-to\-career gap for engineering students and universities. The platform integrates AI\-proctored coding assessments, structured technical preparation pathways, and real\-time student readiness metrics (CTC Score) to streamline hiring outcomes for institutions and corporate recruiters.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW:**




  





 We are looking for a creative and user\-focused UI/UX Developer to design and build intuitive, responsive, and engaging interfaces for our web applications. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to transform complex workflows—such as proctored exam sessions, analytics dashboards, and student learning tracks—into seamless digital experiences that elevate
 



 CrackTheCampus products.
 



  





**KEY TOOLS \& TECHNOLOGIES:**




  





 • Figma Prototyping
 



 • FigJam (User Flows \& Wireframes)
 



 • Figma AI
 



 • Adobe Photoshop
 



 • Adobe XD
 



 • Sketch
 



 • Canva
 



 • HTML5 \& CSS3
 



 • Tailwind CSS / Responsive Design
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  





 • Design clean, intuitive, and modern UI components for student assessment portals, admin consoles, and corporate recruiter dashboards.
 



 • Build interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes and clickable user journeys in Figma and Adobe XD for user testing and stakeholder walkthroughs.
 



 • Facilitate brainstorming sessions, user flows, journey maps, and low\-fidelity wireframes using FigJam and Sketch.
 



 • Create, edit, and optimize raster graphics, promotional banners, illustrations, and marketing visuals using Adobe Photoshop and Canva.
 



 • Leverage modern AI\-assisted design tooling (Figma AI) for rapid wireframing, layout exploration, and content generation.
 



 • Create and maintain scalable Design Systems, component libraries, typography guides, and style guides across all CrackTheCampus digital touchpoints.
 



 • Collaborate directly with frontend engineers to ensure design fidelity during implementation, translating Figma tokens into clean, responsive HTML/CSS and Tailwind code.
 



 • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to optimize user flows and reduce drop\-offs across assessment and onboarding funnels.
 



 • Design responsive layouts optimized across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports with strong adherence to accessibility standards (WCAG).
 



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:**




  





 • 1 to 3 years of hands\-on UI/UX design and frontend prototyping experience (portfolio showcasing web applications, dashboards, or SaaS products required).
 



 • Expertise in Figma and Figma Prototyping (components, auto\-layout, interactive states, design tokens, and variant systems).
 



 • Strong proficiency with FigJam for wireframing, architecture mapping, and user journey design.
 



 • Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop for visual editing, asset optimization, graphic creation, and image manipulation.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Adobe XD, Sketch, and Canva for rapid prototyping and collateral design.
 



 • Familiarity with Figma AI workflows for rapid wireframing, content generation, and layout exploration.
 



 • Solid foundational understanding of frontend implementation constraints (HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind CSS, flexbox, grid, responsive breakpoints).
 



 • Strong visual design sense: typography, layout hierarchy, color theory, iconography, and micro\-interactions

title: Associate Product Designer
description:
About
 **Bright Money** 




  






 Bright
 
 Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle\-income consumers living paycheck\-to\-paycheck.
 



  





 Bright is a profitable, India\-built, U.S.\-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 12 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial service marketplace revenues for loans, credit cards, and credit\-building tools.
 



  





 Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI\-driven Consumer FinTech for middle\-income consumers.
 



  





 The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle\-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.
 



  





 Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





 Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex\-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data\-driven, fast\-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.
 



  





**What is the team \& role about?** 




  





 We are seeking a Junior Product Designer with a passion for finding solutions that allow customers to intuitively use our products. The ideal candidate is eager to grow at every stage of the design process, excited to use AI to design and build faster, and always focused on the needs of the customer. You will work with other designers and cross\-functional team members, and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.
 



  




* You will receive training in building incredible products and features from highly experienced consumer product veterans.
* You will work on an AI\-native design team, learning to use AI across the entire design process rather than as a bolt\-on.
* You will build the cross\-functional and 0\-to\-1 skills needed to one day become a startup founder yourself.
* You will build advanced skills in A.I. and Finance, trained by experienced tech founders who have this expertise.
* You will build a deep end\-to\-end understanding of building a customer\-focused financial product from scratch.



  





**What you will do?** 




  




* Collaborate with teammates across product and engineering to define, build, and release new products and features.
* Construct user flows, wireframes, and prototypes that effectively communicate design concepts for validation.
* Use AI tools to explore ideas and move to high\-fidelity quickly, and experiment with vibe\-coding prototypes to test concepts in the real product.
* Develop and deliver well\-documented, high\-fidelity visuals that accurately represent Bright Money's brand and design system standards.
* Participate in user interviews and research to better understand customer needs.
* Stay curious about how the best AI products are evolving their UI/UX, and bring those learnings into your work.
* Contribute thinking to product features and the roadmap.
* Contribute to and positively shape the design team's culture through collaboration, feedback, and process iteration.



  





**Ideal candidate profile looks like?** 




**Experience \& Background:** 




  




* 0\-1 years of UI/UX experience with a relevant degree in Human Centered Design, or a related field of study.
* Curiosity and eagerness to use AI design and prototyping tools to raise both the speed and the quality of your work.
* Willingness to build simple functional prototypes, including through vibe\-coding, to pressure\-test ideas.
* Strong design craft skills including interaction, visual, and service design.
* A strong grasp of tools like Figma, the Adobe suite, and prototyping tools.
* Ability to understand business objectives, direction, and needs expressed from multiple inputs ranging from marketing, business, and technical teams.
* Experience across the design process including user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design, and usability testing.
* Interest in designing mobile app interfaces for consumer products.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of web and mobile design and interface guidelines.
* Curiosity for user experience research, both to design new products and to improve existing ones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to discuss and convey design principles and strategies to stakeholders.
* Strong product thinking and a desire to collaborate closely with PMs and engineers.
* An excellent portfolio that demonstrates systematic and creative design thinking, as well as a strong understanding of best practices.
* Passion for a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.



  





**What Bright Offers?** 




  




* A profitable sub\-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P\&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data\-driven, high\-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor — Growth Team

 Bangalore — Work From Office, Near RMZ Infinity, Old Madras Road

 ₹4–6 LPA
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 Kloth.me
 



  




 About Kloth
 
 Kloth is building a new way to shop for fashion — combining
 **AI, content and commerce** 
 to make discovering and buying clothes far more visual, personalised and effortless.
 



 Content is one of our biggest growth levers, and we're looking for a
 **Motion Graphics Designer \& Video Editor** 
 who can help us create content people actually stop scrolling for.
 



 We don't just want polished videos.
 



 We want
 **strong visual ideas, unexpected hooks, great motion and edits that have a real shot at beating the odds of going viral.** 



 The Role
 
 You'll sit within Kloth's
 **Growth Team** 
 and work closely with our content and performance marketing teams.
 



 This is a
 **motion\-graphics\-heavy role with significant video editing requirements.** 




**You'll take concepts, scripts, raw footage, product images, screenshots, typography, memes and AI\-generated assets and turn them into highly engaging short\-form content.** 




**Expect to ship 30–40 short\-form video edits every week.** 



 What You'll Do
 * Create high\-quality
 **motion graphics and animated content** 
 for Reels, ads and social media
* Edit
 **20–30 short\-form videos every week**
* **Design strong visual hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds**
* **Animate typography, UI elements, product imagery, illustrations and graphic assets**
* **Create transitions, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects and motion\-led storytelling**
* **Turn relatively simple raw footage into highly engaging content through editing and motion design**
* **Build performance advertising creatives and rapidly produce multiple variations of winning concepts**
* **Work closely with the content team on scripts, hooks, storyboards and the weekly content calendar**
* **Translate creative concepts into formats that feel native to Instagram and other short\-form platforms**
* **Use AI video and image\-generation tools** 
 to create assets, scenes, effects and experimental content
* Develop reusable motion templates that allow us to increase creative output without making everything look templated
* Review performance data and help iterate on creatives based on what is actually working


 Motion Graphics Skills We're Looking For
 
 You should be highly comfortable with:
 


* **Adobe After Effects**
* **Adobe Premiere Pro**
* **Photoshop / Illustrator**
* **Canva**



 Strong skills in the following are especially valuable:
 


* Kinetic typography
* Text animation
* Motion tracking
* Masking and rotoscoping
* Compositing
* Keyframe animation
* Speed ramping
* Motion blur
* Transitions
* Product animation
* UI animation
* Sound design
* Colour correction
* Green\-screen / background replacement
* Creating motion systems and reusable templates



 You don't need to be a VFX wizard.
 



 But you should be able to look at a fairly ordinary piece of footage and think:
 



**"How do I make this dramatically more interesting?"** 



 Video Editing Matters Just as Much
 
 Motion graphics is the core skill, but this is
 **not a pure animation role** 
 .
 



 A significant part of your job will involve editing real footage.
 



 You should have a strong instinct for:
 


* Hooks
* Pacing
* Jump cuts
* Music
* Sound effects
* Captions
* Reaction shots
* Pattern interrupts
* Story progression
* Retention editing
* Creating multiple cuts of the same idea



 You should understand that a great short\-form edit is often less about cinematic perfection and more about
 **keeping someone watching for another second.** 



 AI Skills Matter
 
 We expect you to actively use generative AI as part of your creative workflow.
 



 You should be comfortable experimenting with tools for:
 


* Text\-to\-video
* Image\-to\-video
* AI\-generated scenes
* AI characters and avatars
* Image generation
* Generative visual effects
* Voice generation
* Background replacement
* AI\-assisted editing
* Concept prototyping



 We don't care whether your favourite tool today is Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney or something released three weeks from now.
 



 We care that you're constantly figuring out
 **what AI lets you create that wasn't practical before.** 



 You Should Also Be a Content Thinker
 
 We don't want someone who waits for a perfectly written brief and then opens After Effects.
 



 You'll be expected to actively contribute ideas.
 



 That means participating in:
 


* Content brainstorming
* Writing hooks
* Improving scripts
* Storyboarding
* Trend spotting
* Developing recurring content formats
* Ad creative ideation
* Content calendar planning



 You'll work with marketers and content creators, but you should be capable of saying:
 



**"This opening won't work. Let's try this instead."** 



 What Success Looks Like
 
 Your work should help Kloth create content that makes people:
 



**Stop. Watch. Share. Click. Buy.** 




**We'll care about things like:** 



* Creative output
* Speed
* Watch time and retention
* Hook performance
* Shares and engagement
* Paid\-ad performance
* Number of new formats tested
* Frequency of breakout creatives



 We'd rather test
 **10 genuinely interesting ideas** 
 than spend a week polishing one safe video.
 


 You'll Probably Love This Role If
 * After Effects feels like home
* You obsess over interesting transitions and typography
* You save ads and Reels because you're trying to reverse\-engineer how they were made
* You can edit extremely quickly
* You have opinions about what happens in the first 2 seconds of a Reel
* You enjoy combining design, editing, memes, pop culture and AI
* You experiment with new AI tools before someone asks you to
* You want your creative work to have a measurable impact on the growth of a startup


 Work Setup
 
 This is a
 **full\-time Work From Office role in Bangalore.** 




**And yes — you get a Mac mini to work on.** 




**You'll have significant creative freedom, a high volume of ideas and assets to play with, and extremely fast feedback on whether your work is actually performing.** 



 Compensation
 
**₹4–6 LPA** 
 , depending on experience, portfolio, creative ability and speed.
 


 How to Apply
 
 Please share:
 


1. Your CV
2. Your motion graphics / video editing portfolio
3. **5 short\-form videos or motion pieces you're most proud of**
4. **Any AI\-generated creative experiments you've made**



**A strong portfolio matters significantly more to us than your degree.** 



* **Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**

title: Product Engineer(2 to 5 Yrs)
description:
Framsikt Technologies is looking for a Product Engineer to join our high\-performing R\&D center in Bangalore. This isn’t a standard development role—this is for an engineer who wants to build great products, work closely with Product and Design, and grow into an independent, end\-to\-end product engineer in an AI\-native engineering environment.
 



  





  





**The Mission:** 




  





 Framsikt is a critical pillar of the Visma Group, one of Europe's leading software companies. Our mission is direct and high\-stakes: we power the technology behind Norway’s public sector management. Our platform is the central nervous system for strategic planning and financial workflows for over 300 municipalities, enabling data\-driven decisions that impact the lives of 5\.4 million citizens.
 



  





 When you build here, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.
   





  





**The Role: Autonomy \& AI\-First Development** 




  





 We are moving past the era of "manual" coding.
 



  





 At Framsikt, we expect engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build software. As a Developing Product Engineer, you will build production features while learning to use AI coding tools, agentic workflows, and context engineering to make your development faster and more effective.
 



  





 You will work with experienced engineers to solve problems, make sound technical decisions, and gradually take greater ownership of features from discovery through production.
 



  




* Build AI\-first: Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Build for scale: Apply common engineering patterns across architecture, APIs, data, security, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Engineer the context: Write structured prompts, provide the right codebase context and constraints, and learn how to guide AI tools towards reliable outcomes.
* Own quality: Write unit tests, contribute to CI/CD, participate in code reviews, and use observability tools to understand and improve production systems.
* Shape the product: Partner closely with Product and Design, bring technical thinking into discovery, and turn prototypes into production with speed and clarity.



  





**The Engineering Culture: Deep Focus over Shallow Output** 




  





 We despise "the feature factory." Our Bangalore R\&D center is a high\-trust, low\-overhead environment designed for engineers who love their craft. We prioritize deep work and systems thinking. You will find a flat hierarchy where the best idea wins, regardless of tenure.
 



  





 We actively encourage "breaking things" in the pursuit of better LLM orchestration and agentic design paradigms. If you are the type of engineer who spends their weekends experimenting with new model evaluations or building custom CLI tools to automate your own job, you will be among peers here.
 



  

  





**What You’ll Bring?** 




  





**Eligibility** 




  




* Education : Any professional technical graduation or masters
* 2\+ years of engineering excellence, ideally with C\#, SQL, Angular, and TypeScript (Azure is a plus)
* We are technology\-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals above specific technology experience, as long as you are open to working with the Microsoft technology stack mentioned above.
* Good at problem solving, curious soul and ability to learn quickly and agile



  





**You are a perfect fit if you:** 




  




* Have a good foundation in software engineering, APIs, data modeling, testing, and application architecture.
* Can independently deliver well\-defined features and seek guidance when solving complex or unfamiliar problems.
* See AI coding agents as a force multiplier and are willing to make them part of your everyday engineering workflow.
* Enjoy experimenting with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf.
* Can write structured prompts and provide the context and constraints needed to get useful results from AI tools.Care about code quality, reliability, maintainability, and good engineering practices even when moving fast.
* Enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn ideas and prototypes into production.
* Are comfortable receiving feedback, learning from experienced engineers, and taking increasing ownership of your work.



  





**Our Culture : Built on the following core three values:** 




  




* Reliable – We deliver with ownership, quality and integrity.
* Helpful – We succeed by supporting each other and our customers.
* Engaged – We stay curious, take initiative and continuously improve.
