 Avaz AAC is an Augmentative and Alternative Communication app that gives children and adults with disabilities such as autism, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, aphasia and apraxia a voice of their own to communicate and build meaningful connections. Avaz AAC is a picture\- and text\-based communication app designed for children and adults with complex communication needs.
 





 Our mission is to make effective communication accessible to every person who needs it. Achieving this requires us to understand communicators and their support networks deeply, translate that understanding into reliable products and continuously improve the communication experience.
 




  





**About the team** 





 We are a team of passionate individuals working towards a more accessible and inclusive world where everyone has the opportunity to communicate and be heard. Our product team brings together product managers, designers, developers and QA, with empathy at the centre of how we work.
 





 We create space for fresh ideas, different perspectives and thoughtful experimentation. Team members are encouraged to question assumptions, explore new approaches and learn directly from the people who use our products. We believe meaningful innovation comes from combining curiosity, open collaboration and a deep understanding of our users.
 




  





**What you’ll do** 





 Own the end\-to\-end design process for Avaz AAC and other upcoming apps and portals in the Avaz suite. You will take products and features from early research and problem definition through interaction design, visual design, prototyping, developer handoff, implementation review and post\-launch iteration.
 





 You will work closely with product managers, developers and QA to translate complex communication needs into intuitive, accessible and dependable product experiences across Android, iOS and web platforms.
 




  





**Role and Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end design of Avaz AAC and other upcoming apps and portals in the Avaz suite, from initial concepts to shipped product state.
* Learn directly from users: run research and usability tests, watch how people use what you ship, and turn what you find into clear design decisions.
* Work closely with product managers to convert product requirements and user needs into user flows, prototypes, and high\-fidelity interface design.
* Design mobile experiences for Android and iOS while accounting for platform conventions, device variations, screen sizes and interaction patterns.
* Build and grow a shared design system across Avaz products so the experience stays consistent as we scale.
* Work closely with developers and QA while the product is being built, so what ships matches the design.



  





**Skills and Attributes** 



* 2 to 3 years of experience in product design, UI/UX design or a related digital design role.
* Demonstrated experience designing mobile applications for both Android and iOS.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, prototypes, libraries and developer handoff.
* Strong understanding of user\-centred design, interaction design, information architecture and visual\-interface design.
* Ability to translate complex requirements and varied user needs into clear, intuitive and implementable design solutions.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and work effectively with product managers, developers and QA.



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience designing AAC, assistive technology, health technology, special\-education products or products for people with diverse access needs.
* Experience designing emotionally sensitive user experiences and conversational interactions, including dialogue flows, tone, prompts, responses and feedback.
* Familiarity with WCAG, Apple Accessibility, Android Accessibility, screen readers or other alternative access methods.
* Experience creating or maintaining a design system or UI/UX style guide.
* Familiarity with front\-end development workflows and the technical considerations involved in implementing interface designs.

 Requirements

* Strong proficiency in
 **ArtCAM**

* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings (AutoCAD, etc.)
* Attention to detail and accuracy in design outputs
* Problem\-solving and coordination skills



**Qualifications \& Experience** 
  




* Diploma / Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering, Production, Interior Design, or related field
* 2–5 years of experience in CAM design or CNC programming (preferably in modular furniture industry)
* Hands\-on experience with CNC routers and manufacturing processes



**Preferred Skills** 
  




* Knowledge of other software like AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar design tools
* Experience working in a modular factory setups
* Understanding of ERP systems for production workflow


 Benefits
   

  


**We offer a dynamic work environment, opportunities for growth, and competitive compensation package. If you are passionate about design and are looking for a challenging and rewarding career, we would love to hear from you!** 
  





**What You Get** 
  




* Medical benefits for your wellbeing

title: CPU Physical Design Engineer, Staff
description:
****Company:****
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

****Job Area:****
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Hardware Engineering
   

  

****General Summary:****
 As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next\-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring\-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting\-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.
   

  

****Minimum Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

****Job Overview****
 We are looking for bright and highly motivated ASIC Physical Design Engineers with strong analytical and technical skills to join our Snapdragon CPU team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on high\-performance CPU designs for advanced SoCs in sub\-10nm technologies targeting Mobile, Compute, and IoT products. Similar responsibilities are reflected in internal CPU Physical Design roles focused on RTL\-to\-GDSII implementation, PPA optimization, timing closure, and advanced\-node design.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Own and drive block\-level physical design implementation from RTL/netlist to GDSII.
* Perform Place \& Route (PnR), timing closure, power optimization, physical verification, and signoff activities.
* Develop and optimize implementation methodologies, flows, and recipes to achieve best\-in\-class Performance, Power, and Area (PPA).
* Create and execute design experiments to evaluate implementation strategies and drive QoR improvements.
* Analyze, compare, and track implementation metrics to guide project decisions.
* Collaborate closely with RTL Design, Synthesis, STA, Power, Thermal, and Verification teams to achieve aggressive PPA goals.
* Debug and resolve implementation challenges related to timing, power, congestion, and physical verification.
* Contribute to methodology improvements, automation, and flow enhancement using scripting.


****Minimum Qualifications****
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in ASIC Physical Design and high\-performance CPU implementation.
* Strong experience in RTL\-to\-GDSII implementation flow.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Place \& Route using Cadence Innovus and/or Synopsys Fusion Compiler. Relevant skills commonly include floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, timing closure, and PPA optimization.
* Strong understanding of complete ASIC implementation flow, including:
+ Floorplanning
+ Power Planning
+ Placement
+ Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS)
+ Routing
+ Timing Closure
+ Physical Verification and Signoff

* Experience with STA and timing signoff using PrimeTime and/or Tempus.
* Expertise in SDC constraint generation, validation, and debugging.
* Experience with multi\-power domain designs and UPF/CPF implementation.
* Good understanding of low\-power design and implementation techniques.
* Knowledge of formal verification tools such as Formality and/or Conformal.
* Familiarity with IR/EM analysis, signal integrity, and power analysis.
* Strong scripting skills in Tcl, Perl, and/or Python.
* Experience working on advanced technology nodes (7nm and below preferred).
* Understanding of CPU microarchitecture and critical timing paths.
* Experience implementing high\-frequency, high\-performance CPU designs.
* Strong knowledge of clock architecture and CTS methodologies for high\-speed designs.
* Exposure to constraint management tools and Verilog coding.
* Excellent debugging, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

title: AI Graphic Designer
description:
**Who We Are:** 




 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 As a global, remote\-first organization, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and high\-performing workplace.
 



 About the Role:
 



 The Creative Automation Designer will be responsible for creating scalable, flexible, and production\-ready design solutions that can adapt across multiple products, formats, sizes, content variations, and customer requirements.
 



 The role combines strong visual design expertise with dynamic design systems, responsive layouts, auto\-layout, reusable components, AI\-powered creative workflows, and production knowledge.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to transform static creative concepts into intelligent, reusable, and scalable design solutions.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Creative Operations, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to bridge creative design with technical implementation and help build efficient, future\-ready creative workflows.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Dynamic \& Scalable Design** 



* Create visually compelling and production\-ready designs for print, packaging, promotional products, branding, and digital applications.
* Develop dynamic templates and scalable layouts that adapt across products, formats, sizes, content, and customer requirements.
* Transform static designs into flexible, reusable, and scalable design solutions by defining clear layout and content behavior rules.
* Identify opportunities to improve scalability by converting repetitive design activities into reusable templates, components, and workflows.



**Auto Layout \& Responsive Design** 



* Develop layouts using auto\-layout, responsive design, constraints, grids, and component\-based principles.
* Define how layouts respond to changes in content, text length, image dimensions, product sizes, and available space.
* Establish rules for resizing, reflow, stacking, wrapping, positioning, spacing, and content priority.
* Ensure designs maintain visual hierarchy, usability, consistency, and quality across digital, print, and product formats.



**Design Systems \& Component Libraries** 



* Create and maintain design systems, component libraries, templates, visual assets, and design standards.
* Develop reusable components for typography, color, imagery, icons, grids, spacing, and layouts.
* Establish design rules that support consistency, scalability, and reuse across products and business units.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to translate design components and specifications into dynamic design systems and platforms.



**AI\-Powered Creative \& Automation** 



* Leverage Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, asset creation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and adaptation.
* Evaluate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure quality, accuracy, originality, and brand consistency.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into creative workflows to improve productivity, scalability, and quality.
* Experiment with emerging creative technologies and contribute to AI\-assisted workflows and best practices.



**Visual Design, Print \& Production** 



* Apply strong principles of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, color, grids, spacing, branding, and design consistency.
* Create designs that balance creative quality, scalability, usability, and production requirements.
* Apply knowledge of print production, packaging, substrates, dielines, color management, resolution, finishing, and manufacturing constraints.
* Ensure outputs are technically accurate and suitable for automated, personalized, and large\-scale production.



**Collaboration \& Implementation** 



* Collaborate with Creative, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to understand requirements and deliver effective design solutions.
* Translate creative concepts into clear design rules, specifications, components, and implementation requirements.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure design intent is accurately translated into dynamic and scalable systems.
* Participate in design reviews, prototyping, experimentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.



**Quality \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Maintain high standards of visual quality, consistency, accuracy, scalability, and production readiness.
* Review dynamic templates and outputs to identify layout, typography, imagery, responsiveness, and production issues.
* Establish and follow quality standards for dynamic design and template production.
* Continuously identify opportunities for standardization, automation, AI adoption, and workflow optimization.



  





  





**Your Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, UI/UX, or a related field.
* **3–5\+** 
 years of professional experience in graphic, visual, template, dynamic, or production design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating dynamic layouts, templates, responsive design, and production\-ready creative work.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, color, spacing, composition, grids, and brand consistency.
* Strong understanding of responsive layouts, auto\-layout, constraints, components, and reusable design patterns.
* Ability to translate designs into rules, logic, templates, and reusable components that can scale across formats, sizes, products, and customer requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
* Experience creating adaptable layouts, templates, design variations, and reusable visual assets for print and digital applications.
* Practical experience with Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, image generation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and production acceleration.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs and maintain quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and production standards.
* Willingness to continuously learn and adopt AI, automation, and emerging creative technologies.
* Understanding of how design systems and creative assets can support scalable and automated production workflows.
* Experience with Figma, Adobe Firefly, Canva, or other Generative AI tools will be an added advantage.
* Experience with design systems, component libraries, style guides, and automated creative workflows.
* Experience in e\-commerce, print, packaging, or high\-volume design operations.



  





  





**Why You'll Love Working Here:** 




 At Cimpress, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to scalable creative solutions that connect design, technology, automation, and AI.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to help shape efficient, future\-ready creative workflows while working across Creative, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams.

 Cimpress operates with a Remote\-First culture that empowers employees with flexibility, autonomy, and trust.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 Cimpress is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. title: Structural Design Engineer (RCC)
description:
**Company Description** 




 Flood Precast, established in 1979, specializes in precast concrete products with a strong focus on precast concrete structures. Through continuous research and development, the company has expanded its capabilities and product range to serve diverse construction needs. Flood Flooring is now recognized as the largest producer of precast concrete flooring in the UK and Irish markets. The company is committed to quality, innovation, and reliable delivery, offering robust engineering solutions to support modern infrastructure projects.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This full\-time Structural Design Engineer (RCC) role at Flood Precast India is an on\-site position based in Mumbai. The role involves performing structural analysis and design of reinforced concrete components and precast systems for residential and commercial projects. The engineer will prepare detailed design calculations, drawings, and specifications, and ensure compliance with relevant codes and standards. Daily tasks include using tools such as AutoCAD and Tekla Structures/Tekla Structures Designer for modelling, detailing and analysis, coordinating with project managers, architects, and site teams, and reviewing designs for safety, durability, and constructability. The role also includes assisting in value engineering, supporting technical documentation, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Strong foundation in Structural Engineering and Civil Engineering, with the ability to design RCC and precast concrete elements.
* Proficiency in Structural Analysis using relevant software and methods to assess loads, stability, and performance.
* Structural Analysis \& Modelling: Develop and analyse structural models using appropriate software to evaluate load combinations, connections, and structural behaviour of precast systems.
* Knowledge of Eurocodes and standards applicable to RCC and precast structures.
* Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with attention to accuracy and detail.
* Relevant industry experience in building or infrastructure projects; precast concrete experience is an advantage.



  





  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




 •     
 
 M.Tech in Structural Engineering.
 




 •     
 
 Minimum 4 years of experience in RCC structural design with exposure to precast construction or in\- situ construction.
 




 •     
 
 Proficiency in Tekla Structures Designer and other design software.
 




 •     
 
 Strong knowledge of RCC design principles and seismic design.
 




 •     
 
 Good communication and coordination skills required; a strong hold on English will be an advantage.
 




  





**Preferred Skills** 




 •     
 
 Exposure to precast structures or BIM workflows.
 




 •     
 
 Familiarity with international codes (Eurocode / BS) is an advantage.
 




 •     
 
 Experience in a structural design consultancy environment.
 




  





**Salary** 



* **Salary:** 
 Highly competitive, above industry benchmarks — reflecting your expertise and experience in precast structural design.
* **Growth:** 
 Clear career progression path within a fast\-growing precast construction leader.
* **Work Environment:** 
 Opportunity to work on landmark precast projects with exposure to international design codes (Eurocode/BS) and modern BIM workflows.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
**Overview** 




 As a Principal Product Designer, you will be one of Airtel’s most senior design leaders. You will shape the broadest and most consequential product opportunities often spanning multiple product portfolios, platforms, channels, operating models, or business units.
 



 You will set the organisation’s standard for problem framing, customer insight, interaction and visual craft, systems thinking, technical fluency, storytelling, and measurable design impact. You will guide and approve critical work by senior designers and responsible for their career and growth path. Your contribution will be visible both in the products Airtel ships and in how the wider organisation defines, decides, and builds.
 



  





**What you will own** 



* Long\-range experience direction for major product portfolios or company\-level initiatives.
* The quality and coherence of critical experiences across products, channels, and customer relationships.
* Organisation\-level design frameworks, principles, behavioural patterns, and systemic improvements.
* Executive alignment on complex customer, product, technology, operational, and business trade\-offs.
* Raise the design bar for the most important initiatives and the development of senior design leadership.
* Opportunities for design to create new customer value, differentiation, growth, trust, or operating leverage.



  





**What you will do** 




**Shape company\-level product and experience strategy** 



* Set the gold standard for defining complex customer and business problems with clarity, depth, and strategic relevance.
* Identify opportunities that cut across existing organisational or product boundaries and build compelling cases for action.
* Define or co\-create long\-range experience visions that connect immediate delivery with Airtel’s future product and business direction.
* Balance foundational systems, near\-term outcomes, regulatory or operational realities, and bold future bets.
* Improve the organisation’s approach to customer research, experimentation, measurement, and post\-launch learning where current evidence is insufficient.



**Define the organisation’s design and systems bar** 



* Set and evolve standards for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, content, accessibility, prototyping, service experience, and implementation quality.
* Create principles, frameworks, and reusable behavioural patterns that allow teams to solve complex problems consistently without losing customer context.
* Identify systemic issues across journeys, platforms, channels, terminology, information architecture, and operational processes; lead programmes to resolve them.
* Connect and simplify complex systems while making the consequences of exceptions and trade\-offs explicit.
* Guide the evolution and governance of Airtel’s design system when current components or patterns are insufficient for the next generation of products.
* Shape responsible AI\-enabled products and design practices, including intent definition, behavioural rules, guardrails, feedback loops, explainability, failure recovery, and human oversight.
* Establish or sponsor organisation\-level quality mechanisms that protect the intended experience through build and release.



**Lead the organisation through influence** 



* Influence at every level through exceptional product judgment, evidence, design craft, and business understanding.
* Use prototypes and storytelling to make future opportunities tangible and enable strategic decisions.
* De\-escalate difficult situations, align senior leaders, and move initiatives through complex organisational constraints.
* Direct and critique the work of Lead and Senior Product Designers on the highest\-impact programmes.
* Identify the few decisions or design changes that materially improve an initiative’s customer and business outcome.
* Coach senior designers on strategy, executive influence, systems thinking, prioritisation, technical collaboration, and leadership.
* Build stronger design leaders through clear standards, direct feedback, trust, and visible hands\-on contribution.



**Increase the leverage of Design** 



* Identify where Design can unlock growth, reduce service effort, improve trust, increase adoption, or create new business models.
* Improve design operating mechanisms, cross\-functional collaboration, feedback culture, hiring quality, and senior talent development.
* Represent Airtel Design externally through writing, speaking, industry collaboration, or thought leadership when it creates value.
* Attract and develop exceptional design talent by setting a standard people want to learn from.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Typically 10\+ years of experience in Product Design, with substantial experience shaping complex products, platforms, or ecosystems at scale.
* A body of work demonstrating company\-level problem framing, long\-range vision, systems design, exceptional craft, and measurable business and customer impact.
* Deep expertise across product strategy, interaction design, visual design, information architecture, prototyping, and design systems.
* Strong fluency in research, data, technology, operations, and organisational decision\-making.
* The ability to reason across customer journeys, backend systems, assisted channels, policy, regulation, and service operations.
* A record of influencing executives and aligning multiple teams or business units around a coherent direction.
* A record of creating reusable frameworks or systems that improve outcomes beyond your own projects.
* Evidence of developing senior designers and raising organisational design quality through influence rather than hierarchy.
* Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, negotiation, conflict\-resolution, and written communication skills.



  





**Good to have** 



* Experience in fintech, telecom, banking, payments, identity, AI, marketplaces, platform ecosystems, or other regulated and high\-scale environments.
* Experience shaping products across consumer, enterprise, assisted, retail, and operational channels.
* Industry\-recognised work, public writing, speaking, patents, frameworks, or other external contribution.
* Experience defining new design\-system, AI interaction, or service\-experience conventions.



  





**What success looks like** 



* Airtel makes better portfolio and investment decisions because of your framing and influence.
* Major product areas converge around a coherent customer and experience direction.
* Systemic complexity is reduced rather than redistributed between teams or channels.
* The organisation ships products that are simpler for customers, scalable for technology, viable for the business, and workable for operations.
* Senior designers become stronger strategic and organisational leaders through your coaching.
* Airtel’s design standards, frameworks, and product experiences are recognised internally—and increasingly externally—as benchmarks for quality.
* Design creates measurable new value beyond interface delivery.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Most graphic designers just want to make things look pretty. They obsess over drop shadows and perfectly aligned vectors, but they have absolutely no idea if their design actually generated a click, a lead, or a sale. We don’t hire decorators; we hire growth architects.
 



  





 We are looking for a lethal Graphic Designer who understands the fundamental rules of art and knows how to weaponize them for performance marketing. If you know how to build high\-converting statics, analyze heat maps to improve UI/UX, and actually bring your web designs to life in Framer, we want you on our team.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Work):** 



* **High\-Impact Statics \& Banners:** 
 You will design elite, scroll\-stopping static ads, website banners, and social assets. You understand visual hierarchy, contrast, and typography well enough to direct the user’s eye exactly where we want it to go.
* **The Science of Art:** 
 You don't just rely on Canva templates. You have a deep, fundamental understanding of color theory, composition, and visual weight, and you know how to apply these classical art principles to modern digital marketing.
* **Data\-Driven UI/UX:** 
 You don’t design landing pages based on "gut feeling." You analyze heat maps, scroll\-depth tracking, and click data to identify friction points and redesign interfaces that optimize the conversion rate.
* **Framer Development:** 
 You aren't just designing in Figma and handing it off to a developer to ruin. You have the technical capability to build, animate, and publish blazing\-fast, premium websites directly in Framer.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* You are a rare hybrid who is equally comfortable designing a gritty, direct\-response Meta ad as you are building a sleek, minimalist D2C landing page.
* You check your ego at the door. If a "ugly" high\-contrast banner out\-converts your beautiful, subtle masterpiece, you celebrate the data and adapt.
* You operate with extreme speed and precision. You know how to maintain brand guidelines without letting them slow down your output velocity.



**If you design digital experiences that make people stop, stare, and buy, apply below with your portfolio.**

 PVR Limited, India’s most admired multiplex chain, was founded in 1995 through a joint venture between Priya Exhibitors Private Limited and Village Roadshow Limited, a global exhibition leader. description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 We are looking for an Instructional Design QA Specialist to review learning content across scripts, storyboards, animatics and final production.
   

  

 The role is responsible for ensuring that each piece of content communicates its intended concept clearly, accurately and effectively. The specialist will evaluate the relationship between narration, visuals, activities and learning outcomes while converting recurring feedback into practical SOPs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Review scripts, storyboards, animatics and final videos for instructional effectiveness.
* Verify alignment with defined learning objectives, content briefs and intended audiences.
* Assess whether concepts are introduced in a clear and logical sequence.
* Check explanations, examples, activities and summaries for accuracy and relevance.
* Ensure visuals, animation and on\-screen text correctly support the narration.
* Identify confusing explanations, missing learning steps, contradictions and unnecessary repetition.
* Evaluate pacing, information density, cognitive load and audience engagement.
* Review language for clarity, simplicity, grammar and audience appropriateness.
* Review content for cultural sensitivity, inclusivity and appropriate representation.
* Validate consistency across approved scripts, storyboards, voice\-over, subtitles and final output.
* Identify audiovisual issues that affect comprehension, including unclear visuals, poor timing, incorrect emphasis and distracting presentation.
* Classify issues by category, severity and production stage.
* Provide clear, timestamped and actionable feedback to production teams.
* Distinguish genuine instructional defects from subjective creative preferences.
* Collaborate with instructional designers, subject\-matter experts, writers, animators and production leads.
* Track recurring feedback and convert it into SOPs, checklists and preventive guidelines.
* Analyse rejected or repeatedly revised content to identify root causes and process gaps.
* Participate in pre\-production reviews to prevent issues from reaching later stages.
* Conduct final compliance and quality checks before delivery.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of instructional design and learning principles.
* Ability to evaluate whether content effectively communicates the intended concept.
* Strong attention to detail, logical reasoning and analytical ability.
* Excellent written communication and feedback\-documentation skills.
* Ability to review audiovisual content from both learner and production perspectives.
* Understanding of audience comprehension, cognitive load and content progression.
* Ability to create structured QA frameworks, SOPs and checklists.
* Confidence in challenging unclear or ineffective instructional decisions with sound reasoning.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables, review stages and deadlines.
* Strong working proficiency in English \& Hindi


**Preferred Experience**
* 1\.5\-5 years of experience in instructional design, content quality assurance, educational content review or digital learning production.
* Experience reviewing videos, animation, digital lessons or interactive learning content.
* Familiarity with scripts, storyboards, animatics, voice\-over, subtitles and video\-production workflows.
* Experience working with learning objectives, content standards and subject\-matter experts.
* Familiarity with issue trackers, spreadsheets, review platforms or content\-management systems.

title: Head - Technical Designer
description:
Who We Are Space Matrix is a leading Workplace Design and Build’ consultancy that specializes in creating innovative, sustainable, and human-centric work environments. SMG aims to revolutionise the interior design industry by pioneering DesignTech and offering innovative interior design and building design solutions that cater to the workplace, hospitality, residential, and commercial sectors. Established in 2001 and headquartered in Singapore, we have a strong presence across APAC and beyond, we have more than 600 employees across 16 offices. We are a proud Great Place to Work certified company 7 years in a row. Please visit www.spacematrix.com to learn more. About the Role: SpaceMatrix delivers commercial, workplace and hospitality interiors across six regions. Design intent is strong and consistently solid; what varies is the technical layer beneath it — the depth of the drawing set, the resolution of junction details, the discipline of MEP coordination, and the quality of what finally gets built. That variance is regional, it is visible to clients, and it is the single largest source of avoidable cost, delay and reputational risk in the business. This role exists to remove that variance and to lead the technical function strategically. They own the firm and its documentation and detailing standard as a single national instrument, hold all six regions accountable to it, and carry personal technical responsibility for delivery on the practice & most demanding projects. Equally, this is a leadership appointment rather than a custodial one. The expectation is not only that our documentation becomes consistent, but that the way we produce it gets fundamentally better — that the person in this seat interrogates how drawings, details and coordination actually move through the practice, and redesigns that flow so technical quality and delivery speed improve together rather than trade against each other. This is a people-leadership appointment, not a senior individual-contributor seat. The work is done through teams— a central technical group reporting directly, and documentation leads in every region. Success is measured by the capability of those teams and the consistency of what they produce, not by the drawings this person produces personally. The benchmark is explicit: hospitality-level precision, applied to every typology we deliver. Not hospitality as a sector — hospitality as a standard of resolution, tolerance and finish. What makes the role successful: 1) Ownership of the National Documentation Standard Author, publish and maintain a single firm-wide DD& standard covering drawing hierarchy, sheet naming and numbering, scale conventions, layer and view templates, annotation and dimensioning protocol, revision control, and the mandatory deliverable schedule at each design stage. Build and own a central detail library — wet-area and dry-area junctions, skirting and shadow-gap conditions,ceiling perimeter and service integration details, flooring transitions, door and frame interfaces, joinery sections, expansion and movement joints, waterproofing terminations. Maintain a national Revit template and family standard, with model integrity rules, worksharing protocol and export conventions. Governance of the model is part of the standard, not separate from it. Publish specification templates and a controlled materials and finishes register, aligned to approved vendors and tested against Indian site availability, lead times and workmanship reality. Version, date, communicate and enforce every revision to the standard. The standard is a living document under a single custodian — this role. 2) Process Strategy and Delivery Flow Own the technical delivery process end to end and continuously improve it. The standard is the instrument; the objective is a faster, cleaner, more predictable path from concept sign-off to handover. Map the current documentation workflow across all six regions, identify where effort is duplicated, where information is lost between stages, and where late decisions are structurally forced — then redesign the sequence to remove those points. Define the stage-gate architecture for the practice: what must be frozen when, what deliverable closes each gate, and what downstream work is not permitted to begin until it does. Most programme loss originates in gates that were never enforced. Analyze defect, RFI, revision and rework data to locate root causes in process rather than in individuals, and to direct improvement effort where it returns the most. Evaluate and introduce technology that changes the economics of documentation — model-based quantity extraction, automated sheet and schedule generation, parametric detail families, clash-detection workflows, common data environments and issue-tracking platforms. Build the business case, pilot it, and roll it out with training rather than mandate. Work with design, project management and commercial leadership to align documentation effort with fee structure and resourcing, so technical rigour is planned and paid for rather than absorbed at the back end of a programme. Set the three-year technical roadmap for the practice and report progress against it to leadership. 3) Regional Accountability and Compliance Establish a documentation audit regime across all six regions: scheduled stage-gate reviews at concept sign-off, DD freeze, GFC release and pre-handover, with written findings and closure tracking. Hold release authority over the GFC set. No drawing package issues to a contractor from any region without technical clearance against the standard. Report compliance by region to the leadership group on a defined cycle, with defect trends, repeat findings and remediation status. Non-compliance is escalated, not absorbed. Identify and close capability gaps region by region — through training, template correction, resourcing recommendations or, where necessary, direct intervention on the project. Standardise the technical interface with clients and PMCs: RFI formats, submittal registers, material approval workflows, snag list structure and handover documentation. 4) Project Delivery — Technical Leadership Carry accountability for technical delivery on the practice's flagship and highest-risk projects — directing the teams producing the work, not producing it personally. Review, interrogate and sign off the full drawing set: dimensioned layouts, RCPs, elevations, sections, joinery and bespoke element details, finishes and door schedules, setting-out and coordination drawings. Judgement and approval sits here; authorship sits with the team. Direct BOQ preparation and defend it commercially — setting the specification position, scrutinising rates,and holding the line against unapproved substitution at award and at site. Ensure design is reconciled against programme, budget and buildability before it reaches the contractor, and intervene personally where a project is failing or a client relationship requires seniority. 5) MEP and Services Coordination Own services coordination as a design discipline. Lead ceiling void reconciliation, clear-height verification,service routing, and clash resolution with MEP consultants, PMCs and specialist contractors. Set the coordination protocol every region follows: coordination sequence, model federation, clash tolerance, sign-off gates and the point at which ceiling design is frozen. Verify sprinkler, diffuser, detector, luminaire, speaker and access-panel layouts against the reflected ceiling design — symmetry, alignment and setting-out treated as design deliverables, not contractor discretion. Protect committed ceiling heights and clear dimensions through the coordination process. Where they cannot be held, raise it early and in writing. 6) Site Quality, Mockups and Handover Set and enforce a national QC protocol: mockup and benchmark approval before bulk execution, stage inspections, material sign-off at delivery, and workmanship tolerances published in millimetres. Run and standardise the snagging process — structured snag registers, categorised defects, closure evidence,and a de-snag sign-off that is genuinely conditional. Attend sites across regions at the stages that decide quality: setting out, first fix, ceiling grid, mockup, and pre-handover. Own post-occupancy technical review — capture defects and failures back into the detail library so the same mistake is not detailed twice. 7) People Leadership and Capability Lead the central technical and standards team directly — objective-setting, workload allocation, performance review, development planning and day-to-day management. Lead the documentation leads across all six regions through a matrix relationship: set their technical objectives, contribute formally to their appraisals, and hold them accountable for regional compliance. Own technical hiring for the practice — define competency benchmarks for documentation roles, set the assessment method, and sit on selection panels across regions. Run a structured technical training programme: detailing workshops, MEP literacy sessions, BOQ writing, site exposure and Revit standards training, with defined progression from junior to senior documentation capability. Mentor senior technical staff towards independent compliance, so the standard is upheld locally rather than policed centrally — and build a succession bench beneath this role. Manage underperformance where it persists, and make the resourcing and structural recommendations required when a region cannot meet the standard with its current team. Advise leadership on technical headcount, team structure and resourcing across the six regions. The Precision Benchmark: “Hospitality-level precision” is a measurable standard, not an aspiration. In this role it means: Every junction is drawn, not assumed. Where two materials meet, a detail exists at an appropriate scale and it is the contractor & only instruction. Setting-out is designed. Tile, panel, joint and ceiling grids are set out from a stated datum with cut positions decided by the designer, not the mason. Tolerances are published. Level, plumb, alignment, joint width and reveal dimensions carry stated tolerances in millimetres, and they are inspected against. Services are composed. Every visible ceiling and wall element is positioned deliberately and coordinated to the design grid. Specification is unambiguous. A specification names the product, the standard, the finish, the substrate, the fixing and the acceptance criterion. Mockups precede bulk. Nothing repetitive or high-visibility proceeds without an approved benchmark. Documentation is traceable. Every revision is recorded, reasoned and issued through a controlled register. Authority: For this role to function, the following authority is delegated and must be stated in the appointment letter: Technical release authority over GFC drawing packages in all six regions. Authority to reject non-compliant documentation and to stop issues until corrected. Authority to halt bulk execution at site pending mockup or benchmark approval. Custodianship of the national standard, detail library, Revit template and approved materials register — sole rights of amendment. Formal input into the objectives, appraisals and progression of documentation staff in every region. Decision rights on technical hiring standards and on selection for documentation roles practice-wide. Escalation path direct to the Managing Director on unresolved regional non-compliance. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor's degree in Interior Design or Architecture from a recognised institution. 8–14 years in interior fitout delivery, with a minimum of five full projects taken personally from design development through GFC, construction support and handover. Demonstrable hospitality or luxury-residential documentation experience, or equivalent evidence of detailing at that resolution in a commercial context. Advanced Revit — model authoring, family creation, template and worksharing management, and the ability to set standards others work to. AutoCAD proficiency assumed. Genuine MEP literacy: able to read service drawings, identify clashes independently, and hold a technical argument with an HVAC, fire or electrical consultant on merit. BOQ authorship and specification writing from first principles, including rate scrutiny and tender-stage negotiation. Working command of NBC, applicable fire and life-safety requirements, local statutory approvals and the compliance conditions that govern occupancy. Demonstrated line-management experience — a team of at least six to eight technical staff, with direct responsibility for hiring, appraisal, development and performance management. Experience leading through influence across geographies, including staff who did not report to you directly. Evidence of having improved a delivery process, not merely operated within one — a workflow redesigned, a stage-gate structure introduced, a technology adopted, with a stated before-and-after effect. Experience working across multiple offices, cities or teams, with evidence of having imposed consistency across them. Willingness and availability to travel nationally at short notice. Preferred Prior experience authoring or owning a firm-wide design standard, detail library or documentation manual. Exposure to international hospitality operator standards and brand technical guidelines. Experience on the contractor or PMC side, or in design-and-build delivery. Competencies and Disposition: People's leadership. Builds technical capability in others and is measured by it. Comfortable setting objectives, giving difficult feedback, developing successors and managing underperformance through to resolution. Technical authority. Credibility rests on demonstrated command of the detail, not position alone. This A person will be challenged by regional leads and by contractors, and must win on substance — while resisting the pull to take the work back and do it themselves. Constructive obstinacy. Able to hold a standard under commercial and programme pressure, and to say no at site at eight in the evening. Strategic ownership. Think about documentation as a production system with cost, cycle time and failure rates, not as a set of drawings. Can articulate a three-year technical direction for the practice and sequence it against commercial reality. Systems thinking. Treats a recurring defect as a documentation failure to be fixed at source, not a site problem to be resolved individually. Influence without direct line authority. Regional teams report elsewhere. Compliance has to be achieved through credibility, clarity and consistency as much as through mandate. Written precision. Standards, audit findings and specifications are written instruments. Ambiguity in writing becomes a defect on site. What This Role Is Not: This is not a concept design or visualisation role. It sits downstream of design ideation and is measured on buildability, coordination and executed quality. Candidates whose portfolios comprise renders and mood boards without complete drawing sets, BOQs and executed site evidence will not be shortlisted. It is also not a senior individual-contributor position. The practice already has capable technical people producing drawings; what it needs is someone to lead them. A candidate whose satisfaction comes primarily from personally authoring the set, and who is reluctant to delegate, will neither enjoy this role nor succeed in it. Nor is it a passive standards or documentation-control function. The role carries live project accountability and real authority, over both work and people, and requires someone prepared to use it.

title: Interior designer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Interior Design Manager to lead the design team, manage multiple residential projects, ensure design quality, and coordinate closely with Sales and Execution teams from concept to site implementation. Position Details Designation: Interior Design Manager
 Department: Design
 Industry: Interior Design / Home Interiors
 Location: Bengaluru
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reporting To: Design Head / Business Head Role Overview The Interior Design Manager will be responsible for leading the interior design team and managing the complete design lifecycle of residential interior projects -from client brief and concept development to final design approval and execution handover. The role requires a combination of creative leadership, technical knowledge, client management, team management, and project coordination . The Design Manager must ensure that designs are aesthetically strong, functionally practical, commercially viable, and accurately communicated to the execution team. Key Responsibilities 1. Design Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage the team of Interior Designers. Allocate projects to designers based on workload, capability, and project requirements. Review designers work at key stages of every project. Establish design standards, processes, and quality benchmarks. Conduct regular design reviews and provide constructive feedback. Monitor individual designer performance and productivity. Train team members on design standards, materials, software, and client handling. Ensure designers follow the companys design process and timelines. 2. Client Brief & Requirement Understanding Ensure detailed understanding of the clients lifestyle, preferences, functional requirements, budget, and expectations. Review project requirements before design development begins. Ensure all client requirements are properly documented. Identify design opportunities, constraints, and potential execution challenges at the initial stage. Ensure design proposals are aligned with the clients budget and project scope. 3. Concept & Design Development Oversee development of interior concepts, layouts, colour schemes, material palettes, furniture selections, and design details. Ensure designs are aesthetically appealing while remaining functional and practical. Review floor plans, furniture layouts, elevations, 3D views, and detailed drawings. Ensure consistency of design language throughout the home. Encourage innovative and contemporary design solutions while maintaining commercial practicality. Ensure designs are suitable for actual site execution. 4. Design Quality Control Review all major design deliverables before they are presented to clients. Ensure accuracy of dimensions, layouts, elevations, materials, finishes, and specifications. Check designs for functionality, ergonomics, storage requirements, circulation, and usability. Identify design errors before drawings reach the execution stage. Maintain Vaastukalpaas design quality standards across all projects. 5. Client Presentation & Approval Participate in important client meetings and design presentations. Support designers in presenting concepts, layouts, 3D designs, materials, and finishes. Handle design-related client objections and concerns. Guide clients toward practical and commercially viable design decisions. Ensure client feedback is captured accurately. Manage design revisions and ensure timely approvals. Ensure documented approval before moving designs to execution. 6. Coordination With Sales Team Work closely with the Sales Manager from project handover through design finalisation. Review the scope committed to the client during the sales process. Ensure the design remains within the approved project scope and commercial framework. Identify scope gaps or inconsistencies at an early stage. Support the Sales team with design inputs during important client discussions. Ensure design proposals support the companys commercial objectives. 7. Coordination With Execution Team Conduct proper design handover to the Execution Manager / Site Engineer. Ensure execution teams receive the latest approved drawings and specifications. Clarify design details and resolve technical queries during execution. Coordinate with execution teams regarding site feasibility. Review design changes arising from actual site conditions. Ensure site execution matches approved designs. Participate in site visits when required for design clarification or quality review. 8. Material & Product Selection Develop and maintain material and finish palettes suitable for different project budgets. Coordinate with procurement and vendors regarding materials, finishes, hardware, lighting, accessories, and other design elements. Ensure selected materials are available and commercially viable. Ensure material specifications are clearly documented. Stay updated on new materials, finishes, hardware, furniture, lighting, and interior design trends. 9. Technical Design & Documentation Ensure the design team prepares accurate: Floor plans Furniture layouts Electrical layouts Ceiling layouts Flooring layouts Wall elevations Furniture details Modular kitchen drawings Wardrobe drawings TV unit drawings Storage details Material specifications Colour and finish schedules Hardware specifications Execution drawings 3D visualisations and presentations Ensure drawings are sufficiently detailed for execution. 10. Design Schedule Management Establish design timelines for each project. Monitor project progress against agreed design milestones. Ensure timely completion of concepts, layouts, 3D views, revisions, working drawings, and final approvals. Identify projects at risk of delay and take corrective action. Coordinate design priorities across multiple projects. Ensure design delays do not impact the overall project execution schedule. 11. Design Process & SOP Development The Design Manager will be responsible for continuously improving the companys design process. This includes: Establishing standard design workflows. Creating design checklists. Standardising drawing and documentation formats. Developing material libraries. Creating reusable design templates. Establishing quality-control checkpoints. Improving coordination between Sales, Design, Procurement, and Execution. Reducing design errors and revision cycles. Improving overall design turnaround time. 12. Budget & Commercial Awareness The Design Manager should ensure that design decisions are aligned with the approved project budget. Responsibilities include: Understanding project budgets and commercial limitations. Selecting materials appropriate to the approved budget. Avoiding unnecessary design elements that increase project cost. Identifying opportunities for value engineering. Coordinating with estimation/procurement teams when design changes affect project cost. Ensuring designs are commercially practical and executable. 13. Design Trend & Market Research Stay updated with current interior design trends. Research new materials, finishes, furniture, hardware, lighting, and technology. Introduce relevant design innovations into the companys offerings. Develop new design concepts and style references. Understand changing customer preferences in the residential interiors market. Help strengthen Vaastukalpaas design identity and market positioning. 14. Project & Team Reporting Maintain and review: Project design status Designer-wise workload Design turnaround time Pending client approvals Revision status Drawing completion status Site/design queries Design errors and rework Project delays Team performance Conduct regular design team meetings and project reviews. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will primarily be measured on: Design delivery within committed timelines Design quality and accuracy Client satisfaction Client approval rate Number of design revisions Reduction in design errors Accuracy of execution drawings Design-to-execution consistency Designer productivity Team performance Project profitability awareness Coordination with Sales and Execution teams Timely project handover to execution Candidate Profile Education Bachelors / Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or related field . Additional qualifications in design management or project management will be an advantage. Experience 5-10 years of experience in residential interior design. Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a team-lead / design-manager / senior designer role preferred. Strong experience in turnkey residential interiors. Experience managing multiple designers and multiple projects simultaneously. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of: AutoCAD SketchUp 3D visualisation software Photoshop / presentation software Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets Interior detailing Modular furniture design Kitchen design Wardrobe design False ceiling design Electrical planning Material and finish selection Furniture and space planning Construction detailing Knowledge of additional rendering and design tools is an advantage. Essential Skills Creative leadership Team management Client handling Design presentation Technical detailing Project management Problem-solving Time management Attention to detail Communication Decision-making Commercial awareness Strong coordination skills Behavioural Expectations The ideal candidate should be: Creative but practical Highly organised Detail-oriented Confident with clients Strong in team management Solution-oriented Accountable Proactive Good at handling pressure Open to feedback Strong in communication Commercially aware Committed to quality and timelines Important Job Requirements Willingness to visit project sites when required. Comfortable attending client meetings and design presentations. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to work closely with Sales and Execution teams. Willingness to work according to project requirements, including weekends when necessary. Strong ownership of design timelines and deliverables. Must be comfortable making design decisions and resolving design-related issues independently. Ideal Candidate The ideal Interior Design Manager at Vaastukalpaa should be more than a creative designer. They should be capable of leading people, managing projects, understanding clients, controlling design quality, and ensuring that every design can actually be executed on site.

title: Lead Engineer -  Design
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Design Engineer to lead the design and development of advanced additive manufacturing machines and mechanical systems. The candidate will be responsible for mechanical design activities from initial concept development through detailed design, validation, and final assembly. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in SolidWorks, a thorough understanding of mechanical design standards and validation processes, and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Mechanical Design & Product Development 
 Lead the complete mechanical design and development of advanced machinery and mechanical systems. Drive the design process from concept development, feasibility studies, 3D modeling, engineering calculations, detailed drawings, prototype development, validation, and final product release. Review and approve mechanical designs, drawings, assemblies, and engineering documentation. Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards such as ISO, ASME, DIN, and relevant industry practices. Establish design approaches, methodologies, and best practices for new machine development. Drive continuous improvement of existing machine designs for performance, reliability, cost, and manufacturability. 
 . Technical Leadership 
 Provide technical direction and mentorship to mechanical design engineers and team members. Review design concepts and provide technical guidance on complex mechanical engineering problems. Establish design standards, drawing practices, tolerance guidelines, and engineering procedures. Support the team in resolving critical design, manufacturing, and assembly challenges. Conduct technical reviews and design evaluations at key project milestones. Build and promote a strong engineering and problem-solving culture within the design team. Component Selection 
 Independently calculate, evaluate, and select critical machine components. Select and size components such as bearings, spindles, ball screws, linear motion guides, motors, actuators, and other machine elements. Ensure selected components meet performance, reliability, and application requirements. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience 15+ years of experience in mechanical design and development. Proven experience in industrial machinery, automation equipment, precision machinery, or capital equipment. Demonstrated experience leading complex machine design and product development projects. Experience in managing and mentoring mechanical design teams. Core Domain Knowledge 
 Strong experience in general machinery or industrial equipment design. Good knowledge of engineering design standards and codes, including ISO, ASME, and DIN. Experience in cutting machines, precision machinery, or automated equipment will be an advantage. Software Skills 
 Expert-level hands-on experience with SolidWorks. Strong capability in complex 3D modeling, assemblies, and 2D drafting/detailing. 
 Engineering Skills 
 Strong understanding of: Engineering mechanics Static analysis FEA DFMEA FMEA Tolerance analysis Machine design principles Component selection and sizing Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in Additive Manufacturing / 3D Printing machine design and development. Experience with precision motion systems, CNC machines, cutting machines, robotics, or automated machinery. Experience in new product development from concept to commercialization. Experience in customer-facing technical roles. Experience working with international customers or engineering teams. Knowledge of industry-specific standards and safety requirements applicable to machinery. Experience in cost optimization, design standardization, and value engineering. Key Competencies Mechanical Design Leadership | Machine Design | Additive Manufacturing | SolidWorks | Precision Machinery | Product Development | FEA | DFMEA | FMEA | GD&T | DFM | DFA | Engineering Standards | Component Selection | Manufacturing | Project Management | Team Leadership | Customer Interaction | Problem Solving | Continuous Improvement

title: Lead UX Designer - UI Lead Designer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced and creative UI Design Lead to join our multidisciplinary Web Experience team and take responsibility for developing, evolving and delivering best-in-class visual and interaction design across our ecosystem of websites. This role is part of our Global Marketing function within the global Customer organization of HERE Technologies. Based in Mumbai, India, you'll become part of an international cross-functional group that strategically and operationally runs our ecosystem of websites, with HERE.com being the main hub for inspiring and educating audiences about our offering, generating buyer demand, and providing a self-serve entry into the HERE platform. You'll work in a team of highly talented, creative professionals who are at the center of web experience for HERE, focusing on technology topics ranging from Automotive to Fleet Management and Supply Chains. Your input will be crucial in shaping and executing high-quality UI across our global rolling annual product roadmap, using your deep expertise in visual design, interaction design, design systems and scalable digital experiences as you liaise closely with UX Design, Content, Product Owners, Development, the HERE Design System team, Product and Revenue Marketing stakeholders, Market Intelligence and partner agencies. We'll count on you to be the go-to expert for UI craft excellence, helping to establish and maintain design standards, reusable components and patterns, and clear definitions of quality to ensure our suite of websites deliver consistent, accessible and compelling user experiences. We'll also expect you to be enthusiastic about being hands-on, using a sprint-based, agile approach, while providing guidance and mentorship to fellow designers without direct line management responsibility. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Be our go-to person for UI design excellence across here.com and our broader website ecosystem, including visual design, interaction design, user flows, UI artifacts, prototypes and final design specifications. Lead the design execution of key website initiatives from discovery through delivery, working closely with UX Design, Content, Product Owner and Development colleagues. Knowledge of SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, Photoshop or other design software will be an advantage. Good understanding of construction materials, interior finishes and architectural detailing. Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural and MEP drawings. Good communication and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability. title: Senior Hardware Designer
description:

description:
FlytBase


Create AI\-native motion graphics, animations, and video content end\-to\-end for social, product, and campaigns, using AI tools, 3D, and editing workflows while building scalable motion systems and templates.


Marketing
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Full\-time
 2
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase builds the world's leading Physical AI drone autonomy platform, powering mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Its customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole and Statnett. Explore some of our key deployments here \- flytbase.com/case\-studies. With a presence in the US and Pune, India, FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


We're looking for a motion graphics designer who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision. You'll also be expected to use AI video and animation tools as part of your everyday workflow to move fast. If you need heavy hand\-holding to get started, this isn't the right fit—but if you're ready to own tasks end\-to\-end and learn on the job by actually doing the job, this is for you.
### **What You'll Own**


• AI\-Native Motion: Use tools like Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Veo 2, and AnimateDiff as part of your daily workflow to generate and refine motion assets. • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish. • Storytelling: Turn product and technical ideas into clear, compelling animated content with minimal briefing. • 3D \& Editing: Animate and composite 3D renders and video edits for live campaigns. • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
### **Best Suited For**


• Working proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent)—comfortable enough to execute independently, not just follow tutorials. • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days. • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own. • Solid grasp of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling fundamentals. • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step. • You've seen every corner of Pinterest and have curated boards for all your visual ideas.
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• AI\-first mindset: You already reach for AI tools to move faster, not just when told to. • Ready to ship: You can take a task from brief to final output without needing it broken down for you. • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting. • High trust, high candor: You give and receive sharp feedback early. • Reliable: You follow through on what you commit to, on time.
### **What We Don't Want**


• Designers looking for a resume line with no real involvement. • People who need step\-by\-step hand\-holding to get started on a task. • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional. • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you're done with roles where junior means low\-impact work, and you're ready to own real deliverables that shape how the world sees drone autonomy—show us what you've shipped and why it worked.

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:

title: Senior Network Solution Designer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Senior Network Solution Designer to join the Access Networks organization. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise and service‑provider‑grade network infrastructures. The role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, network segmentation, L2/L3 services, wireless infrastructure, and architectural design. The candidate must operate effectively both independently and within distributed global teams.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Develop detailed High\-Level and Low\-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for routing, switching, segmentation, Wi‑Fi, and NAC\-enabled environments
* Design scalable enterprise and service provider network architecture
* Evaluate architecture changes, define resiliency requirements, and ensure alignment to Nokia standards.
* Analyze and resolve complex production network issues while ensuring reliable service operation for both Wired and Wireless network services.
* Administer service requests, execute network changes, and manage escalated incidents or priority incidents end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with cross\-technology teams to provide timely updates and coordinate incident resolutions.
* Identify root causes of network incidents and develop preventive actions while adhering to change management processes.
* Design and deploy wireless networks and authentication solutions, ensuring compliance with security best practices.
* Act as a L3 escalation point for L2 team members and mentor junior team members while staying updated on industry trends in network security technologies.
* Drive results and foster a strong customer focus in a dynamic, global team environment to maintain SLA compliance.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You\-Have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent with 12\+ years of experience in network services within complex environments
* Deep knowledge in Network Routing, Switching, design/configuration in Local Area Networks.
* Proficiency in authentication protocols like RADIUS, TACACS, and LDAP
* Proficiency in OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VRRP and MPLS network protocols,VPLS, VPRN and VLL services
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and network technologies and Engineer network resilience, redundancy and optimized traffic flows.


**Nice\-To\-Have**
* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools for network management
* Experience in configuration and management of Clearpass \& NAC
* WLAN knowledge specifically with Aruba Access Points and Controllers
* SROS Nokia Service Router Experience


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
* Health and well\-being support – medical insurance for you and your family, health check\-ups, life and accident insurance, well\-being programs, and employee resource groups
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave based on eligibility
