description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: UX Designer  

Experience: 5 to 8 yrs.  

Job Location: Bangalore  

Position ID: J0926\-0532  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

Role Overview  

We are looking for an experienced UX Designer to create intuitive, user centered experiences for web and mobile applications. The role involves working closely with product, business, technology, and client stakeholders from discovery through design and implementation.  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

. Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, and discovery workshops.  

. Define personas, user journeys, workflows, and information architecture.  

. Create wireframes, prototypes, and interaction designs using Figma / Adobe XD / Sketch.  

. Conduct usability testing and incorporate user feedback into design iterations.  

. Ensure usability, accessibility, consistency, and responsive design.  

. Collaborate with Product Managers, BAs, Developers, UI Designers, and Architects.  

. Present designs and recommendations to stakeholders and clients.  

. Support Agile ceremonies and provide developer handoff specifications.  

  

Required Skills
  

. 5–8 years of UX Design experience for web/mobile applications.  

. Strong experience in UX Research, User Flows, Wireframing, Prototyping, Information Architecture, and Usability Testing.  

. Proficiency in Figma / Adobe XD / Sketch.  

. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.  

. Experience working in Agile environments.  

. Understanding of Design Thinking, Human Centered Design, and WCAG accessibility.  

  

Preferred
  

. Enterprise application / digital platform experience.  

. Familiarity with UI Design Systems and Component Libraries.  

. Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  

  

Mandatory Portfolio:
  

Candidates must provide a portfolio link with 2–3 UX case studies demonstrating the end to end process from research and user flows through wireframes, prototyping, testing, and final design.  

  

Key Deliverables  

Personas \| Journey Maps \| User Flows \| Information Architecture \| Wireframes \| Prototypes \| Usability Reports \| UX Recommendations \| Developer Handoff Assets

title: Senior UX & UI Designer
description:
**Who should Apply:** 




  





 Whether you specialise in UX research, UI design, or design engineering, we encourage you to apply
 



  





**About Tcules:** 




 Tcules is a digital product studio bringing research, design and code into one practice for SaaS product teams. We help teams create new products and evolve established ones for the people who use them.
 



  





 Our Product Design work is grounded in user research and product context. We structure complex information and workflows, shape interactions and interfaces, prototype and test product directions, and build Design Systems that help products remain consistent as they grow. We increasingly use AI\-assisted workflows to explore and design directly in code, while Design Engineering carries product intent into the working frontend.
 



 Founded in 2017, Tcules has worked on more than 90 projects for clients across 19 countries. Our team works together from our studio in Ahmedabad, India.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a senior designer who can take ownership of software product design from the first client conversation through delivery. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can understand product problems, design clear and thoughtful solutions, build scalable design systems, and keep projects moving through strong communication and sound judgement.
 



  





 You will work directly with prospects, clients, designers, developers and product stakeholders. You will be responsible for both the quality of the design work and the successful delivery of the engagement.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 





 Product design
 



* Lead end\-to\-end product design across discovery, research, information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototyping, UI design, testing and implementation support.
* Turn complex business requirements, workflows and data into clear, usable web and mobile product experiences.
* Explain design decisions using user needs, product context and evidence rather than personal preference.
* Work closely with designers and developers to maintain design quality through implementation, release and iteration.
* Use AI\-assisted tools where they improve research, exploration, prototyping or production work, while maintaining quality and responsible judgement.




 Design systems
 



* Architect and evolve scalable design systems across foundations, components, patterns and product\-specific extensions.
* Define a clear token structure, from primitive and semantic tokens to component\-level tokens, using variables, collections, modes and aliases to support themes, brands and responsive contexts.
* Create flexible component APIs with well\-defined variants, properties, states, behaviours and accessibility requirements for web and mobile products.
* Work closely with engineering to maintain parity between design libraries and coded components, including token mapping, naming, versioning, release practices and implementation quality.
* Establish practical governance through documentation, contribution and review processes, adoption guidance, audits and migration plans that help the system remain useful as products grow.




 Client collaboration and delivery
 



* Support pre\-sales conversations by understanding requirements, asking the right questions and contributing to the proposed approach, scope and estimate.
* Lead client communication and keep expectations, decisions, progress and next steps clear throughout the engagement.
* Coordinate with the internal team to deliver the agreed work with the expected quality and timelines.
* Identify risks or changes early and help bring the project to a successful completion.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 3\+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design (Willing to make exception for special talent)
* Strong professional experience designing software products, preferably complex SaaS, enterprise or workflow\-based products.
* A portfolio that shows end\-to\-end product thinking, strong UX and UI craft, clear rationale, systems thinking and meaningful outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining design systems, not only using existing component libraries.
* Strong skills in research, problem definition, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping and visual design.
* A high standard for typography, layout, hierarchy, interaction states, responsive behaviour and accessibility.
* Clear verbal and written communication, including the confidence to lead client calls, ask difficult questions and present recommendations.
* Ability to scope and estimate design work with practical awareness of delivery constraints and dependencies.
* Ability to work independently, make sound decisions and involve others at the right time.
* Comfort working across different industries, product stages and levels of ambiguity.
* Working knowledge of how design decisions translate into frontend implementation.



  





**Who should apply** 




 Apply if you are a hands\-on senior product designer who wants meaningful responsibility across product thinking, design systems, client conversations and project delivery. This role is best suited to someone who enjoys solving complex software problems and can guide both the work and the people involved in it.
 



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Please share your portfolio and a cover letter explaining why you make a great fit for this role. Include case studies that clearly show your role, process, design\-system contribution, important decisions and the outcome of the work.
 



  





 Tcules is an equal opportunity employer. We value different backgrounds and perspectives and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

****About The Company:****
 Cradlewise is a San\-Francisco, Bangalore and Pune based sleep tech company. We build innovative solutions for parents. Our products are designed to take the stress out of parenthood.
   

  

 Our first product \- the award winning Cradlewise smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts to bounce along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep—just like a parent! → See how our smart crib works
   

  

 We are working to reimagine the baby nursery to make it smart, intuitive and delightful. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values, and our culture!
   

  

****About The Cradlewise Design Team****
 Cradlewise Design is a close\-knit team of User\-Experience Designers, Visual Designers and Video editors from all over India. We create experiences to help every family sleep and live better, through science\-driven solutions, and it's the role of the team to humanize and create every touchpoint with empathy and support.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Cradlewise solved sleep for babies. Now we're going after what comes next: a brand\-new software product in the kids category, starting from a blank page. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the design from zero to one: the research, the flows, the visual language, the first shipped version. You'll sit in on parent interviews happening right now, sketch the same week, and watch your work decide what we build. You'll also shape the Cradlewise app and web portal that thousands of families already use daily.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Design a 0\-to\-1 product in the kids category: from discovery and user research through flows, prototypes, and the first release.
* Create a visual language that works for two audiences at once: kids and their parents.
* Design and improve the Cradlewise app and web portal, including our subscriptions experience, funnels, and retention experiments.
* Prototype fast, test with real families, and iterate. Speed matters more than polish at this stage.
* Contribute to our design system for consistency across products.
* Work directly with founders, product, tech, content, and marketing to take designs live.
* Keep designs accessible and grounded in human\-factors principles.


****What You’ll Bring To The Role:****
* 3–5 years of experience in product/UI/UX design.
* A portfolio that can demonstrate your ability to work on modern digital interfaces.
* Craft beautiful experiences that visually present the user interface so information is easy to read, understand and find.
* Thorough understanding of the design process to perform research, build workflows and user journeys, execute design with high quality prototypes and test mock\-ups for feedback.
* Understanding and implementation of best practices including accessibility standards and human factors.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm, willingness to iterate quickly and strong bias for action.
* Passion for design and simplifying complex problems, and a hunger to experiment with new and innovative solutions.
* A humble team player who is a great partner to work with for cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to learn from your mistakes and absorb feedback.
* Great communication skills, product thinking (why’s) and comfort with presenting and discussing designs.
* High proficiency in design tools like Figma and AI tooling to intelligently design creative experiences.
* Ability to learn and use analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and make informed design decisions.


****Academic Qualifications****
* Bachelors or MA/MS degree (or higher) in Design (interaction, graphic or visual communication) or equivalent practical experience.


****What We Offer:****
* A founding\-designer seat on a 0\-to\-1 product: blank canvas, full ownership.
* Direct access to founders and daily collaboration with product and engineering.
* Autonomy to ideate, experiment, and execute, with regular reviews to accelerate your growth.
* A close\-knit, learning\-oriented design team and a hybrid working setup.
* Competitive salary.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 We absorb that complexity so our customers never have to think about it. Which means it lands in our product instead. Our users should never have to feel it.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Design Engineer to help make Dodo Payments one of the best\-crafted products in fintech. You might be a designer who learned to code because handing off Figma was not enough, or an engineer who kept opening Figma because the interface was not good enough. Either way you care deeply about both.
   

  

 You will sit directly between design and engineering, across dashboard, checkout, billing, onboarding, analytics, and new products. You will explore ideas visually, prototype them quickly, and often build the final thing yourself. Sometimes the fastest way to answer a design question is Figma. Sometimes it is 100 lines of code.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and Build: Turn complicated payment concepts into surprisingly simple interfaces, and ship the production UI in React yourself.
* Prototyping: Explore and validate interactions quickly, before we commit engineering time to them.
* Interface Craft: Obsess over typography, hierarchy, density, motion, and state. Use motion and interaction where they genuinely improve understanding, and not where they do not.
* 0 to 1 Product: Design and build new product experiences from scratch, starting from ambiguous problems.
* Systems and Primitives: Create the components and patterns that make the rest of Dodo better, without disappearing into a design system that never ships product.
* Raising the Bar: Improve existing experiences instead of accepting "it works," and push back when something is not good enough.
* Collaboration: Work directly with engineers, product, and founders on product decisions.


 You will have a lot of room to define Dodo's visual and interaction language. We expect you to use it.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, in a role that spanned both.
* Figma: Excellent with Figma as a thinking and prototyping tool, not just a handoff surface.
* Code: Comfortable writing React and TypeScript, and shipping your own work to production.
* Visual Taste: Strong visual judgment, and the ability to explain why something works.
* Interaction and Motion: Care for how interfaces move and respond. Framer Motion, Rive, GSAP, Three.js or similar is useful, but a particular library is not the point. Being able to make the thing in your head real is.
* Speed: You prototype extremely quickly and are comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem.
* Judgment: You know when simplicity takes more work, not less.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, and own how Dodo looks and feels. "Fintech has to look boring" is not an acceptable design constraint here.
* Ownership: You are not decorating finished requirements or producing mockups for someone else to interpret. You design it, you build it, you ship it.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.

title: UX Designer - C3 - CXP
description:
Bengaluru
   

  

 Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company \- a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of:**
* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 As a
 **UX Designer** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **5\-8 YEARS** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


****Role Responsibilities****
 We are looking for a
 **UX Designer with 5–8 years of experience** 
 who can take ownership of the UX process and do the
 **UX heavy lifting** 
 — from understanding customer needs and business objectives to defining problems, shaping experiences, and delivering thoughtful, user\-centric solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not just someone who creates screens. You should be able to
 **understand customers, speak their language, challenge assumptions, simplify complex problems, and translate insights into meaningful experiences.**
****What You’ll Do****
* Lead UX activities across projects, from discovery and problem definition through to final experience design.
* Understand customer needs, behaviours, pain points, motivations, and expectations.
* Conduct and support user research, interviews, workshops, journey mapping, personas, and usability testing.
* Translate customer and business requirements into clear UX strategies and solutions.
* Define information architecture, user flows, journeys, wireframes, and interaction models.
* Create prototypes and validate concepts with users and stakeholders.
* Identify usability issues and continuously improve the experience based on evidence and feedback.
* Work closely with UI designers and development teams to ensure UX intent is carried through to the final product.
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and clients to align user needs with business goals.
* Present and articulate design decisions clearly, using customer and business outcomes rather than design jargon.
* Challenge existing assumptions and propose better, simpler, and more effective solutions.
* Contribute to design systems, UX standards, and reusable patterns where appropriate.


****What We’re Looking For****
**Must Have**
* 5–8 years of professional UX design experience.
* Strong understanding of human\-centred design and UX methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive UX work and take ownership of complex problems.
* Strong ability to understand customer needs and speak the customer's language.
* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into clear UX problems and actionable solutions.
* Strong skills in:
* User journeys
* Information architecture
* User flows
* Wireframing
* Prototyping
* Usability testing
* UX research
* Interaction design
* Strong communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to explain why a design solution is right, not just what was designed.
* Experience working directly with clients, stakeholders, product teams, and developers.
* Strong proficiency in Figma or equivalent UX/design tools.


**The Person We’re Looking For**
 We value
 **problem\-solvers over screen\-makers** 
 .
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who:**
* Starts with the customer problem, not the UI.
* Is comfortable asking “Why?” and challenging the brief when needed.
* Can turn complex business requirements into simple customer experiences.
* Can work with incomplete information and bring structure to ambiguity.
* Is confident conducting conversations with customers and stakeholders.
* Can advocate for users while understanding business realities.
* Uses research, data, and evidence to support design decisions.
* Is comfortable owning the UX process from discovery → definition → design → validation.
* Can balance user needs, business objectives, technology constraints, and feasibility.
* Has strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger experience.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working on large\-scale digital products or enterprise platforms.
* Experience across web, mobile, or native applications.
* Experience in design systems and component\-based design.
* Experience facilitating design thinking workshops or discovery sessions.
* Exposure to accessibility and WCAG principles.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate UX research, ideation, prototyping, or analysis.


****What Success Looks Like****
 Within this role, you will be expected to:
   

  

**Understand → Define → Solve → Validate**
 You should be able to take a customer or business problem, understand it deeply, define the right UX problem, develop meaningful solutions, validate them, and clearly communicate the rationale behind your decisions.
   

  

**Core Attribute**
**We are looking for a UX designer who can do the UX heavy lifting — someone who understands customers deeply, speaks their language, owns the problem, and can turn complexity into simple, meaningful experiences.**
**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

****The Benefits****
 This is a
 **Fulltime** 
 position based in
 **Bangalore** 
 .
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer:**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a
 **Lead Product Designer / UX Pod Lead** 
 to drive end\-to\-end design strategy and execution for core modules of our Cloud HR Tech platform.
 



 In this "Player\-Coach" role, you will be the design anchor for a dedicated product pod. You will manage a small, agile team of 2 to 4 UX/UI designers while remaining fully hands\-on with high\-impact feature design, design systems, and complex product workflows. You will partner directly with Pod Leads, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to build world\-class, enterprise\-grade SaaS experiences across web and mobile.
 



 If you are an experienced Senior/Lead Designer ready to own product strategy, mentor junior talent, and stay deeply connected to pixel\-perfect craft, this role is built for you. This position reports to the Senior Director of UX.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* **Core Workflow Ownership:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-priority HR tech modules (e.g., payroll engines, performance management, workforce analytics, mobile attendance).
* **High\-Fidelity Artifacts:** 
 Produce complete UX artifacts—from user journeys and wireframes to production\-ready Figma mockups, interactive prototypes, and micro\-interactions.
* **Design Systems:** 
 Drive the evolution of our centralized Figma Design System (tokens, auto\-layout, interactive components) and ensure component standardization across all pods.
* **AI\-First Workflows:** 
 Embed modern AI design tools (Figma AI, ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) into the team’s day\-to\-day workflow to maximize design velocity and research automation.
* **People Management:** 
 Manage, guide, and mentor a small team of 2–4 UX/UI designers. Conduct regular 1:1s, design critiques, and performance reviews.
* **Quality \& Governance:** 
 Set high standards for visual design, interaction quality, and design system usage across the team's output.
* **Sprint \& Capacity Planning:** 
 Allocate design resources within the pod, balance workload across sprint cycles, and ensure on\-time delivery of dev\-ready assets.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Establish efficient dev\-handoff workflows, usability testing cadence, and cross\-functional alignment habits with engineering and product.



**LOOKING FOR** 



* **8 to 10 years** 
 of total experience in UX/UI design for enterprise SaaS, B2B cloud applications, or consumer\-scale mobile apps.
* Proven experience (or demonstrated strong readiness) in leading design reviews, mentoring junior designers, or stepping into formal people management.
* Mastery of
 **Figma** 
 (Auto\-Layout, Variables, Component Architecture, Dev Mode, Design System Governance).
* Strong grounding in
 **Design Thinking, Information Architecture, and Product Strategy** 
 .
* Practical experience incorporating
 **AI tools** 
 into design research, copy, and UI generation workflows.
* Strong cross\-functional alignment skills—ability to push back on unrealistic tech constraints and advocate strongly for user experience with PMs and Dev Leads.
* Excellent verbal, visual, and written communication skills.



 Share your
 **Resume** 
 along with a
 **Portfolio link** 
 demonstrating both hands\-on SaaS web/mobile design work and examples of leading/mentoring design projects.

title: Engineer III - UI/UX
description:
We are looking for a UX designer to design software and platforms that meets user needs. We need you to be analytical \& creative in order to design the overall functionality of the product to ensure great user experience.
   

  

 Ultimately, you will make our product more user\-friendly and intuitive to attract and retain customers
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Understand product specifications and user psychology
* Translate concepts into user flows, wireframes, mockups and prototypes that lead to intuitive user experiences
* Conduct concept and usability testing and gather feedback
* Facilitate the stakeholder’s product vision by researching, conceiving, sketching, prototyping and user\-testing experiences for digital products
* Find creative ways to solve UX problems (example: usability, findability)
* Design \& deliver wireframes, user stories, user journeys \& mockups optimized for a wide range of devices and interfaces
* Make strategic design \& user experience decisions related to core \& new functions and features
* Take a user\-centered design approach and rapidly test and iterate designs
* Communicate design ideas and prototypes to developers
* Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends


**Skill Sets/Experience We Require**
* 6\-8 years of UX design experience.
* Expertise in standard UX software such as Figma, Sketch, OmniGraffle, Axure, InVision, UXPin, Balsamiq, Framer, and the like is a must.
* Experience working with clients to understand detailed requirements and design complete user experiences that meet client needs and vision.
* Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile\-first and responsive design.
* Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.
* Experience working in a team setting including synthesizing abstract ideas into concrete design implications.
* Passionate about resolving user pain points


**Pedigree**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or related subject
* Relevant certifications

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are looking for a senior product designer who thinks in problems, not screens, and has rebuilt their workflow around AI to move faster than a traditional design process allows.
 



 Design here doesn't look like it did two years ago. Our designers prototype in code with AI, test ideas as working software instead of static mocks, and go from problem framing to a clickable prototype in hours, not weeks. Figma is still in the toolkit, but it's no longer where most of the thinking happens.
 



  





**How designers work here\-** 
 We've changed how design works here over the last couple of years. Instead of presenting static mocks, we build interactive HTML prototypes with AI and let stakeholders click through real flows, with real states and edge cases. Ideas get tested as working software early, which means we can explore several directions in the time it used to take to polish one. AI is part of every phase of our process: research, ideation, UX writing, prototyping, and design system work. We also invest in our own tooling and reusable workflows so the whole team keeps getting faster. But AI doesn't make the decisions. What ships still comes down to a designer's judgment about the user, the business, and the product.
 



  





**What Will You Do** 




  





 ● Own design problems from framing through shipping. You'll define the problem, explore directions, prototype, test, and work with engineering to get it live, without needing much oversight

description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead and elevate design for Ethos’s Partnerships business and Platform teams.Buying life insurance is one of the most important financial decisions a family can make. The vast majority of families complete this purchase with the facilitation of an agent. For the last hundred years this process was dominated by paper\-heavy, multi\-week purchase flows that made selling and buying life insurance a pain. Today, Ethos is giving them modern digital tooling to transform that. Ethos’s Partnerships Business is our B2B2C channel that gives independent insurance agents and insurance agencies a digital\-first platform, automated underwriting infrastructure, and multiple insurance offerings that help them serve their clients faster and grow their business.
   

  

 As the head of design for Ethos’ Partnership and Platforms you will have a direct opportunity to shape how design helps agents and their customers achieve their goals. You’ll champion intentional, intuitive, and strategic product experiences, compelling storytelling, and measurable business impact — and will help make Ethos the most trusted and user\-friendly life insurance experience in the world for agents and their clients.

title: Head of Design
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**The role**
 HackerRank is hiring a Head of Design to define and own the experience for our platform and lead the organization responsible for delivering it. You will guide both traditional product experiences and emerging AI\-native and agentic experiences, through a team of product designers and design managers.
   

  

 As a member of Product, Engineering, and Design Leadership, you will serve as a strategic leader in the company. This role requires executive range and practitioner instincts. You should be able to move from an organizational question to a product strategy discussion, then into a working prototype or detailed interaction review without losing the thread between them. All of our leaders are builders.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Set experience strategy. Define the design vision for HackerRank’s platform and turn company strategy into a clear experience direction. Connect near\-term product decisions to a coherent view of where technical hiring and developer skills are going. Keep the organization close to customers and developers, using research, product data, prototypes, and direct observation to shape the work.
* Drive AI and agentic fluency. Shape how people interact with AI across the platform, from embedded intelligence to autonomous agents. Establish rigor around AI experience evals, agentic specifications, and emerging interaction practices. Set the expectation that designers experiment with models, agents, and code\-adjacent tools—and model that behavior yourself.
* Be the quality bar. Raise the quality and coherence of HackerRank’s end\-to\-end experience. Guide the information architecture, workflows, interaction patterns, and systems that make the platform feel like one product. Have a clear point of view on what good looks like, make that standard practical, and raise the quality of everything HackerRank ships.Drive strategic partnership. Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership. Shape product strategy, investment priorities, and roadmaps; clarify the problems worth solving; and make the trade\-offs required to balance customer value, technical reality, speed, and long\-term platform quality.Build and lead the team. Lead an organization that includes product designers and design managers. Hire and develop strong leaders, establish clear ownership, raise the quality of critique and decision\-making, and create an environment where designers can move quickly without lowering the bar.


**How You Will Lead**
 We expect you to get close to the work. You see yourself as a maker who can lead others through ambiguity, and you proactively spend time building with models and agents and shipping your work.
   

  

 You do not need to be a production engineer. You do need enough technical curiosity and fluency to prototype alongside engineers, explore ideas with modern AI and coding tools, and understand how model behavior, architecture, latency, cost, data, and evaluation shape the experience.
   

  

 You should be comfortable developing your own perspective on the product and market. You can communicate that perspective clearly to non\-designers and build support for improvements across the experience, from broad product strategy to the smallest interaction details.
   

  

 You have led senior designers and design managers, and you know how to raise the quality of the work without slowing the team down. Build early. Put ideas in front of customers. Learn from real behavior. Refine from evidence.
   

  

**Requirements And Experience We Are Looking For**
* A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong judgment, leadership, and high\-quality execution. Show us what shipped, what changed, and the role you played.
* Significant product design experience, including ownership of complex products or platforms and several years leading designers and design managers.
* A track record of building and developing strong design organizations, including hiring senior talent, coaching managers, clarifying ownership, and improving the overall caliber of the team.
* Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and turn ambiguous opportunities into shipped products.
* Direct experience delivering AI\-powered products, agentic experiences, or other non\-deterministic systems.
* A hands\-on approach. You enjoy getting into the work, making ideas tangible, and helping teams ship stronger results.
* Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools, including demonstrated use of AI, code\-adjacent tools, or working software to explore and communicate ideas. Framer experience is a plus.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank

* We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

title: UX Designer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking a talented UX Designer (Grade 26\) to join the UX Design team for Optum® Crimson AI \- an AI\-enabled clinical analytics and business intelligence platform used by hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Crimson AI integrates directly with a health system's EHR and brings clinical, financial, scheduling and supply chain data together into a single modular platform, layering predictive analytics, AI\-generated recommendations and a conversational AI experience on top of it. Analysis that once required weeks of manual data mining is now delivered in seconds.
   

  

 This is a design role in which data is the product. Our users come to Crimson AI to identify an opportunity, understand what is driving it, and decide what to do next. Your work makes that path short, clear and trustworthy.
   

  

 The role combines user experience design, product thinking, data visualization and AI\-enabled design capabilities to deliver solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science and Business stakeholders, you will contribute to the design and evolution of complex digital products, transforming user insights and business requirements into engaging and effective experiences.
   

  

 We work in short, iterative cycles in each Sprint. Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications \- you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.
   

  

 We are a closely knit team that shares work early, critiques generously and holds a high bar for craft. You will have real ownership of your product areas, direct access to the people who understand the data and the domain, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving these problems together.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, design concepts and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate product vision and functionality
* Apply user\-centered design methodologies to ensure usability, accessibility, and adoption
* Build a thorough working understanding of the product and the business behind it, and ask the incisive early questions that establish the real user problem, the intended business outcome and the measures of success \- then design against those rather than against a feature list
* Translate complex, multi\-source healthcare data into actionable insight. Develop a working understanding of how the underlying data relates \- what drives what, what can meaningfully be compared, and where the caveats sit \- and design the information hierarchy, data presentation and visualizations so that users can see the signal, trust it, and act on it
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis and user discovery activities to inform product and design decisions
* Translate complex business requirements, workflows, and data structures into intuitive and user\-friendly experiences
* Incorporate customer feedback, user research findings and market insights to refine designs and improve product outcomes
* Operate at pace: scope your own design approach, select the right fidelity for the decision at hand, and iterate as the team's understanding of the problem sharpens
* Perform AI\-driven product design and prototyping, and apply AI tooling to accelerate your own exploration and delivery
* Follow and help strengthen the defined UX guidelines, standards, and best practices across teams
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality user experiences
* Participate in usability testing, stakeholder workshops, design reviews, and design\-thinking sessions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment) The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in UX / Product Design, including hands\-on experience designing for data\-rich or analytics\-driven products
* Hands\-on experience with user research, usability testing, stakeholder workshops, and design sprint activities
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG / Section 508\) and inclusive design principles
* Proficiency in Figma and other industry\-standard design and prototyping tools
* Demonstrated product thinking: a track record of understanding product and business requirements quickly, asking the right questions of stakeholders, and producing design solutions that demonstrably serve both user needs and business goals. Portfolio should evidence the reasoning, not only the screens
* Proven ability to work with data hierarchy, data architecture and complex data relationships and to propose best\-in\-class designs for presenting them cdashboards, drill\-downs, comparative and benchmarked views, and insight\-led layouts that lead users to a decision
* Proven ability to work with self\-direction in areas of ambiguity: you can take an early or evolving problem statement, structure it, seek out the information you need, and move it forward without every step being defined for you
* Proven ability to work effectively in a high\-velocity, cross\-functional environment \- responsive to new information, efficient in revision, and pragmatic about sequencing what ships now versus what follows
* Proven ability to communicate product and design intent through demo\-ready prototypes and clear narrative \- work that travels well to customers, executives and internal stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate user needs, business goals and technical constraints into thoughtful design solutions
* Proven solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to product, engineering, data science and business audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of experience building products in the US healthcare analytics domain, with familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare data platforms, interoperability standards or population health analytics
* Experience designing for probabilistic or predictive outputs \- communicating confidence, uncertainty and recommendation provenance so that users know how much to trust what they are seeing
* Experience partnering with Product / Data Science / ML teams and defining success metrics for AI\-driven experiences, including generative AI, predictive analytics, conversational interfaces and intelligent workflows
* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and experience designing complex dashboards, reporting and analytics solutions


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
*\#NJP*

title: Product Designer
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.
   

  

 As a Product Designer, you will partner with Product Managers to turn user problems and desired outcomes into clear user journeys, testable experiences, and practical design direction. You will work closely with Product and Engineering from early problem framing through implementation, using rapid prototypes to clarify decisions, expose gaps, and improve the product experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, early\-career role for a designer who combines strong UX and product thinking with visual judgment and prototyping fluency. The role also owns the quality and continuity of clickable product demos and selected product storytelling.
   

  

**As our Product Designer, you will be required to:**
* Partner with Product Managers to frame user problems, clarify desired outcomes, challenge assumptions, and identify what needs to be learned before a solution is committed.
* Translate problems and outcomes into user journeys, task flows, interaction models, and testable experience concepts.
* Build rapid, AI\-assisted prototypes using Figma, Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable tools, selecting the lightest approach that can answer the question at hand.
* Explore and communicate multiple design approaches, gather feedback, and iterate quickly rather than treating the first proposed screen as the answer.
* Maintain and evolve the persistent clickable product demo so that priority workflows remain current, coherent, visually credible, and easy to present.
* Create and update demo scenarios for Sales and stakeholder conversations when the production product does not yet tell the intended product story clearly.
* Produce clear development reference and handoff material, including annotated flows, states, edge cases, interaction behavior, and required assets.
* Partner with Engineering during implementation to answer experience questions, review working builds, and resolve material gaps between intent and execution.
* Support product storytelling through product screenshots, workflow visuals, short demo recordings, and selected customer\-facing visuals that directly explain the product experience.


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a closely related role. Exceptional candidates with 1\-2 years of strong, relevant work may also be considered.
* A portfolio that shows how you moved from a user problem to journeys, alternatives, prototypes, decisions, and a usable product outcome, not only final visual screens.
* Strong UX and product thinking, including the ability to simplify complex workflows, recognize assumptions, and connect interaction choices to user and business outcomes.
* Prototyping fluency in Figma and comfort using Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable AI\-assisted tools to move quickly from concept to testable experience.
* Strong visual judgment and enough craft to create polished, credible prototypes and demos.
* Clear communication and the confidence to challenge, clarify, and improve Product Manager thinking while remaining collaborative and outcome focused.
* Comfort partnering with Engineering, producing development\-ready references, learning unfamiliar tools quickly, and adapting the level of fidelity to the stage of work.

 Remote
   

  

 As a
 **Creative Director,** 
 you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human\-led.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

 Designity is a premium, AI\-enabled and human\-led Creative\-as\-a\-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director\-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI\-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

 They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Set the creative vision \- Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* Turn business goals into creative opportunities \- Find the human and strategic insight behind the brief. Translate it into focused, emotionally resonant concepts that support the client’s objectives.
* Guide the right creative team \- Help shape and lead multidisciplinary teams based on the needs of the client, brand, and assignment.
* Conduct Quality Control \& Protect the standard \- Review concepts and execution for strategic relevance, originality, craft, brand alignment, and production quality.
* Lead client conversations \- Present and defend creative ideas with confidence. Explain the reasoning behind recommendations and guide stakeholders through productive feedback cycles.
* Develop creative talent \- Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.
* Use AI with intention\- Leverage AI tools to strengthen research, ideation, exploration, and workflow efficiency. Retain human ownership of strategy, accuracy, taste, sensitive decisions, and final approval.
* Build a strong creative environment \- Encourage originality, curiosity, respectful challenge, accountability, and collaboration.


**What You Will Bring**
* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 3 years in creative leadership roles
* A portfolio demonstrating strong work across branding, visual communication, digital experiences, motion, or integrated campaigns, with clear examples of how you have leveraged AI in your creative process and outcomes
* Great attention to detail to catch any branding inconsistencies
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams toward original, strategically grounded creative work
* The ability to translate complex business challenges into clear creative strategies and compelling concepts
* A strong understanding of branding, storytelling, design, and audience\-centered communication with sound creative judgment and the ability to explain what is working, what needs to change, and why
* A business\-minded approach that connects creative decisions to audience and organizational goals with the ability to present ideas clearly, build stakeholder alignment, and guide feedback without losing the strategic intent
* Strong written and verbal English communication for nuanced client conversations, presentations, briefs, and feedback
* The adaptability, judgment, and reliability and strong internet connection needed to work effectively in a remote environment
* Practical experience using AI tools to strengthen creativity or efficiency without compromising quality or human accountability


**How We Work**
 Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

 At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**What This Role Offers**
* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast\-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards


**We Believe Great Teams Are Built On Shared Values**
* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.


**Success In This Role Means**
* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.
* Balancing creativity with reliability, organization, and follow\-through.
* Embracing AI as a tool to enhance creativity and efficiency.


**Disclaimer**
 Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

title: Optics Design Engineer
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking an Optical Design Engineer with strong expertise in optical system design, simulation,tolerancing, and validation. The role involves complete ownership of design activities from requirement capture to system validation and customer engagement.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Initiation \& Requirements** 




 • Understand system and product requirements; extract relevant inputs.
 



 • Define detailed optical specifications with primary engineering calculations.
 



 • Communicate assumptions, deliverables, timelines, and associated risks.
 



 • Anticipate challenges and provide effective risk mitigation strategies.
 



**2\. Optical System Design** 




 • Select suitable starting design configurations.
 



 • Perform detailed optical design using Zemax or equivalent tools.
 



 • Conduct optimization, tolerance analysis, and manufacturing sensitivity studies.
 



 • Generate optical drawings, documentation, and design reports.
 



 • Typical systems include:
 



 o EO/IR cameras, night vision optics
 



 o Spectrometers, laser systems
 



 o IR lenses, telescopes, lens stacks
 



 • Present design solutions to customers and internal stakeholders.
 



**3\. Opto\-Mechanical \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Transfer optical design intent to mechanical teams.
 



 • Support development of mounts, mechanisms, baffles \& housings.
 



 • Understand tolerances and environmental impacts on system performance.
 



 • Basic exposure to detectors (CCD, CMOS, IR), acquisition electronics, and system integration.
 



**4\. Validation \& Testing** 




 • Coordinate lens procurement, vendor interactions, and corrective actions.
 



 • Support fabrication, material selection, alignment, and test activities.• Perform optical validation under laboratory and environmental conditions.
 



**5\. General Engineering Contributions** 




 • Participate in project initiation, feasibility studies, and cost analysis.
 



 • Provide technical inputs for proposals and solution justification.
 



**6\. Communication \& Soft Skills** 




 • Communicate effectively with customers and cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Prepare technical presentations and demonstrate solutions to clients.
 



 • Willingness to travel for trials, studies, and customer discussions.
 



 • Self\-driven, quick learner with strong ownership and enthusiasm for optics.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 • MSc Physics (preferably Semiconductors) / M.Tech (Applied Optics) / MSc Tech (Optics/Photonics)
 



 • 0 – 2 years of hands\-on experience with Zemax or equivalent optical design tools
 



 • Strong experience in optical systems design: EO/IR optics, lens stacks, assemblies/sub\-assemblies
 



 • Basic knowledge on 3D modelling (modules, components, and full devices)
 



 • Ability to generate ISO\-compliant optical design drawings
 



 • Working knowledge of optical manufacturing \& design documentation
 



 • Experience in Opto\-mechanical design and opto\-electronics is an advantage
 



 • Willingness to travel across India and SEA for trials, demonstrations, and customer support.

title: Service Design Intern (Systems Design & Operations Focus)
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad \| (In\-Person Role)  

**Role Type:** 6\-Month Internship (Full\-Time Offer Contingent on Performance)  

**Department:** Systems \& Service Design


**About TRD Studios**


TRD Studios is a new\-age, integrated Management \+ Experience Studio. We specialize in transforming chaotic, fragmented enterprise operations into scalable, high\-margin architectures. As experts in Business Services and Systems Design, we approach organisational bottlenecks by looking beyond the physical machinery to understand the invisible structures governing human behavior.


We firmly believe in Conway’s Law, which posits that organisations will inevitably design systems that mirror their own internal communication structures. Therefore, our interventions go far beyond throwing software at a problem. We engineer human behavior, establish unified command structures, and design pragmatic digital architectures that respect the physical realities of the workspace.


**The Role:** Service Design Intern


We are seeking a highly analytical and curious Service Design Intern with a strong inclination toward Systems Thinking. In this role, you will transcend traditional UX/UI design. You will not just be designing screens; you will be architecting entire operational ecologies.


Working closely with our Lead Service Designers, you will help untangle complex B2B and B2C operations. You will be instrumental in mapping the intersections where customer interactions (Frontstage), internal business processes (Backstage), information architecture, and physical material workflows collide. Your work will directly inform the creation of Minimum Viable Systems (MVS) designed to protect operational flow, eradicate undocumented “shadow queues,” and establish unified command structures for our enterprise clients.


The 6\-Month Journey \& Core Responsibilities (The 5D Framework)


Because systemic change requires observation, iteration, and behavioural embedding, this internship spans a rigorous 6\-month period. Your responsibilities will actively map to our 5D Framework:


**1\. Discover: Deep\-Dive System \& Behavioural Mapping**


* **Operational Ecology Mapping:** Assist in mapping the actual production, material, and information flow of our clients, rather than just documenting their intended organisational charts.
* **Stakeholder \& Power Dynamics:** Utilise frameworks like the Stakeholder Influence Map to identify informal power centres, document how conflicts are resolved, and understand who truly influences priorities on the ground.
* **Value Stream Mapping (VSM):** Track the physical flow of materials and inventory to identify spatial congestion, supply chain visibility gaps, and undocumented routing that traps capital in dead stock.


**2\. Define: Synthesizing Systemic Constraints**


* **Root Cause Analysis:** Help distill chaotic shop\-floor symptoms into defined problem statements grounded in observed behaviour.
* **Friction Point Identification:** Compile lists of operational pain points ranked by their systemic impact on overall throughput, revenue, and scalability.


**3\. Design \& Develop: Architecting Minimum Viable Systems**


* **Service Blueprinting:** Draft comprehensive, end\-to\-end service blueprints that visualize the lines of interaction, lines of visibility, and internal support processes.
* **Operational Rulebooks \& SOPs:** Collaborate in designing simple, algorithmic production Priority Rulebooks, Material Readiness Checklists, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that replace reactive firefighting.
* **Pragmatic Digital Architecture:** Translate designed physical processes into pragmatic digital ERP staging requirements. You will ensure that digital interfaces respect environmental constraints of workers handling heavy machinery who cannot easily navigate complex touchscreens.


**4\. Deliver: Scaling, Piloting, and Measurement**


* **Pilot Observation:** Support the rollout of controlled production pilots. You will observe daily standups, track early operational metrics, and document human failure points during adoption.
* **KPI Tracking:** Assist in defining and measuring operational KPIs that align daily behaviour with strategic goals (e.g., on\-time delivery percentages, work order lead times, and inventory days).


The Mindset \& Qualifications We Are Looking For


* **Systems Thinker:** You possess the ability to zoom out and view a business not as isolated departments, but as a complex, interconnected ecology.
* **Behavioural Empathy:** You understand that operational paralysis is rarely a technology issue; it is a symptom of informal communication, infinite Work\-In\-Progress (WIP) limits, and an absence of unified command.
* **Methodological Rigor:** Familiarity with industry\-standard frameworks such as Service Blueprinting, Value Stream Mapping, RACI matrices, and Minimum Viable Systems (MVS).
* **Analytical Detective:** You are comfortable diving into raw data, conducting stakeholder interviews, and identifying the “invisible structures” that override the intended logic of a business.
* **Design Tool Proficiency:** Competency in tools like Figma, Miro, or similar mapping software to create highly granular, readable system overview maps, process charts, and UI mockups for internal dashboards.


Internship Terms \& Next Steps


* **Duration:** The internship period will be for **6 months**.
* **Career Progression:** We view this internship as an intensive incubator for future leaders. **A full\-time offer will be given based on performance** at the successful conclusion of the 6\-month period.
* **Why TRD?**  

This is not a theoretical internship. You will be exposed to the raw, unfiltered reality of enterprise operations. You will learn how to pragmatically bridge the gap between high\-level business strategy and ground\-level execution, developing a robust portfolio that showcases your ability to engineer real\-world business scale.


**To Apply or Inquire:** Please send your resume, portfolio (showcasing systems thinking, mapping, or service design projects), and a brief introduction to our design team. **Contact us at** \[email protected] **if you have any questions on the role.**

title: TRD Studios Internship Program 2026-27
description:
#### **About TRD Studios**


At **TRD Studios**, we are pioneering a transformative approach to entrepreneurship and innovation. As a dynamic ecosystem builder, TRD Studios operates at the nexus of creativity, technology, and sustainability, empowering startups, enterprises, and aspiring entrepreneurs to bring their bold visions to life.


Our flagship initiative, the **TRD Residential Entrepreneurship Experience (TREE)** program, is designed to foster talent, inspire innovation, and enable transformative growth across diverse sectors, including Fintech, HealthTech, Gaming, MediaTech, Manufacturing, and beyond. Central to our mission is the **ISTAM Framework (Information Structures for Thought and Action in Management)**, a proprietary methodology that combines structured thinking, proactive decision\-making, and action\-oriented learning to drive entrepreneurial success. This framework forms the backbone of our programs, offering participants a strategic roadmap for navigating complex business landscapes.


At TRD Studios, we champion collaboration through partnerships with incubators, accelerators, regulators, and corporates, creating an ecosystem that fuels value creation and sustained growth. With a multidisciplinary, innovation\-driven environment, we are committed to equipping the next generation of entrepreneurs, venture partners, and industry leaders with the tools to reimagine the world and shape the future.  

  

**Work Culture**


At TRD Studios, we foster a **learning\-driven environment** where creativity, collaboration, and curiosity are encouraged. Interns are not just observers but active contributors to our projects. Here’s what you can expect:


* You’ll be paired with a **dedicated mentor** to guide you throughout the internship.
* You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table, and your contributions will be valued and implemented.
* A professional environment where **punctuality**, respect for confidentiality (through an **NDA**), and teamwork are highly prioritized.

We are looking for **multidisciplinary interns** who are eager to learn and contribute in one or more of the following areas:


* **Design** (Product, UX/UI, Industrial Design)
* **Management** (Business Strategy, Operations)
* **Legal Research**
* **Finance** (Financial Modeling, Accounting, Business Analysis)
* **Marketing** (Digital Marketing, Branding, Content Strategy)
* **Supply Chain** (Logistics, Procurement, Distribution)


Whether you’re a designer interested in creating real\-world solutions, a finance expert eager to develop business models, or a legal researcher contributing to the **Generative AI platform** we’re building, there’s a place for you at TRD Studios.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


**General Responsibilities (for all roles):**


* Work on **brand\-specific projects** such as **Go Banjara**, **HumSatva**, **Rooomin**, and others.
* Contribute to **operational strategies** that enhance business efficiency and scalability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to **deliver real\-world solutions**.
* Engage in **problem\-solving**, innovation, and proposing **new strategies** based on the industry you’re working in.


**Role\-Specific Responsibilities:**


**1\. Design (Product, UX/UI, Industrial Design)**:


* Work on the development of product designs for TRD brands.
* Create user\-centric designs that meet client needs and enhance **brand experiences**.
* Participate in the **design process**, from ideation to prototyping, ensuring alignment with TRD Studios’ product strategy.


**2\. Management (Business Strategy, Operations)**:


* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for **operational improvements**.
* Develop **business strategies** for TRD’s brands to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Work closely with project teams to ensure **timely delivery** of solutions, while maintaining operational excellence.


**3\. Legal Research**:


* Conduct **regulatory analysis** and research **compliance laws** relevant to various industries, with a focus on Indian and international standards.
* Assist in structuring legal data for our **Generative AI platform for legal compliance**, ensuring that it is optimized for automation.
* Perform **case law research** and provide insights on legal trends that can be integrated into AI\-driven compliance systems.
* Collaborate with AI teams to ensure legal data is correctly implemented into the platform’s decision\-making algorithms.


**4\. Finance (Financial Modeling, Accounting, Business Analysis)**:


* Develop **financial models** to support business strategy and long\-term planning for TRD Studios’ brands.
* Perform **market analysis** to assist in pricing strategies, revenue forecasting, and investment opportunities.
* Support the finance team in **budget planning**, financial reporting, and analyzing key business metrics.


**5\. Marketing (Digital Marketing, Branding, Content Strategy)**:


* Assist in the development and execution of **marketing strategies** for TRD brands, enhancing their digital presence.
* Work on **brand campaigns** to increase visibility and customer engagement.
* Develop **content strategies** for social media, websites, and promotional materials.


**6\. Supply Chain (Logistics, Procurement, Distribution)**:


* Analyze existing **supply chain processes** and identify areas for optimization, especially within TRD brands like **Go Banjara**.
* Work on procurement and logistics strategies that ensure efficient product delivery and cost\-effectiveness.
* Assist in creating a streamlined **distribution network** for new product launches.

#### **Eligibility Criteria**


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **design, business, law, finance, marketing**, or **supply chain**management.
* Strong **communication skills** and a passion for learning and innovation.
* Ability to work effectively in a **team environment**.

title: Principal UX designer
description:
**About HG**
 HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.
   

  

 Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're seeking a passionate and experienced Principal UX Designer to serve as our Head of UX, owning the user experience design process from concept to delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong advocate for the user, with a track record of creating intuitive, accessible, and engaging digital experiences — and is comfortable operating as a design team of one, balancing hands\-on execution with strategic ownership. You'll be the primary voice for UX across the product organization, translating user needs and business goals into effective design solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end UX design process, from initial research and ideation through wireframing, prototyping, and final implementation.
* Conduct and lead user research and usability testing to deeply understand user behavior, needs, and pain points. Synthesize findings into actionable design insights.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define product strategy, requirements, and features.
* Create and maintain design deliverables such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups using industry\-standard tools.
* Champion user\-centered design principles and best practices across the organization, ensuring design decisions are data\-informed and user\-validated.
* Own and maintain the design system to ensure consistency and scalability across products.
* Manage external design contractors or agencies as needed to supplement capacity.
* Set the design function's standards and processes — critique cadence, research practices, tooling — even as a team of one, so they can scale as the team grows.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in a UX design role, with at least 5 years in a senior or principal capacity.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates expertise in user research, interaction design, and visual design.
* Proven ability to operate as a design team of one — balancing strategic ownership with hands\-on execution, and managing competing stakeholder priorities without a team to delegate to.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Sketch; familiarity with AI\-assisted design/prototyping tools is a plus.
* Proven experience leading user research methodologies (e.g., interviews, surveys, usability tests) and data analysis.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to a variety of audiences, including senior leadership.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment is highly desirable.
* A bachelor's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with GTM Intelligence and data platforms is a strong plus.
* Significant overlap with US business hours is required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving, with the judgment to prioritize independently.
* User\-centered design and design thinking methodologies.
* Information architecture and interaction design.
* Empathy for users and the ability to advocate for their needs.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration, especially in the absence of a design team to lean on.


**What We Offer/Benefits**
 We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.
   

  

 We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description:

 FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  




 The Role
 
 We're looking for a motion graphics designer who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision.  • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish.

 • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
 



  




 Best Suited For

 • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days.
 



 • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own.
