 • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step.

 What Makes You a Flyter

 • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting.

 What We Don't Want

 • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional.
 



 • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
 



  




 Why FlytBase?

 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.

 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.

 The Perks

title: Interior Designer
description:
**1\. ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The Interior Designer is responsible for managing assigned interior design projects from concept development through design documentation and execution coordination. The role combines design excellence, client interaction, team management, documentation, and coordination with site, purchase, vendors, and other internal teams.
 



**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • 
 **Design \& Concept Development:** 
  Develop concepts, space planning, mood boards, material palettes, colour schemes, presentations, and detailed interior drawings.
 



 • Prepare and coordinate furniture layouts, flooring layouts, ceiling plans, electrical and lighting layouts, wall elevations, furniture details, partitions, and execution details.
 



 • Ensure designs are practical, aesthetically strong, budget\-conscious, and execution\-friendly.
 



 • 
 **Client Interaction:** 
  Understand client requirements, present designs professionally, conduct meetings, record feedback, manage expectations, and obtain timely approvals.
 



 • 
 **Team Management:** 
  Allocate tasks to junior designers/interns, review their work, monitor deadlines, provide guidance, and maintain design quality.
 



 • 
 **Internal Coordination:** 
  Coordinate with Principal Designer, Junior Designers, Site Supervisors, Project Manager,Purchase/Procurement, Accounts, vendors, and contractors.
 



 • 
 **Site Coordination:** 
  Conduct site visits, review execution against approved drawings, resolve design queries,identify deviations, and coordinate corrective actions.
 



 • 
 **Material \& Vendor Coordination:** 
  Assist with material selection, samples, specifications, vendor discussions, and verification of materials against approved designs.
 



 • 
 **BOQ \& Cost Coordination:** 
  Assist with quantities and specifications, coordinate with the purchase/project team and propose cost\-effective alternatives where required.
 



 • 
 **Documentation:** 
  Maintain approved drawings, revisions, material selections, client comments, site instructions, and other project records with proper revision control.
 



 • 
 **Project Ownership:** 
  Take ownership of assigned projects from brief → design → client approval → coordination →execution support → handover.
 



**3\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Review project priorities, deadlines, and pending approvals.
 



 • Complete assigned design and drawing work within committed timelines.
 



 • Update the daily task/reporting sheet.
 



 • Follow up with clients and internal teams for pending decisions and approvals.
 



 • Coordinate with junior designers and site teams.
 



 • Resolve design\-related site queries promptly.
 



 • Keep project documentation and drawing revisions updated.
 



 • Report progress, risks, delays, and pending decisions to the reporting manager.
 



 White Lines Design Studio • Job Description • Page 1
 
 • Plan priorities for the following working day.
 




**4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** 




 • Quality and creativity of design output.
 



 • Timely completion of drawings, presentations, and assigned deliverables.
 



 • Client satisfaction and professionalism of communication.
 



 • Accuracy of drawings and reduction of avoidable errors/revisions.
 



 • Timely follow\-up for client approvals and decisions.
 



 • Effective delegation, supervision, and development of junior team members.
 



 • Speed and effectiveness in resolving site/design issues.
 



 • Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.
 



 • Material knowledge, cost awareness, and execution feasibility.
 



 • Overall ownership and coordination of assigned projects.
 



**5\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& KNOWLEDGE** 




 • 
 **Software:** 
  AutoCAD, SketchUp/3D software, Photoshop/Illustrator or equivalent, and MS Office/Google Workspace.
 



 • Good knowledge of furniture detailing, materials, finishes, lighting, ceiling systems, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other interior services.
 



 • Strong client communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Team leadership, time management, problem solving, negotiation, and attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to work under deadlines and coordinate multiple projects/tasks.
 



**6\. AUTHORITY \& ACCOUNTABILITY** 




 • Responsible for the design and coordination of assigned projects within the approved brief and company process.
 



 • Major design changes, additional costs, vendor commitments, and significant timeline commitments must be discussed with and approved by the Principal Designer/Management.
 



 • No drawing should be issued for execution without appropriate internal review, client approval where applicable, and revision control.
 



**7\. IDEAL CANDIDATE** 




 The ideal candidate should think like a designer but work like a project owner. They should be capable of understanding a brief, developing a strong design, presenting it to the client, coordinating the internal team,maintaining documentation, and supporting the site team through successful execution.

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Communication Designer** 
 for a leading design\-led architecture practice.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency** 
 .
   

  

 The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.
   

  

 That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.
   

  

**Why an Architecture Background Helps**
 This is not a typical graphic design role.
   

  

 You will work with:
   

  

  

* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.
   

  

 A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**
 You may be a strong fit if you:
   

  

  

* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**
* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**
* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media

title: User Interface Designer
description:
**About the Role:\-** 




 We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to join our product team and take ownership of designing intuitive, scalable, and user\-friendly experiences across our product. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and other stakeholders to understand user problems, translate requirements into thoughtful experiences, and take designs from concept to implementation. The ideal candidate is someone who can think beyond visual design — someone who understands user journeys, product workflows, information architecture, usability, and business requirements, while also having a strong eye for UI.
 



  





**What You'll Do:\-** 




 • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product requirements, user problems, and business objectives.
 



 • Translate product requirements and user needs into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
 



 • Design intuitive experiences for complex product workflows while keeping them simple for users. • Create and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI patterns to ensure consistency across the product.
 



 • Conduct user research, usability analysis, and competitive benchmarking where required.
 



 • Identify UX gaps and proactively suggest improvements to existing product experiences.
 



 • Collaborate closely with engineering throughout the development cycle to ensure design intent is implemented accurately.
 



 • Review implemented features and provide design feedback before release.
 



 • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, product analytics, and stakeholder inputs.
 



 • Maintain design documentation and ensure design decisions are clearly communicated to the team.
 



 • Balance user needs, technical constraints, and business priorities when making design decisions.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:\-** 




 • 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design, preferably working on SaaS, B2B, or technology products.
 



 • Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.
 



 • Experience designing complex workflows and products rather than only marketing websites or landing pages.
 



 • Strong proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems and reusable components.
 



 • Ability to create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills.
 



 • Good understanding of responsive design and common web application patterns.
 



 • Ability to explain and defend design decisions using user and product context rather than personal preferences.
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment with evolving requirements.
 



 • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 



  





**Good to Have:\-** 




 • Experience designing B2B SaaS / enterprise products.
 



 • Experience working with chatbot, conversational AI, automation, or workflow\-based products.
 



 • Experience with usability testing and user research.
 



 • Familiarity with product analytics and using data to inform design decisions.
 



 • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and frontend development constraints.
 



 • Experience building and maintaining a design system from scratch.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:\-** 




 • Users can complete key product workflows with minimal friction and confusion.
 



 • New features are designed with consistency and scalability in mind.
 



 • Product experiences become simpler and more intuitive over time.
 



 • Engineering teams have clear, implementation\-ready designs.
 



 • Design decisions are grounded in user needs, product objectives, and data.
 



 • The product maintains a consistent and high\-quality visual and interaction language.

 Handbag and Accessories Design
 * Design original handbags across categories such as totes, shoulder bags, crossbody bags, clutches, bucket bags, pouches, wallets and travel accessories.
* Develop fashion accessories such as bag charms, keychains, straps and other complementary products.
* Create detailed hand sketches, digital illustrations and technical flat drawings.
* Develop product shapes, proportions, compartments, closures, handles, straps and functional features.
* Design surface details such as prints, embroideries, beadwork, appliqué, patchwork, crochet, weaving, quilting and trims.
* Create multiple colourways and material combinations for selected designs.
* Balance creativity, functionality, durability, price positioning and commercial appeal.


 Technical Design and Documentation
 * Prepare complete tech packs containing technical drawings, dimensions, construction details, materials, hardware, trims and finishing instructions.
* Create detailed front, back, side, base and interior views of each product.
* Specify handle drops, strap lengths, pocket placements, closure mechanisms, logo placements and hardware measurements.
* Prepare bill of materials and product\-development sheets.
* Provide clear artwork, Pantone references, embroidery layouts and placement instructions.
* Maintain accurate records of designs, colourways, materials, samples, approvals and revisions.
* Update collection line sheets and product\-development trackers regularly.


 Materials, Trims and Hardware
 * Research and source suitable fabrics, leathers, vegan alternatives, canvas, raffia, jute, woven materials, linings and other materials.
* Develop and select hardware such as buckles, zippers, hooks, rings, chains, magnetic closures, feet and logo plates.
* Source trims, tapes, cords, fringes, tassels and embellishment materials.
* Ensure that selected materials meet the required standards for quality, durability, functionality and cost.
* Coordinate with vendors to develop customised materials, hardware and trims where required.
* Maintain an organised material, trim and hardware library.


 Print, Embroidery and Surface Development
 * Develop original prints, placement artworks and surface\-design concepts for handbags and accessories.
* Create or coordinate embroidery, beadwork, appliqué and other handcrafted embellishment layouts.
* Prepare accurate colour references, motif sizes and placement specifications.
* Review strike\-offs, embroidery swatches, beading samples and material trials.
* Provide clear correction comments and ensure that approved surface details are accurately reproduced.


 Sampling and Product Development
 * Coordinate with pattern makers, sample makers, merchandisers and vendors to develop prototypes and samples.
* Review handbag patterns, proportions, construction, functionality and finishing.
* Evaluate sample size, weight, opening, storage capacity, strap comfort and overall usability.
* Check stitching, lining, reinforcement, edge finishing, closures and hardware quality.
* Compare samples with approved sketches, tech packs, materials and reference images.
* Conduct sample\-review meetings and provide detailed correction comments.
* Follow every style through prototype, revised sample, pre\-production sample and final approval.
* Ensure that all corrections are implemented before production.


 Collection Planning and Coordination
 * Work with the Chief of Design to prepare seasonal range plans and development calendars.
* Plan a balanced assortment across categories, sizes, shapes, materials, colours and price points.
* Coordinate handbag and accessory collections with Mexicola’s apparel collections.
* Manage multiple products and development timelines simultaneously.
* Coordinate with merchandising, sourcing, production, quality and marketing teams.
* Follow up proactively on materials, artworks, samples, costing and approvals.
* Identify and communicate potential delays or quality concerns at an early stage.


 Costing and Commercial Awareness
 * Design products according to the brand’s target price points and customer profile.
* Work with merchandising and production teams to review product costing.
* Suggest suitable materials or construction modifications when required to meet cost targets.
* Make value\-engineering recommendations without compromising the overall design language or perceived quality.
* Understand minimum order quantities, material consumption and production feasibility.
* Use sales feedback and product performance to improve future collections.


 Production and Quality Support
 * Ensure that bulk production follows approved samples and technical specifications.
* Review production samples and flag deviations in construction, colour, materials, hardware or embellishments.
* Work with production and quality teams to resolve design\-related issues.
* Ensure consistency in product dimensions, workmanship, finishing and functionality.
* Maintain Mexicola’s quality standards throughout the production process.


 Shoot and Launch Support
 * Assist with product selection and styling for campaign, catalogue and e\-commerce shoots.
* Prepare product details, styling references and collection notes for the content team.
* Ensure that samples required for shoots, presentations and launches are complete and approved.
* Support the development of lookbooks, line sheets, product presentations and launch materials.
* Collaborate with the apparel and marketing teams to present a cohesive brand story.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Accessory Design, Fashion Design, Leather Goods Design, Lifestyle Product Design or a related field.
* 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in handbags and accessories.
* Experience working with a fashion, lifestyle, export or design\-led brand is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of handbag construction, materials, trims, hardware and manufacturing processes.
* Experience creating detailed tech packs and coordinating with sampling teams.
* Understanding of embroidery, beadwork, print and handcrafted surface\-development techniques.
* Familiarity with both textile\-based and structured handbags will be an advantage.


 Technical Skills
 * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
* Strong sketching and technical flat\-drawing skills.
* Ability to create accurate handbag specifications and construction details.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with 3D product\-design software or Procreate will be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare print\-ready artworks and professional presentation boards.


 Key Competencies
 * Strong creative and visual sensibility.
* Excellent understanding of colour, materials, proportions and detailing.
* Strong knowledge of handbag functionality and construction.
* Ability to understand and maintain Mexicola’s design identity.
* High attention to detail and quality.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of product costing.
* Good organisation and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple styles and deadlines.
* Clear communication and coordination skills.
* Proactive, responsible and solution\-oriented approach.
* Willingness to take complete ownership of products from concept to production.


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is passionate about handbags, accessories, travel, colour and artisanal craftsmanship. They should have a strong eye for design as well as the technical knowledge required to convert creative concepts into functional, production\-ready products.
 



 We are looking for someone who can introduce fresh ideas while understanding commercial requirements, manufacturing feasibility and customer needs. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with the Chief of Design, taking feedback positively and independently managing each product through the complete development process.
 


 Application Requirements
 
 Interested candidates should submit:
 


* Updated résumé
* Handbag and accessories design portfolio
* Examples of technical drawings or tech packs
* Current and expected salary
* Notice period
* Current location



**Please note:** 
 Applications without a relevant handbag or accessories design portfolio may not be considered.

 Mexicola

 About Mexicola
 
 Mexicola is a contemporary fashion and lifestyle brand inspired by tropical destinations, artisanal craftsmanship and effortless resort living. Our aesthetic combines vibrant prints, relaxed silhouettes, handcrafted details and modern bohemian luxury. We are looking for a talented Apparel Designer who can translate this distinctive vision into original, commercially relevant collections.

 The candidate should have a strong understanding of women’s resortwear, prints, fabrics, garment construction, fit and surface techniques. The role requires creativity, technical knowledge, commercial awareness and the ability to manage multiple styles and development timelines simultaneously.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesTrend Research and Concept Development
 * Research Indian and international fashion, resortwear, colour, fabric, print and silhouette trends.
* Study competitor brands, customer preferences and emerging market opportunities.
* Develop seasonal concepts, mood boards, colour palettes, print directions and collection stories.
* Translate the Chief of Design’s creative vision into cohesive and commercially viable collections.

 Apparel Design
 * Design original apparel across categories such as dresses, kaftans, co\-ord sets, tops, shirts, skirts, trousers, jumpsuits and occasion\-resortwear.
* Create detailed hand sketches and digital fashion illustrations.
* Develop silhouettes, colourways, prints, embroideries, embellishments and placement artworks.
* Design collections that balance creativity, wearability, price positioning and commercial potential.
* Adapt designs for different seasons, occasions and customer requirements.

 Print and Surface Development
 * Develop original print concepts, placement artworks and seamless repeat patterns.
* Coordinate with graphic and textile designers for print development and colour separations.
* Explore embroidery, beadwork, appliqué, lace, crochet, trims and other handcrafted surface techniques.
* Prepare accurate artwork, Pantone references, print sizes and placement instructions.
* Review strike\-offs, embroidery swatches and surface\-development samples and provide corrections.


 Technical Design and Documentation
 * Prepare complete tech packs containing flat sketches, measurements, construction details, fabric information, trims and finishing requirements.
* Create specification sheets, bill of materials and design\-development sheets.
* Communicate garment\-construction details clearly to pattern makers, sampling teams and vendors.
* Maintain accurate records of styles, colourways, fabrics, artworks, approvals and revisions.
* Update range plans, line sheets and collection\-development trackers regularly.


 Fabric and Trim Development
 * Research and source suitable fabrics, linings, trims, buttons, laces and other materials.
* Work closely with the sourcing and merchandising teams to select materials that meet design, quality, cost and delivery requirements.
* Develop new fabrics, prints, washes and textures with mills and vendors where required.
* Ensure that selected fabrics are suitable for the garment’s silhouette, drape, fit and intended use.


 Sampling and Fit
 * Coordinate with pattern masters, tailors and sampling teams to develop prototypes and samples.
* Conduct regular fittings and evaluate garment fit, proportion, construction, comfort and finishing.
* Provide clear sample comments and ensure that required corrections are implemented.
* Compare samples with approved sketches, prints and specifications to maintain design accuracy.
* Follow styles through all stages, including first sample, fit sample, size set, pre\-production sample and final approval.
* Resolve design and construction issues during sampling and production.


 Collection Planning and Coordination
 * Work with the Chief of Design to create seasonal range plans and collection calendars.
* Plan an appropriate balance of categories, silhouettes, prints, colours and price points.
* Manage multiple designs and development deadlines simultaneously.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, merchandisers, sourcing teams, production teams and external vendors.
* Follow up proactively on fabrics, artworks, samples, approvals and production requirements.
* Highlight delays or quality concerns before they affect the collection launch.


 Production and Quality Support
 * Ensure that final production matches approved designs, colours, fabrics, prints and samples.
* Support the production and quality teams in resolving design\-related issues.
* Review initial production pieces and flag any deviations from the approved specifications.
* Ensure consistency in sizing, fit, finishing and overall product quality.
* Suggest design modifications when necessary without compromising the original concept.


 Shoots and Brand Presentation
 * Assist with styling and product selection for campaign, catalogue and e\-commerce shoots.
* Prepare garment details, styling references and collection notes for the content team.
* Support the development of lookbooks, line sheets, product presentations and launch materials.
* Collaborate with marketing and e\-commerce teams to communicate each collection’s design story accurately.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Fashion Design, Apparel Design or a related field.
* 2–3 years of professional experience in apparel design.
* Experience in women’s contemporary fashion, resortwear, occasionwear or a design\-led fashion brand is preferred.
* Strong understanding of fabrics, garment construction, pattern making, fit and production processes.
* Experience creating detailed tech packs and coordinating with sampling teams.
* Knowledge of prints, embroidery, embellishment and surface\-development techniques.


 Technical Skills
 * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
* Strong fashion illustration and technical flat\-sketching skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with CLO 3D, Procreate or other design software will be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare print\-ready artworks and professional presentation boards.


 Key Competencies
 * Strong creative and visual sensibility.
* Understanding of the Mexicola aesthetic and target customer.
* Excellent colour, print and silhouette sense.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of product pricing.
* Good time\-management and organisational skills.
* Ability to handle multiple styles and deadlines.
* Clear communication and effective coordination.
* Proactive, responsible and solution\-oriented approach.
* Willingness to take ownership of designs from concept to final production.


 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is passionate about fashion, travel, colour, prints and artisanal craftsmanship. They should be able to understand Mexicola’s creative direction and translate it into distinctive, wearable and commercially successful products.
 



 We are looking for someone who is both creatively strong and technically capable—an individual who can propose fresh ideas, prepare accurate design documentation, work closely with the sampling team and take responsibility for each style throughout the development process.

* Updated résumé
* Apparel design portfolio
* Examples of tech packs or technical drawings
* Current and expected salary

* Current location

title: Interior Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Tvasttr Architects is a modern architecture and interior design firm based in Ahmedabad, led by founders who bring a contemporary, design\-forward approach to every project. The studio focuses on creating functional, aesthetically refined spaces that reflect the needs and preferences of clients. Tvasttr Architects works across residential, commercial, and experiential environments, blending architectural principles with thoughtful interior detailing. Team members collaborate closely to deliver cohesive design solutions from concept through completion, offering opportunities for creative growth and hands\-on project involvement.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Interior Designer will work full time on\-site at our Ahmedabad studio, collaborating with architects and design team members to develop interior concepts and detailed design solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating space plans, mood boards, and material palettes; preparing drawings, layouts, and presentations; and coordinating FF\&E selections such as furniture, fixtures, and equipment. The role involves working with project teams to refine designs based on client feedback, assisting with construction drawings and documentation, and supporting site visits to ensure design intent is executed. The Interior Designer will also liaise with vendors and contractors, maintain project timelines, and contribute to a cohesive, modern design language across all projects.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Interior Design and Architecture skills, with the ability to integrate interior concepts with overall spatial design.
* Candidates should possess Space Planning skills, including layout optimization and functional zoning of residential and commercial spaces.
* Candidates should possess Construction Drawings skills, including the ability to prepare detailed plans, sections, and elevations for execution.
* Candidates should possess FF\&E skills, including selection, specification, and coordination of furniture, fixtures, and equipment.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software (such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar) and presentation tools.
* Strong visual communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to translate concepts into clear documentation.
* Ability to collaborate in a studio environment, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
* Diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field; prior studio or site experience is preferred.

Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.  KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market. KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies. KONE IT is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation areat the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part ofKONE’s success. IT professionals - KONE Corporation Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Product Designer, Business Intelligence (BI) to join our Business Intelligence team in Chennai (preferred)/Pune .   This role focuses on designing, conceptualizing, and enhancing BI products that enable data-driven decision-making across KONE. The BI Product Designer collaborates closely with product owners, users, architects, and developers to ensure BI solutions are intuitive, scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards. S/he actively collaborates with stakeholders inside and outside KONE IT to ensure that BI solutions deliver tangible value, meet data governance requirements, and align with KONE’s cybersecurity and architecture standards. In addition to product design responsibilities, this role may also include hands-on development tasks in Fabric & Power BI. By combining design thinking, data modelling, and iterative solution development, the BI Product Designer ensures BI products evolve according to the product vision and roadmap while enabling informed, data-driven decision-making across KONE. Main responsibilities  BI Product Design & User Collaboration   Analyze business and user needs, translating them into BI product concepts, functional specifications, and backlog items.  Work with product owners, process owners, and key users to define requirements and acceptance criteria.  Take ownership of the design and conceptualization of BI dashboards, data models, and analytical product Design fitforpurpose and fitforuse BI solutions that consider both functional (analytics, usability, accessibility) and nonfunctional (security, performance, scalability) requirements. Participate in user demos, gather feedback, and incorporate insights into design improvements.  Ensure usability, accessibility, and visual consistency of BI dashboards and models.  BI Solution Development & Optimization Design APPs, Reports & semantic models involving very large datasets, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and maintainability. Create & maintain high quality technical design documents, including data models, logic descriptions, and architectural diagrams in Confluence & Sharepoint.   Provide clarifications and support to developers, data engineers, and testers during implementation, verification, and validation Identify data-quality issues early in the pipeline and escalate appropriately. Troubleshoot issues related to BI data sources, model performance, and platform connectivity.  Monitor & Optimize BI solutions for performance, scalability, and security.  IT Product Operations Support Operations teams in managing major incidents and other critical issues related to BI product operations. Enforce governance policies , data quality practices, and architectural standards for BI solutions Collaboration & Ways of Working Actively support the Product Owner in backlog prioritization and maintaining the BI product roadmap Work directly with the BI Product Owner, Lead developer, Data engineer  and business stakeholders to clarify requirements before development begins. Actively participate in Scrum or Kanban workflows, ensuring work items are properly captured, documented, and updated in Jira. Communicate proactively—raising blockers, risks, and design concerns early. Contribute to iterative delivery, focusing on incremental value rather than large one-off deliveries. Requirements for the role Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and morden data architectural principles. Strong grasp of UX principles in BI design and delivery. Hands on experience with Microsoft Power BI, Fabric , DBT and Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., GitHub). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Proficiency in scripting languages such as SQL, DAX, Python and Power Query. Actively exploring and applying AI-assisted capabilities to improve productivity in BI solution development and delivery. Working in virtual matrix team with outstanding emotional intelligence skills, able to motivate team, remove the impediment, build excellent collaboration and psychological safe environment, champion for teamwork  Preferred Certifications: PL-300: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, DP-600: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, DP-605: Develop Reports with Power BI At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life. Read more on https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html

title: Sr Design Manager, PDS Projects
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced Interior Design Manager with over 15 years of professional experience in design and project delivery, including a minimum of 5 years in a Design Manager role. The candidate will be responsible for leading the design process, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and local regulations, and coordinating effectively with clients, consultants, and contractors throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership capabilities, extensive experience in interior fit-out and construction projects, and a proven track record in managing design implementation from concept through execution. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Design Management 
 Lead and manage the complete design process from concept development to construction documentation and execution. Ensure timely delivery of design milestones while maintaining quality and project objectives. Establish and implement design management procedures, standards, and best practices. Review and approve design drawings, specifications, material selections, and technical submissions. Drive design coordination across all disciplines to achieve seamless project delivery. 
 
 Regulatory Compliance Management 
 Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements, local authority regulations, building codes, fire and life safety requirements, accessibility standards, and relevant industry guidelines. Coordinate with regulatory authorities and facilitate approvals as required. Review designs for compliance with applicable local norms and project-specific requirements. 
 
 Client Stakeholder Coordination 
 Act as the primary design interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams. Lead design review meetings and provide technical guidance to stakeholders. Understand client requirements and translate them into effective design solutions. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve design-related issues proactively. 
 
 Consultant Contractor Management 
 Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, structural consultants, contractors, and specialist vendors. Review consultant deliverables and ensure alignment with project objectives. Monitor contractor compliance with approved design intent during project execution. Resolve technical and coordination issues arising during construction. 
 
 Design Implementation Project Support 
 Ensure accurate implementation of approved designs at site. Conduct periodic site inspections and design audits. Review RFIs, material submittals, shop drawings, and mock-ups. Support value engineering initiatives while maintaining design quality and functionality. Monitor project progress and provide recommendations to mitigate design-related risks. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelors Degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering (Architecture preferred). Minimum 10 years of overall experience in architecture, interior fit-out, design management, or construction projects. Minimum 5 years of experience in a Design Manager role leading multidisciplinary projects. Strong understanding of interior design, architectural detailing, construction practices, and project delivery processes. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale commercial, corporate, workplace, hospitality, or mixed-use projects. 
 
 Key Skills Competencies 
 Strong Design Process Implementation and Management Knowledge of Statutory Approvals and Local Building Regulations Client Relationship Management Consultant and Contractor Coordination Design Review and Quality Assurance Project Planning and Execution Space Planning and Interior Fit-Out Expertise Leadership and Team Management Value Engineering and Cost Optimization 
 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Experience in corporate workplace and large-scale interior fit-out projects. Strong understanding of BIM, AutoCAD, Revit, and project coordination platforms. Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong commercial awareness and stakeholder management skills. 
 
 Role Objective 
 To drive design excellence, ensure compliance with statutory and local regulations, manage stakeholder coordination, and successfully implement design processes that support timely and high-quality project delivery. 
 
 Location 
 On-site - Bengaluru, KA

The ideal candidate will have a strong architectural foundation, hands-on experience in apartment or villa design, and the ability to manage multiple consultants and stakeholders seamlessly. This is a work-from-office role based in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with visits to project sites in North Bangalore. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design Coordination & Reviews Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary design teams to ensure seamless integration across architecture, structure, services, and landscape. Drive regular design review meetings to evaluate progress, address design challenges, and uphold quality standards. Maintain oversight of design deliverables, ensuring all submissions meet project requirements and align with design intent. Facilitate collaboration among consultants to resolve cross-disciplinary issues and maintain design coherence. Ensure that all design outputs adhere to project timelines, technical accuracy, and brand design principles. 
 GFC & Documentation Management Oversee the preparation, review, and release of Good for Construction (GFC) drawings and related documentation. Ensure documentation accuracy, consistency, and version control across all design stages. Collaborate closely with site and project teams to ensure timely availability of approved design documents. Conduct periodic audits and reviews to confirm design implementation aligns with approved drawings. Establish structured processes for document management, ensuring traceability and easy access to current information. 
 Site Support & Query Management Serve as the primary interface between design and execution teams, ensuring design intent is maintained on-site. Manage and coordinate consultant responses to site queries, RFIs, and design change requests. Conduct site visits at key project milestones to assess design adherence and quality of execution. Provide proactive solutions to design-related challenges encountered during construction. Promote clear communication between the site, consultants, and internal stakeholders for efficient issue resolution. 
 Regulatory Compliance & Approvals Coordinate the submission and follow-up of design documents for all statutory approvals and NOCs. Ensure that design documentation complies with all regulatory, sustainability, and project-specific requirements. Maintain accurate records of approvals, revisions, and correspondence for audit and reference. Oversee the preparation and submission of as-built drawings post-completion in alignment with project closeout processes. Foster compliance awareness among design teams and consultants through consistent communication and guidance. 
 Reporting & Risk Management Provide regular updates to leadership on design progress, coordination status, and potential risks. Identify design-related risks early and work collaboratively with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies. Maintain transparent reporting systems to track consultant performance, design deliverables, and issue closures. Facilitate post-project design reviews to capture learnings and strengthen future design management processes. Promote a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement within the design management function. 
 Experience & Background 10-12+ years of experience in Architecture, with a strong focus on apartment projects and individual homes/villas. Prior experience in a builder or developer organization in a similar design management capacity is an added advantage.

 Technical Proficiency Thorough knowledge of local by-laws, enabling effective coordination with architects and consultants. Proficiency in MS Office Suite and MS Project for project management. title: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
Job Summary 
 Role: Lead Product Designer. Experience: 6+ years. Location: Navi Mumbai. Work Mode: On-site. Employment Type: Full-time. Were looking for a Lead Product Designer who can stay hands-on while raising how design works across the team. Youll own product and UX/UI direction on complex, multi-platform projects end to end, from problem framing through polished delivery, while reviewing and mentoring other designers so the whole team ships faster and with more confidence. Youll also own a piece of our design infrastructure, whether thats the design system, documentation standards, or critique culture, and youll be the person clients and internal stakeholders trust to explain the "why" behind a decision. AI sits inside how you work day to day: youll use it to accelerate research, critique, and design operations, and youll help other designers do the same without cutting corners on quality. 
 
 What You Will Own 
 Lead product and UX/UI work from problem framing through delivery on complex projects, translating user, business, and client needs into flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces across web and mobile. Review, mentor, and unblock other designers, running critiques that raise team quality, confidence, and speed rather than just catching errors. Own or improve a system-level asset, such as the design system, documentation, QA standards, file hygiene, or a recurring design ritual, and be accountable for it getting measurably better. Use feedback, research inputs, and usability thinking to pressure-test design decisions before they ship. Present work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and a strong rationale, including when the recommendation is unpopular. Run first-pass research synthesis and heuristic audits with AI, then validate the output against real transcripts and sessions before it shapes a design decision. Use AI to accelerate documentation and critique prep, drafting design-system notes, rationale write-ups, and review agendas so more of the teams time goes to the actual design conversation. Balance multiple live projects and designers questions without becoming the bottleneck for either. 
 
 How AI Shows Up in This Role 
 Synthesizing first-pass themes from user research transcripts and support tickets before validating them against the raw sessions. Running a first-pass heuristic or UX audit on a flow, then using it as a starting point for your own review, not a substitute for it. Generating rapid wireframe and flow variants to explore a problem space before committing a direction to high fidelity. Drafting design-system documentation, component rationale, and handoff notes so engineering gets clearer specs faster. Building critique prompts and review checklists that other designers can reuse, turning a one-off AI trick into a team habit. 
 
 What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days 
 You independently own design direction on live projects without needing constant rescue. Other designers are visibly using your feedback, structure, or standards to work faster and with more confidence. One part of the design system, documentation, or QA workflow is noticeably stronger because of a contribution you made. Your design files, handoff clarity, and documentation make collaboration smoother across design, product, and engineering. Clients and stakeholders trust your communication and the rationale behind your calls. Youve demonstrated at least one repeatable AI-assisted workflow that improves speed without reducing design quality, and can show a teammate how to run it. 
 
 Who You Are 
 Youd rather fix the root cause than patch the symptom. You give feedback people can actually act on. You stay calm and clear when a client pushes back. You notice when a process is quietly wasting everyones time. 
 
 Requirements 
 What You Bring: 6+ years of relevant UX/UI or product design experience. Direct experience reviewing or mentoring other designers. Experience with client-facing or stakeholder-facing work. Strong UX depth across flows, wireframes, prototyping, interface design, and handoff. Evidence of design-system ownership, scalable component thinking, or process improvement. Experience designing complex digital products across web and/or mobile platforms. A strong portfolio with at least two detailed case studies relevant to complex digital products. Advanced Figma capability, including components, auto layout, design systems, prototyping, and clean file structure. You design AI-assisted workflows for your own craft, know where the tools break down, and raise the bar for how the team uses them. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, BFSI, or multi-role products. Motion or prototyping depth. Experience designing or documenting an AI-assisted workflow that other designers adopted, not just used yourself. Experience contributing to team rituals, critique culture, or quality review systems. 
 
 Education 
 Education: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Relevant work experience and practical capability will be valued more than academic specialisation. 
 
 Interview Process 
 Application and candidate assessment Recruiter qualification call One-way video interview L1 live task interview (30 minutes) L2 hiring-manager interview L3 founder / leadership round

title: Landscape Designer
description:
About Pravaa
 



**Pravaa is a design\-led plantscaping studio based in Mumbai, creating living environments for homes, workplaces and hospitality.** 




 We use nature as a design medium, combining
 **plantscaping, biophilic design and plant science** 
 to create spaces that look considered, feel alive and function better.
 



 We don't start with plants. We start with
 **people, space and purpose** 
 — understanding how a space is used, its light, airflow, interiors and everyday rhythm before deciding what belongs where.
 



 From indoor plantscaping and terraces to vertical gardens, moss installations and ongoing care, Pravaa designs, installs and maintains environments that are made to thrive.
 



 About the Role
 



**We're looking for a designer who sits at the intersection of landscape design, interiors and plantscaping.** 




 The
 **Landscape Designer — Indoor \& Small Spaces** 
 will be responsible for translating spaces into thoughtfully designed plantscapes — understanding the architecture and interiors of a space, determining what greenery belongs where, and developing the design through to execution.
 



 This is
 **not a conventional large\-scale landscaping role.** 




 We work extensively with
 **homes, balconies, terraces, foyers, living spaces, offices, lobbies and other compact urban environments** 
 , where every plant, planter and placement needs to be intentional.
 



 You will work across the design process — from
 **site visits and spatial analysis to planting plans, concepts, BOQs and on\-site execution** 
 — while collaborating with Pravaa's wider design, horticulture and installation teams.
 



 What You'll Do
 



**01 — Understand the Space** 



* Visit sites and understand the architecture, interiors, dimensions and existing conditions
* Study
 **natural light, airflow, orientation, movement and usage**
* Understand the client's lifestyle, requirements and how they want the space to feel
* Identify opportunities where greenery can improve the space rather than simply fill it



**02 — Design the Plantscape** 



* Develop planting layouts for
 **indoor and small\-space environments**
* Decide what goes where based on
 **scale, proportion, composition, light and spatial function**
* Develop planting plans and detailed layouts
* Select appropriate plant forms, heights, densities and groupings
* Design the relationship between
 **plants, pots, planters, stands and the surrounding interiors**
* Create cohesive compositions rather than isolated plant placements



**03 — Develop the Design** 



* Prepare
 **2D layouts, technical drawings and 3D visualisations**
* Develop concepts, moodboards and presentations where required
* Prepare BOQs and material specifications
* Work with interior designers and architects to ensure the plantscape complements the larger design language
* Translate design intent into something that is aesthetically strong
 **and practically executable**



**04 — Take It to Site** 



* Coordinate with vendors, nurseries, fabricators and installation teams
* Participate in installation and site execution
* Ensure plant placement, planter positioning, proportions and detailing are executed as designed
* Identify and solve practical site challenges
* Document final placements and relevant design information for ongoing maintenance



**05 — Keep Learning** 



* Research new planting styles, materials, planters and design approaches
* Explore new ways of integrating nature into interiors
* Build an understanding of plant behaviour and indoor growing conditions
* Stay curious about
 **biophilic design, interiors, architecture and plantscaping**



 What We're Looking For
 



 We're looking for someone with
 **very good taste, strong spatial understanding and genuine curiosity about plants.** 




 Someone who:
 


* Has a strong instinct for
 **proportion, scale, balance and composition**
* Can look at a space and understand what is missing — and what should
 *not* 
 be added
* Has a good understanding of interiors and how different materials, colours and forms work together
* Is genuinely interested in plants and wants to understand
 **why a particular plant works in a particular space**
* Understands that good plantscaping is not just about choosing beautiful plants — it is about choosing the
 **right plant for the right environment**
* Pays attention to the details — from the height of a plant to the finish of a planter
* Can think creatively while remaining practical about
 **light, maintenance, access and plant survivability**
* Is comfortable working between
 **design software, site visits, nurseries and live installations**
* Can communicate ideas clearly and work closely with designers, horticulturists, vendors and clients
* Is curious, observant and willing to continuously learn
* Has a high standard for
 **finish and presentation**



 Most importantly, you should enjoy the process of
 **figuring things out** 
 .
 



 You don't need to know every plant or every material. But you should be the kind of person who sees something unfamiliar and wants to know more.
 



 Qualifications
 


* Degree / diploma in
 **Landscape Design, Landscape Architecture, Interior Design, Architecture or a related discipline**
* Strong understanding of spatial and planting design
* Proficiency in
 **AutoCAD, SketchUp or similar design software**
* Ability to create and interpret technical drawings and layouts
* Basic understanding of plant selection and growing conditions
* Strong visualisation and presentation skills
* Experience in landscape design, interior landscaping, plantscaping or interior design is preferred



**Exceptional freshers are welcome to apply** 
 if they have a strong portfolio, excellent spatial sense and a genuine interest in plants and design.
 



 The Kind of Person We're Looking For
 



 At Pravaa, we're building a
 **design studio** 
 , not a conventional landscaping company.
 



 So we're looking for people who are:
 



**Curious. Observant. Design\-conscious. Particular.** 




 People who care about why something works — not just whether it works.
 



 If you believe greenery can be
 **designed** 
 , not simply placed, we'd like to meet you.
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time · On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers \+ Experienced candidates
 



**Industry:** 
 Plantscaping · Biophilic Design · Landscape Design
 



**Send your CV \+ portfolio / relevant work to:** 




**evolve@pravaa.in** 




**Pravaa** 




*Designed by nature, defined by intention.*

title: Level Designer
description:
We’re a passionate team of builders who are dedicated to delivering real solutions that empower real people. Today, we’re leveraging AI and gamification to build a platform centered around improving the safety readiness of frontline workers in any high risk industry.

**Mission**


Own the **playable quality** of the modules you build. What you ship should be clear, engaging and coachable for frontline workers, grounded in real work and correct procedure. You design and you implement, brief to shipped.

**Outcomes you're accountable for*** Playable experience quality primary
* + Learners understand goals, consequences and feedback **without confusion**, and can connect "what happened" to "what to do on the job".
	+ The module is readable, well paced and tuned.
	+ Scoring reflects real performance against the objectives and tells a learner what to improve.
* Procedural fidelity
* + Safety\-critical detail is correct, checked with subject matter experts early. Where reality is adapted to work as an experience, that is deliberate and written down.
* It ships, in every language and customer version
* + Your modules hit their date, and the localised builds are as good as the source.
	+ Nothing generative reaches a client unchecked. Artefacts, wrong characters, broken continuity and mistranslations are caught by you, before QA.
* The pipeline is faster because you used it
* + You work agentically by default, and what you learn goes back into the authoring pipeline instead of staying in your head.

**Responsibilities**Design the moment to moment* Define how the module plays: learner flow, the decision points, the feedback at each one, failure and recovery.
* Turn objectives into **what the learner must demonstrate**, not what they are told. A scene that only informs is not doing its job.
* Design the decision, not just build it: what the learner chooses between, what makes the wrong choice genuinely tempting, and what the consequence teaches.
* Keep UX, pacing and narrative flow aligned rather than competing.


Build it, end to end and agentically* Build in our authoring pipeline using **Claude Code**: spec, images, voice and video, scenes, captions, questions, preview, release.
* Direct the models. Measure before you ask for a change, keep edits surgical, verify the result, and know when to stop looping and do it by hand.
* Build and iterate in Unreal Engine 5 where the module calls for it: greybox, sequences, the state machine that drives the experience, render and export.


Validate and iterate* Playtest your own work against the spec and the objectives before anyone else sees it.
* Turn client feedback into fixes, and judge defect versus change request.
* Estimate and track your own work, flag slippage early, and ask in open channels.

 **Requirements**  

  

**What we're looking for*** **AI native, in production.** You build with agentic coding tools, Claude Code or equivalent, on real deliverables with real deadlines. Required, not a bonus. Expect to walk us through something you shipped this way, including where the model failed you and what you did about it.
* **Design craft, not just implementation craft.** You can say why a scene is not landing, and show us a decision point you designed and what each choice was there to teach.
* Around 3 to 5 years in game or level design, and strong Unreal Engine 5 skills, specifically tuning and iterating interactive experiences.
* Fundamentals: pacing, readability, feedback loops, consequence and failure handling.
* Practical fluency with generative image, video and voice tooling, and the judgement to tell good output from output that only looks finished.
* Comfortable in a repo: branches, pull requests, review.
* Organised, communicative, delivers without being chased. Enough grasp of art, animation, programming and sound to brief them and integrate their work.

**Nice to have*** You have improved a tool or pipeline you depend on.
* Localisation at volume, VR or web builds, or safety and industrial training content.

  

**Benefits** **How do we support and benefit our employees:**

* Competitive salary and stock options — everyone shares in what we're building
* 25 days holiday \+ public holidays
* Fully equipped setup from day one (no waiting for laptops)
* Regular company offsites and team socials
* A flat, transparent culture with direct access to leadership


At Pixaera, we're committed to building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diverse perspectives fuel creativity and innovation, which is why we celebrate individuality and foster an environment of inclusion and belonging.


We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer — discrimination of any kind has no place here. No matter your background, identity, or lived experience, you're welcome at Pixaera.

title: UI/UX Engineer
description:
INSIGHT GLOBAL \- INTERNAL OPPORTUNITY: Join the team at IG HQ in Hyderabad!
 



  





 IG LABS · AN INSIGHT GLOBAL COMPANY
 



 UI/UX Engineer
 



**Designing and Building the Interfaces That Make Agents Usable**




 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking
 **for a UI/UX Engineer**
 to design and build the interfaces that make IG Labs' agentic systems usable and trusted. An agent only delivers value if people act on it, and that comes down to the surfaces where humans meet the system: the review and approval screens, the agent consoles, the dashboards that make autonomy legible. You both design and build those surfaces in production. This is core delivery engineering, not a finishing touch applied at the end.
 



 You take on the hardest product problems in our client work: the human\-in\-the\-loop workflow that has to earn an operator's trust, the dense decision interface that has to feel simple, the dashboard that turns an agent's work into something a stakeholder believes. You own the experience from first sketch to shipped interface, and you are accountable for whether people actually adopt it.
 



 Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The component libraries, design system, and interaction patterns you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the Data and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Designing \& Building the Interface
 



 • Design and build the surfaces where humans meet agents: review and approval UIs, agent consoles, and decision dashboards.
 



 • Own both sides of the craft: the UX (flows, interaction, and the trust an operator needs to act on an agent's output) and the front\-end implementation in production code.
 



 • Prototype fast, put it in front of real users, and refine. Treat adoption as a design outcome you are accountable for, not a hope.
 



 • Make complex, data\-dense workflows feel simple, and make autonomy legible enough that people trust it.
 



 • Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard.
 



 Front\-End Engineering
 



 • Build production front\-ends with modern tooling (React, TypeScript) that are responsive, accessible, and performant.
 



 • Integrate cleanly with agent, data, and API backends, handling real\-world states: latency, streaming, partial results, and failure.
 



 • Instrument interfaces for adoption signals, so the team can see what users actually do and iterate on evidence.
 



 • Hold a high bar for craft: the polish that makes the difference between a tool people tolerate and one they trust.
 



 Delivering in Client Engagements
 



 • Own your work end to end within live client engagements, from first sketch to a shipped, adopted interface.
 



 • Bring the deep design and front\-end expertise a client engagement depends on, as a peer to the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and other engineers in the POD.
 



 • Maintain the documentation and handoff discipline that distributed, multi\-client delivery requires, so your work is easy to pick up, extend, and reuse.
 



 • Be available for the hard, real\-time problems that need a working session, not a write\-up.
 



 Building Reusable Capability
 



 • Turn everything you build into reusable capability: component libraries, a design system, and interaction patterns for human\-in\-the\-loop and agent interfaces that make the next engagement faster.
 



 • Partner with the Technical Architect to abstract, validate, and document what you build for the IP library.
 



 • Actively drive Reuse Index. The interface foundations you create are how the next project starts ahead of where the last one finished.
 



 • Treat capability\-building as core, not overhead. Every interface you ship should leave the Factory stronger.
 



  





  





 What This Role Is Not:
 



 • Not a designer who hands off mockups. You design and you build, in production code.
 



 • Not a front\-end developer waiting for specs. You own the experience end to end, from the first sketch to the shipped interface.
 



 • Not an internal tools team. You build the systems clients pay for, not internal tooling for its own sake.
 



 • Not a Forward Deployed Engineer. The FDE leads the engagement on the ground at the client; you design and build the interfaces the engagement delivers to its users. Different seats, both core.
 



 • Not the Technical Architect. The TA sets architecture and standards across engagements; you build the systems within them and shape the patterns that become standards.
 



 Qualifications
 



  





 Required
 



 Strongly Preferred
 



 8\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, with genuine depth in both product and UX design and front\-end engineering. A true hybrid, not one side with a hobbyist grasp of the other. Strong with modern front\-end (React, TypeScript), design tooling (Figma), and design systems. Experience designing for complex, data\-dense, or workflow\-heavy applications. Cares deeply about adoption and trust, and can prove impact with real usage. A clear written communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team.
 



 Experience designing and building interfaces for AI or agentic products: human\-in\-the\-loop review, agent consoles, and decision support. Strength in accessibility and data visualization. Experience in a consulting, professional services, or client\-delivery environment. Familiarity with the access and compliance constraints of regulated clients in financial services or healthcare.

title: UX Designer (2 to 4 years)
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

**Position Summary:** Design is evolving as AI blurs the boundaries between research, UX design, product thinking, prototyping and development. In this role, you will help shape human\-centered design in an AI\-native product environment, using AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development (SDD) practices while ensuring evidence, creativity and human judgment remain central.


You will solve complex healthcare problems involving interconnected systems, large amounts of information and decisions where clarity and accuracy matter. The primary focus is document interoperability—helping healthcare professionals find, review, understand and act on clinical information—as well as referrals and other cross\-organization experiences.


Research is central to the role. You will work with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients and clinical/domain experts, combining research insights with product and behavioral data to make evidence\-based design decisions.

**About the Team:** You will be part of a collaborative team working closely with **Design, Product, Engineering, clients and clinical/domain experts** to create clear, accurate and usable healthcare experiences.


The team is exploring how **AI** can support research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation. You will contribute to evolving **SDD practices** and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for **accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value**.


Together, the team works on complex, data\-rich healthcare workflows where users need to understand information, make decisions and take action across interconnected systems.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Use AI across **research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation** as part of an AI\-native design approach.
* Contribute to evolving **specification\-driven development (SDD)** practices and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value.
* Help plan and conduct **user research** with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients, clinical experts and domain experts.
* Ask thoughtful questions, build rapport, listen closely and identify meaningful patterns from qualitative research and customer feedback.
* Combine qualitative insights with **product and behavioral data** to understand both what users do and why they do it.
* Translate research and evidence into clear **problem definitions, workflows, experience principles and product concepts** that help the team determine what to build and why.
* Design understandable enterprise experiences, including **user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and detailed interface designs**.
* Design for **document interoperability, referrals and cross\-organization healthcare workflows**, accounting for different users, dense information, edge cases and system constraints.
* Collaborate with **Product, Engineering, Design, clients and domain experts** to evaluate trade\-offs and build shared understanding.
* Drive clearly scoped work forward, communicate progress and risks, seek feedback and take on increasing complexity as your capabilities grow.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Develop a strong understanding of **complex healthcare systems and workflows**, even without prior U.S. healthcare expertise.
* Apply human\-centered judgment to determine where **AI should and should not influence an experience**.
* Experiment with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration and other creative practices, adapting approaches based on learnings.
* Reason about **complex systems, data, relationships, constraints and downstream consequences**.
* Use evidence to separate **assumptions from validated insights** and respond constructively when new information challenges your initial thinking.
* Communicate clearly with users and colleagues across different **disciplines, cultures and levels of technical knowledge**.
* Show initiative, follow through on commitments, seek feedback and maintain a high standard for the quality and consequences of design decisions.
* Work directly with **U.S.\-based healthcare professionals and clinical experts** as part of research activities.
* Maintain planned evening availability in India when required for scheduled research sessions with U.S.\-based users.
* Continue developing UX capabilities and take on increasing levels of responsibility and complexity as your capabilities grow.

**Expected Education \& Experience**

* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in UX design, product design, UX research, service design, data, engineering, healthcare, psychology, customer experience or another related discipline.
* Experience researching or designing **complex, data\-rich products and workflows** involving multiple users, constraints and dependencies.
* Experience in healthcare, health technology, fintech, insurance, enterprise software, logistics, security, data products or another **systemic or regulated environment** is valuable.
* Ability to use **qualitative research, customer feedback and/or behavioral product data** to inform product, service or design decisions.
* Curiosity about analytics tools such as **Amplitude** is valuable, even if you are not currently a quantitative researcher.
* Ability to communicate ideas through **workflows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and/or detailed interface designs**.
* Demonstrated experimentation with **AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration or another creative practice**, with an ability to adapt based on what you learn.
* Healthcare or health technology experience is a plus, particularly familiarity with **clinical workflows, document exchange, interoperability, referrals or care coordination**.
* A **bachelor’s or master’s degree** in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Business or a related discipline is welcomed; equivalent skills developed through practical experience are also valued.
* We care more about the **quality of your thinking, research instincts, curiosity and ability to grow** than a specific job title or list of tools.

***About athenahealth***

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

Adral is an intelligence company building systems that finish the work, not just converse about it. We develop foundational models (including our MoE\-Mamba general reasoning architecture and security\-focused models) and deploy them across web, desktop, and mobile surfaces with deep agentic capabilities. description:

Designed to provide real\-time AI\-powered insights, icogz empowers organizations to make data\-driven decisions and enable intelligent automation across all departments.
