With a unified view of enterprise data and over 200 proprietary algorithms, icogz is pioneering the future of business intelligence and decision\-making.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative and curious **Intern \- Web Designer** to join our team on a 3\-month internship, with the possibility of full\-time conversion based on performance and business requirements.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about UI/UX design and eager to learn how thoughtful design comes together with modern, AI\-assisted development. You'll get hands\-on exposure to the full design process — from wireframing and user flows through to mockups and landing pages — while also learning how tools like Cursor and Lovable are changing how designs get built. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a strong, practical foundation in both design and vibe coding.

**Key Responsibilities**

UI/UX \& Visual Design

* Support the creation of wireframing, user flows, mockups, and high\-fidelity visual design for websites, landing pages, and web assets.
* Apply core principles of typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy to produce clean, engaging designs.
* Help design and maintain responsive design layouts that work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
* Contribute to and follow existing design systems and component libraries to keep designs consistent with brand guidelines.
* Assist with structuring page layouts and site flow using sound information architecture.

Research \& Usability

* Support basic user research and usability testing activities to help the team understand user needs and pain points.
* Help identify usability issues and suggest design improvements based on findings.
* Learn to apply interaction design principles to make experiences more intuitive.

AI\-Assisted Development \& Rapid Prototyping

* Get hands\-on exposure to AI\-assisted development and vibe coding using tools like Cursor and Lovable to quickly bring design concepts to life.
* Practice prompt engineering to generate and iterate on layouts, components, and prototypes efficiently.
* Use no\-code/low\-code tools and rapid prototyping approaches to support rapid iteration on design ideas.
* Learn basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to better understand how designs translate into working web pages.

Handoff, QA \& Collaboration

* Support design\-to\-code handoff by preparing clear specs, assets, and documentation for developers.
* Assist with cross\-browser testing to confirm designs display correctly and consistently.
* Help apply accessibility (WCAG) guidelines to make designs more inclusive.
* Collaborate closely with designers, developers, and marketing team members, and take part in design reviews and feedback sessions.
* Use tools such as Canva for quick visual assets and supporting marketing/design needs.

Continuous Learning

* Stay curious about emerging design trends, UX methodologies, accessibility standards, and AI\-assisted design and development tools.
* Contribute ideas to improve design processes and workflow efficiency.

**Required Skills**

* Strong interest in UI/UX design, web design, or a related field, with some coursework, personal projects, or freelance work to show for it.
* Basic understanding of responsive design and mobile\-first thinking.
* Foundational skills in typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.
* Familiarity with at least one design tool such as Figma, Adobe XD, Canva, or similar.
* Willingness to learn HTML, CSS, and modern AI\-assisted development tools like Cursor or Lovable.
* Good communication skills and openness to feedback.
* Ability to manage time across multiple small tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and genuine care about producing polished work.

**Preferred Skills**

* Some exposure to HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Familiarity with vibe coding, prompt engineering, or no\-code/low\-code tools.
* Basic understanding of user research, usability testing, or user flows.
* Awareness of accessibility (WCAG) standards and inclusive design practices.
* Interest in design systems or component libraries.
* Any personal or academic projects involving landing pages, mockups, or prototypes.

**Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree, diploma, or certification in Graphic Design, Web Design, UI/UX Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia Design, or a related field.
* Equivalent self\-taught experience, professional certifications, or bootcamp training will also be considered.
* Candidates should share a portfolio or samples of relevant design work, even if from coursework or personal projects.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on exposure to modern UI/UX design and AI\-assisted development workflows.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced designers and developers.

Answergen Reporting Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is focused on delivering modern, data\-driven reporting and business intelligence solutions that help organizations transform complex data into meaningful insights and actionable business outcomes.

We combine technology, analytics, and innovative digital solutions to build scalable and high\-performing platforms for modern businesses.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient Website Designer to take ownership of our website design, development, optimization, and maintenance initiatives.

The ideal candidate will combine strong UI/UX design and web development expertise with hands\-on experience in WordPress, CMS platforms, static website development, SEO, AEO, and GEO. You will be responsible for creating responsive, engaging, accessible, and performance\-driven digital experiences aligned with business and brand objectives.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and develop modern, responsive, and user\-centric websites across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.

* Optimize websites for page speed, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, mobile responsiveness, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Configure and manage WordPress themes, plugins, integrations, updates, backups, and basic website security.
* Troubleshoot and resolve website issues related to layouts, broken links, plugin conflicts, responsiveness, functionality, and performance.
* Conduct website reviews and audits to identify opportunities to improve usability, functionality, performance, and search visibility.
* Work closely with marketing, content, development, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver website initiatives within timelines.
* Maintain consistency across visual design, branding, content presentation, navigation, and overall user experience.
* Stay updated with developments in web technologies, UI/UX, SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI\-driven search, incorporating relevant practices into website initiatives.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Web Design \& Development**

* Strong hands\-on experience with WordPress and CMS platforms.
* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery.
* Strong understanding of responsive and mobile\-first web design.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining static and dynamic websites.
* Working knowledge of hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, website migration, deployment, and basic server concepts.
* Familiarity with Git/version control is an advantage.

**UI/UX Design**

* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture, user flows, visual hierarchy, typography, and design systems.
* Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or equivalent UI/UX tools.

* Ability to translate user and business requirements into intuitive and engaging interfaces.
* Understanding of accessibility and user\-centered design practices.

**SEO, AEO \& GEO**

* Practical understanding of On\-Page SEO and Technical SEO.
* Knowledge of AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and content structuring for answer\-based and conversational search.
* Understanding of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and website optimization for AI\-powered and generative search platforms.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Moz.
* Knowledge of schema markup, indexing, crawlability, canonicalization, redirects, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.

**ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Experience with Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Divi, or similar WordPress page builders.
* Basic knowledge of PHP, WordPress theme/plugin customization, and WooCommerce.
* Understanding of website security, caching, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals.
* Knowledge of CRO and landing\-page optimization is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar design tools.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Minimum **3 years of relevant experience** in Website Design, Web Development, UI/UX, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Web Design, UI/UX, Computer Science, IT, Digital Marketing, or a related discipline.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in WordPress, CMS, UI/UX, responsive, static, and dynamic website projects.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, creative\-thinking, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

A creative, technically strong, and business\-oriented Website Designer who can take ownership of the complete website lifecycle from UI/UX design and development to optimization, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail\-oriented, performance\-focused, and adaptable to evolving web technologies, SEO practices, and AEO, GEO, and AI\-driven search.

Collaborate closely with PM and engineering, and be comfortable enough with code concepts to understand technical feasibility and implementation constraints.

Your leadership will transform enterprise workflows into intelligent, adaptive experiences that scale globally.

 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy\-to\-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. Our mission is to bridge the gap between complex technology and everyday human needs, ensuring Geo’s products are highly relevant, useful, and empowering for users in rapidly growing economies. Within this space, Transit Growth in Emerging Markets represents a massive opportunity to redefine how millions of people navigate rapidly urbanizing cities. Transit in these regions is fundamentally different often complex, multimodal, and heavily reliant on informal networks.
   

  

 In this role, you will independently drive the strategy and execution for how transit commuters plan, navigate, and experience their irequent and infrequent trips. You will be solving unique local modalities, data gaps and the micro\-needs that drive daily habits in growing transit engagement. You will work with Transit growth in Google Maps for users in Emerging Markets and across the globe.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross\-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, and provide creative, thoughtful solutions.
* Communicate the user experience at various stages of the design process with wireframes, flow diagrams, storyboards, mockups, or high fidelity prototypes.
* Integrate user feedback and business requirements into ongoing product experience updates.
* Advocate for the prioritization of design centered changes, refinements, and improvements.
* Lead and take ownership of key parts of the product's user experience for Transit Growth in Emerging Markets.

 The team is exploring how
 **AI**

 **SDD practices** 
 and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for
 **accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value** 
 .
   

  

 Together, the team works on complex, data\-rich healthcare workflows where users need to understand information, make decisions and take action across interconnected systems.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Use AI across research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation as part of an AI\-native design approach.
* Contribute to evolving specification\-driven development (SDD) practices and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value.
* Help plan and conduct user research with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients, clinical experts and domain experts.
* Ask thoughtful questions, build rapport, listen closely and identify meaningful patterns from qualitative research and customer feedback.

* Design understandable enterprise experiences, including user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and detailed interface designs.
* Design for document interoperability, referrals and cross\-organization healthcare workflows, accounting for different users, dense information, edge cases and system constraints.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, clients and domain experts to evaluate trade\-offs and build shared understanding.
* Drive clearly scoped work forward, communicate progress and risks, seek feedback and take on increasing complexity as your capabilities grow.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Develop a strong understanding of complex healthcare systems and workflows, even without prior U.S. healthcare expertise.
* Apply human\-centered judgment to determine where AI should and should not influence an experience.
* Experiment with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration and other creative practices, adapting approaches based on learnings.
* Reason about complex systems, data, relationships, constraints and downstream consequences.
* Use evidence to separate assumptions from validated insights and respond constructively when new information challenges your initial thinking.
* Communicate clearly with users and colleagues across different disciplines, cultures and levels of technical knowledge.
* Show initiative, follow through on commitments, seek feedback and maintain a high standard for the quality and consequences of design decisions.
* Work directly with U.S.\-based healthcare professionals and clinical experts as part of research activities.
* Maintain planned evening availability in India when required for scheduled research sessions with U.S.\-based users.

**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in UX design, product design, UX research, service design, data, engineering, healthcare, psychology, customer experience or another related discipline.
* Experience researching or designing complex, data\-rich products and workflows involving multiple users, constraints and dependencies.
* Experience in healthcare, health technology, fintech, insurance, enterprise software, logistics, security, data products or another systemic or regulated environment is valuable.
* Ability to use qualitative research, customer feedback and/or behavioral product data to inform product, service or design decisions.

* Ability to communicate ideas through workflows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and/or detailed interface designs.
* Demonstrated experimentation with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration or another creative practice, with an ability to adapt based on what you learn.
* Healthcare or health technology experience is a plus, particularly familiarity with clinical workflows, document exchange, interoperability, referrals or care coordination.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Business or a related discipline is welcomed; equivalent skills developed through practical experience are also valued.

 About us
 
 Epicure Robotics builds autonomous food and beverage kiosks that make healthy products conveniently available across workplaces, campuses, gyms and hospitals. Our flagship product, The Smoothie Bar, brings together food, robotics, software and physical product design into one customer experience.
 



 As our machines go into more locations, we need an in\-house designer to own how everything looks and feels, from the screen a customer taps to the cup they walk away with.

**3\. Design posters, standees and banners** 
 Location\-specific artwork for corporate offices, campuses, gyms and events. Print\-ready files that match real dimensions, materials and vendor requirements.

 Cups, lids, sleeves, labels, boxes, machine decals and panels, plus merch. Keep it all looking like one brand, from the machine to the cup.

 Founders and leadership, the software and UI team, mechanical and product engineering, the food and kitchen team, ops and deployment, sales and marketing, and our printing, packaging and fabrication vendors.

 You won't be making social media posts all day. You'll shape how customers discover, understand and interact with a new category of food product, and build the design language Epicure carries across machines, locations and cities.

description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 Strategic Focus: 20% Strategic, 40% Managerial, 40% Tactical.
   

  

 The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product\-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross\-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies, including cloud platforms, data, and AI, the organization supports the development of scalable, user\-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.
   

  

 As an Associate Director, Product Design, you will lead a team of Product Designers while owning end\-to\-end customer experiences, product journeys, or strategic initiatives. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Strategy, and Business leaders to translate product strategy into a compelling experience vision and drive delivery of high\-quality, user\-centered solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach leadership role that combines people leadership, design strategy, and hands\-on execution. You will guide and develop designers, influence product direction, foster a culture of design excellence, and remain actively involved in solving complex experience challenges.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design Leadership \& Delivery
+ Own the design strategy, experience vision, and execution for a broad set of features, customer journeys, products, or strategic initiatives
+ Translate business objectives, customer needs, and product strategy into clear design opportunities, experience principles, and actionable design solutions
+ Lead teams in transforming complex and ambiguous problems into simple, elegant, and innovative experiences across web, mobile, conversational, and AI\-enabled channels
+ Guide designers in creating user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity experiences that bring product vision to life
+ Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Strategy, Analytics, Accessibility, and Legal teams to ensure experiences are desirable, feasible, viable, and compliant
+ Provide design direction informed by user research, analytics, accessibility standards, health literacy considerations, legal requirements, technical constraints, and best practices
+ Drive quality and consistency across multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing customer needs, business priorities, and delivery timelines
+ Collaborate with Design System teams to contribute reusable components, patterns, and standards that improve scalability and efficiency across products
+ Champion accessibility, inclusive design, and health equity considerations throughout the product design process
+ Support teams in identifying opportunities that improve healthcare access, health outcomes, member engagement, and clinical quality measures such as HEDIS and STARS
+ Leverage AI\-enabled tools and emerging design methodologies to accelerate workflows, improve team effectiveness, and enhance product experiences

* Design Strategy \& Thought Leadership
+ Help define and evolve experience strategy across key customer journeys, products, and business initiatives
+ Lead teams in identifying emerging opportunities in healthcare, digital experiences, and AI\-powered products, evaluating their applicability and business value
+ Drive design thought leadership by advocating for customer\-centered design practices, innovation, and continuous improvement
+ Navigate ambiguity and help teams achieve clarity, alignment, and momentum in complex problem spaces
+ Constructively challenge assumptions and existing approaches to uncover new opportunities and improve customer experiences
+ Frame problem spaces, establish priorities, define success measures, and structure work to deliver meaningful outcomes
+ Influence stakeholders through solid storytelling, facilitation, strategic thinking, and evidence\-based design recommendations
+ Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning across the design organization

* Team Leadership \& Management
+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Designers, creating opportunities for career growth, skill development, and increased impact
+ Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performing team culture grounded in trust, accountability, creativity, and innovation
+ Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports
+ Lead design critiques, coaching sessions, workshops, and working sessions that elevate the quality of design across teams
+ Review and approve work produced by team members, partners, and agencies to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with experience standards
+ Support resource planning and prioritize team efforts across strategic initiatives and product delivery needs
+ Build solid partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research, and Business organizations to drive alignment and successful outcomes
+ Promote employee engagement, retention, and professional development through effective coaching and people leadership
+ Serve as a trusted advisor and representative of the design organization across cross\-functional teams and leadership forums

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience designing digital products and experiences across web, mobile, and emerging digital platforms
* 2\+ years of experience leading, coaching, or managing product designers and design teams
* Proven experience owning and delivering complex end\-to\-end customer experiences, product journeys, or strategic initiatives
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Research, and Business leaders in Agile product development environments
* Demonstrated success translating product strategy and business goals into meaningful customer experiences and measurable outcomes
* Solid portfolio showcasing both strategic thinking and hands\-on product design execution across complex products and services
* Deep expertise in user experience design, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, service design, and human\-centered design methodologies
* Expert proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design workflows
* Solid communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to lead teams through ambiguity while balancing strategic priorities and executional excellence.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading design teams responsible for enterprise software, healthcare products, or large\-scale digital ecosystems
* Experience designing AI\-powered, conversational, generative, or agentic experiences
* Experience driving adoption of design systems and reusable experience patterns
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams, including U.S.\-based stakeholders
* Healthcare experience preferred but not required. Experience in similarly complex or regulated industries such as insurance, financial services, telecommunications, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or enterprise software is also valued
* Experience designing accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2\.1 AA requirements
* Demonstrated experience incorporating health equity, accessibility, and inclusive design principles into product development
* Experience using AI\-enabled tools to improve research, ideation, design exploration, prototyping, documentation, and workflow efficiency


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product@Lenskart -  HRTech & AI-Native Platform
description:
**Product Manager : HRTech \& AI\-Native Platform** 




  





**What you’ll do** 




**Discover the real problem** 



* Work directly with employees, store managers, recruiters, HR teams, business leaders and engineers.
* Absorb inputs from multiple stakeholders without treating every suggestion as a requirement.
* Separate symptoms, preferences and edge cases from the underlying problem.
* Use workflow observation, data and root\-cause analysis to understand where work actually breaks.
* Convert ambiguous business problems into clear product hypotheses and measurable outcomes.



**Build products that work in the real world** 



* Own the journey from discovery and product definition through launch, adoption and iteration.
* Write clear product requirements, user stories, process flows, data contracts and acceptance criteria.
* Design for different workforce contexts—frontline, manufacturing, corporate, Tech/Product and new markets.
* Make thoughtful build, buy, integrate, extend and retire recommendations.
* Protect the global product core while accounting for legitimate country, policy and operational differences.



**Work deeply with technology and data** 



* Collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, data, security and enterprise IT teams.
* Understand APIs, system integrations, identity, data models, events, permissions and failure scenarios.
* Use SQL, analytics tools or structured data exploration to answer product questions independently.
* Define instrumentation before launch and use evidence not anecdotes to assess outcomes.
* Challenge point\-to\-point fixes that create long\-term complexity or operational risk.
* Consider reliability, privacy, security and scalability part of the product—not post\-launch checklists.



**Make AI useful, trusted and measurable** 



* Identify problems where AI can materially improve speed, quality or cost not simply add an AI label.
* Help develop grounded assistants, intelligent workflows and automation.
* Define evaluation datasets, quality thresholds, escalation paths and human accountability.
* Measure successful task completion, outcome quality, time saved, cost per successful task and user trust.
* Stop or redesign AI use cases that do not meet quality, fairness, security or economic thresholds.



**Drive decisions and execution** 



* Prioritise ruthlessly across user pain, business value, risk, effort and strategic fit.
* Align senior stakeholders without relying on endless meetings or consensus.
* Surface trade\-offs early and communicate decisions clearly.
* Work through dependencies and operational constraints to get products shipped.
* Stay close to adoption after launch and take ownership of business outcomes—not merely feature delivery.



  





**You’ll thrive here if you** 



* Have 3–5 years of Core product management experience
* Are street\-smart and resourceful: you can make progress even when the process, ownership or data is imperfect.
* Are intellectually curious and willing to go several layers deeper than the initial request.
* Can process conflicting inputs without becoming paralysed or turning the roadmap into a stakeholder wish list.
* Have strong product judgment and know when to use research, data, first principles or a fast experiment.
* Are technically fluent enough to have meaningful conversations about APIs, data flows, integrations, identity and system reliability \& can get your hands dirty when required to build.
* Can communicate equally well with an engineer, an HR operations specialist, a store manager and a senior executive.
* Prefer solving a meaningful problem over shipping a fashionable feature.



**Technical comfort we’re looking for** 




 You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable with several of the following:
 


* REST APIs, webhooks and system integrations
* Relational data models and basic SQL
* Identity, roles and permissions
* Event\-driven workflows and automation
* Product analytics and experimentation
* AI/LLM concepts such as retrieval, evaluation, grounding and Evals
* Security, privacy and data\-residency considerations
* Enterprise platforms such as HRMS, ATS, payroll, CRM or workflow systems



**What you can expect from this role** 



* Real ownership, not backlog administration.
* Problems that sit at the intersection of people, technology and global scale.
* Space to experiment with AI, with clear expectations around evidence and responsibility.
* A high\-learning environment where curiosity, speed and depth are valued.



**A note before you apply** 




 You do not need to match every bullet. We care more about how you think, learn and operate than whether your previous job title was perfect.

We believe enterprises don't scale expertise—they lose it. Knowledge stays trapped in individuals, judgment gets applied inconsistently, and the best talent spends time on work that should run itself. We're changing that.

This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership in an AI\-first, early\-stage company, work on complex enterprise problems, and help define how users build, evaluate, understand, and deploy AI\-powered systems.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Experience \& Systems Design**
* Own end\-to\-end UX across major platform capability areas.

* Design platform primitives that are intuitive, reusable, composable, and scalable.
* Balance flexibility, correctness, usability, and system complexity when designing platform experiences.

About iDream Education****Vision:** Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.**Belief:** We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.**Mission:** To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to **Learn Unlimited**.
Company website: **http://idreameducation.org** \| iPrep website: **http://iprep.in** **2\. Role Summary**
We are looking for a Product Designer to join our Product team and help shape how millions of students and teachers experience iPrep. You will take product requirements from rough idea to polished, tested UI — designing for a genuinely diverse user base that spans smart classrooms in metro schools to low\-bandwidth devices in rural India. This is a role for someone who wants to grow across the full arc of product design: understanding the user, shaping the flow, and getting the pixels right — not just executing screens from a spec.  

  

**3\. Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables*** **Product Design Execution**
	+ Translate product requirements and rough concepts into polished, high\-fidelity UI designs for iPrep across web, app, and device platforms.
	+ Build and maintain consistent, reusable components within iPrep's design system.
	+ Prototype key flows and interactions to pressure\-test design decisions before handoff.
* **User Research \& Discovery**
	+ Support user research — plan and conduct interviews and usability tests with teachers, students, and field staff to ground design decisions in real user needs.
	+ Translate research insights into concrete design changes and document key findings for the wider team.
	+ Contribute to personas and journey maps that reflect iPrep's varied user contexts — from urban smart classrooms to low\-bandwidth, low\-literacy rural settings.
* **Collaboration \& Handoff**
	+ Work closely with the Principal, Product Design and cross\-functional partners in product, engineering, and content to keep design intent intact through build.
	+ Participate actively in design reviews and critiques, and incorporate feedback without losing sight of the user problem.
	+ Prepare clear, implementation\-ready specs and documentation for engineering handoff.
* **AI\-Augmented Design Workflow**
	+ Use AI\-powered design tools (Figma AI, and other emerging platforms) to speed up ideation, iteration, and production work.
	+ Proactively pilot new AI\-assisted workflows and share learnings back with the design team.

 **4\. Qualifications \& Experience*** **Experience:** 1–3 years in product design, UX design, or UI design, ideally within a digital product, SaaS, or EdTech environment.
* **Portfolio:** Case studies that show your end\-to\-end process — problem framing, research input, iteration, and final high\-fidelity output — not just polished final screens.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Strong working knowledge of Figma (components, auto layout, prototyping). Comfort with basic user research methods (interviews, usability testing).
* **Sector Context:** Exposure to designing for low\-bandwidth, bilingual, or varied\-literacy user contexts is a strong advantage.
* **AI Fluency:** You use AI tools as part of your daily design workflow, not as an occasional novelty.
* **Communication:** Able to clearly articulate design rationale to non\-designers and hold your own in a cross\-functional review.

 **5\. What Makes You a Great Fit?**
You care about designing for real users who don't look like the users in most portfolios — students and teachers working with patchy internet, shared devices, and multiple languages. You're equally comfortable digging into a research conversation and polishing a Figma file, and you're looking to grow under close mentorship rather than work in isolation. **6\. What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit*** Integrity: Makes thoughtful, user\-first decisions and takes ownership.
* Impact: Creates meaningful experiences that drive user and business value.
* Excellence: Sets high standards for design quality and user experience.
* Collaboration: Influences and works effectively across cross\-functional teams.

 **7\. Why Join Us**
We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you'll design for one of India's largest last\-mile EdTech platforms, working closely with a Principal Product Design and a small, tight product design team where your decisions visibly shape how millions of students learn.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Abow India is a design\-led growth company that helps brands in India and beyond scale intelligently and sustainably. The team partners with businesses that already have traction and want to strengthen their branding, positioning, and revenue systems. Abow goes beyond traditional branding, marketing, and websites by identifying growth bottlenecks, improving systems, and enhancing brand perception through tailored strategies. The company focuses on deeply understanding each business before designing solutions that genuinely support scaling. Currently, Abow collaborates with brands in the ₹12–20 Cr ARR range that are ready to move to the next level of growth.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Graphic Designer role at abowindia is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for branding, marketing campaigns, websites, and other digital and print materials, ensuring consistency with each client’s brand identity and growth goals. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing logos and brand systems, designing graphics for social media and advertising, refining typography and layouts, and collaborating with strategists and marketers to translate business objectives into clear visual concepts. The role also involves preparing production\-ready files, maintaining design standards, participating in creative brainstorming sessions, and iterating on designs based on feedback from internal teams and clients.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with the ability to produce high\-quality visual assets for digital and print.

* Proficiency in Typography and layout design, with a keen eye for readability, hierarchy, and visual balance.
* Advanced knowledge of industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma or similar) and modern design workflows.
* Ability to interpret business and marketing objectives into effective visual concepts and campaigns.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating relevant work in branding, identity design, and marketing collateral.
* Strong attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to handle multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with openness to constructive feedback and iterative design.

title: CBS-BMC- Creative Services - Assistant Director-Senior Art Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY Global Delivery Services (GDS), we work hand in hand with the business to build awareness of our services and solutions; to bring our purpose — building a better working world — to life for our people, clients and communities; to engage our people and build a high performing culture; and to build the commercial value and emotional resonance of the EY and the GDS brand.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high\-impact, high\-quality and on–brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
   

  

 As a Senior Art Director, you will have a unique blend of creative vision and strategic thinking, to lead our team and will act as a strong creative strategist and a design thought leader.
   

  

 You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on\-brand, user\-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem\-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best\-in\-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* You understand the power of creative ideas and have a track\-record of delivering memorable ideas that shape audience perception, engagement, and participation
* You help coach and train the wider team, transforming GDS Creative Services capability from providing excellent design and execution services, to leading with brand\-building and distinctive creative ideas and strategy
* Have experience leading teams in creative agencies or in\-house brand teams, championing high\-visibility campaigns for top global brands (preferably B2B)
* Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on\-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
* Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post\-production
* Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency
* Stay up\-to\-date with current and future designs, web standards, concepts and industry trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
* Provide creative and art direction support to the team, coordinate with team members and others to resolve issues, as necessary
* Proactively identify opportunities to employ pop culture trends, creativity, executional approaches and techniques to create exceptional user experiences
* Communicate effectively with various customers/customer groups while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
* Lead project discussions with customers with a customer\-centric mindset
* Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
* Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
* Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A user\-centric mindset with creative, innovative and analytical approach
* Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
* Exceptional project management, risk management and team management
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality output on time and within budget
* An innovative mindset that takes a client problem and delivers compelling and inspiring creative solutions
* Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Understanding of current and future visual trends


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor's degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline) \*
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign, Adobe DC and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word and Excel)
* Experience across a range of digital, social, and integrated media
* Knowledge of social platforms (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest etc.)
* Strong visual design and creative thinking capability
* At least 12 years of overall experience in a fast\-paced global environment
* Prior art direction experience in leading agencies


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Working knowledge of other key software and tools relevant to the industry


**What We Look For**
* Strong business acumen along with creative vision
* Creative problem\-solving mindset with a flexible can\-do attitude
* A growth mindset creative who loves to collaborate, ideate and deliver breakthrough work
* Experience in leading and managing creative teams, as well as developing junior creative talent
* Self\-starter who loves challenges and makes big things happen by working together
* Experience working with global clients
* Confidence, maturity and ability to build strong client relationships
* A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others


**What We Offer**
 EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Learning/Instructional Designer
description:
**Job Title: Learning/Instructional Designer** 




**Work Location: Somajiguda, Hyderabad(Onsite)** 




**Shift Timings: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST** 




  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are seeking a highly organized and creative
 **Learning/Instructional Designer** 
 to own the end\-to\-end learning lifecycle, including instructional design, content development, LMS administration, and training coordination. This role is responsible for designing engaging learning experiences, managing learning technologies, coordinating training delivery, tracking learner progress, and ensuring a seamless learning experience for employees across the organization. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating digital learning content, partnering with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), administering Learning Management Systems (LMS), coordinating instructor\-led and virtual training sessions, and analyzing learning effectiveness.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain engaging e\-learning, virtual instructor\-led, classroom, and blended learning programs using instructional design best practices.
* Create storyboards, scripts, assessments, multimedia content, simulations, videos, graphics, and interactive learning modules using Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to translate complex business and technical content into learner\-friendly, engaging training materials.
* Administer the Learning Management System (LMS), including course creation, content uploads, learner enrollments, learning paths, reporting, troubleshooting, and ongoing system maintenance.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate instructor\-led and virtual training sessions, including learner communications, meeting logistics, classroom setup, attendance tracking, and post\-training follow\-up.
* Monitor learner participation, completion rates, compliance requirements, certifications, and training effectiveness through dashboards and reports.
* Maintain learning documentation, course catalogs, historical training records, and digital learning assets.
* Perform quality assurance testing on learning content to ensure compatibility across multiple devices, browsers, and LMS platforms.
* Continuously evaluate and improve learning programs using learner feedback, performance metrics, and instructional design methodologies.
* Partner with HR, Talent Development, business stakeholders, and instructors to ensure learning programs align with organizational goals and business priorities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance learner engagement, operational efficiency, and overall learning experience.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* 3–10 years of experience in Instructional Design, Learning \& Development, Learning Operations, or Corporate Training.
* Hands\-on experience designing digital learning solutions using
 **Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, and Adobe Captivate** 
 .
* Experience administering Learning Management Systems such as
 **Workday, Cornerstone, Moodle, SuccessFactors** 
 , or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies including
 **ADDIE, SAM, Adult Learning Principles, and Kirkpatrick Evaluation Model** 
 .
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Excellent project coordination, stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

title: Executive - Graphics
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Local Designer to support payment card design adaptation, customer requirements, and production-related activities. The role will primarily involve adapting customer-provided artwork to payment card specifications and ensuring designs comply with applicable CQM (Card Quality Management) guidelines and technical requirements. 
 The position will also work closely with the Printing , Customer Service, and Customer teams to support artwork approvals, color matching , printing sheet approvals , and overall execution of customer projects. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Payment Card Design & Artwork Adaptation Adapt and modify customer-provided designs according to payment card specifications, technical requirements, and CQM guidelines. Ensure artwork is correctly prepared for production, including dimensions, layout, color specifications, image quality, and other technical requirements. Create new card designs and design concepts when required. Review artwork for potential production issues and provide suitable design solutions. Ensure customer designs are accurately translated into production-ready payment card artwork 
 2. Customer & Internal Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with customers and Customer Service teams to understand design requirements and provide appropriate artwork solutions. Communicate effectively with customers regarding artwork changes, technical limitations, design adaptations, and approval requirements. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth and timely completion of artwork-related activities. Support resolution of artwork-related queries and ensure timely closure of open points. 
 3. Printing & Production Support Work closely with the Printing Department on day-to-day artwork and production requirements. Support the review and approval of printing sheets against customer-approved color references and specifications. Assist in evaluating color accuracy and overall print appearance against approved customer references. Provide design and technical support to the Printing Department during production. Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of design- or color-related issues during the printing process. Ensure artwork meets the applicable branding and design requirements of the respective payment schemes. 
 4. Reporting & Documentation Prepare professional presentations for customer and internal reviews. Maintain daily work reports and provide regular updates on project status. Maintain proper records of artwork versions, approvals, revisions, and related documentation. Ensure effective tracking and communication of pending artwork activities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Proficient in A dobe Photoshop . Proficient in Adobe Illustrator . Good understanding of artwork preparation and graphic design principles. Knowledge of color management, print processes, and production artwork requirements is preferred. Good understanding of payment card design and production requirements is an advantage. Knowledge of scheme submission and approval processes for VISA, Mastercard, RuPay, and AMEX will be an added advantage. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience in graphic design, artwork adaptation, prepress, printing, or payment card manufacturing . Experience working with customer artwork and adapting designs for production requirements. Exposure to payment card design, CQM guidelines, and scheme approval processes will be highly beneficial.

title: Fashion Designer - Digital Fashion Stylist & Quality Checker
description:
About the Role : We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and technology-driven Fashion Designer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about fashion design, styling, digital fashion, and AI-powered creative technologies . 
 The selected candidate will work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies and established fashion brands , contributing to digital fashion styling, garment visualization, image quality checking, fashion content development, and AI-assisted creative workflows. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early-career fashion professionals who want to build a long-term career at the intersection of Fashion, Digital Technology, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) . 


 Key Responsibilities : 
 Digital Fashion Styling & Quality Control: 
 Work as a Digital Fashion Stylist and Digital Fashion Quality Checker (QC) for fashion-related projects. Review digital fashion outputs, product images, garment visuals, styling, proportions, colors, fit, details, and overall presentation. Identify design inconsistencies, visual errors, garment detailing issues, and deviations from the original reference/design. Ensure digital outputs meet required fashion, styling, visual quality, and brand guidelines . Analyse client requirements, references, sample images, and feedback and ensure accurate implementation. Coordinate with creative and production teams to communicate corrections and required changes. Maintain consistency across multiple products, designs, images, and project requirements. 

 Fashion Design & Styling: 
 Apply strong knowledge of Indian and Western Menswear and Womenswear to digital fashion projects. Understand fabrics, silhouettes, garment construction, fitting, styling, color combinations, prints, patterns, and garment detailing. Assist in concept development, mood boards, styling references, placement prints, and fashion presentations. Review and interpret fashion references, product images, sample garments, and design specifications. Support digital garment visualization and AI-assisted fashion content creation. 

 AI & Digital Fashion Workflows: 
 Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, MNML, Magnific, Grok , and similar platforms for creative ideation and fashion workflows. Use AI tools for concept generation, image enhancement, visual development, prompt creation, trend research, and creative problem-solving . Develop and refine prompts to achieve accurate fashion-related visual outputs. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, digital fashion tools, fashion trends, and creative workflows . Explore new AI-assisted methods to improve efficiency, quality, and accuracy in fashion projects. 

 Client & Project Coordination: 
 Understand project requirements and implement client feedback accurately. Manage project, design revisions, and quality-checking requirements simultaneously. Maintain proper communication with internal teams and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Follow project timelines, brand guidelines, and quality standards. Maintain confidentiality of client information, designs, references, and project-related materials. 


 Required Skills & Qualifications : 
 Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Technology, Textile Design, or a related field. 
 Fresher or 1-2 years of experience in Fashion Design, Fashion Styling, Digital Fashion, Quality Checking, or related roles. 
 Strong understanding of Indian & Western Menswear and Womenswear . 
 Good knowledge of:
 Fabrics and textiles Silhouettes Garment construction Garment fitting Fashion styling Colors and combinations Prints and patterns Garment detailing 
 Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is required. 
 Understanding of placement prints, mood boards, concept development, and tech packs . 
 Basic awareness or hands-on exposure to AI tools and AI-assisted creative workflows . 
 Strong attention to detail and visual judgement. 
 Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 Ability to understand and implement feedback accurately. 


 Preferred Skills & Additional Requirements : 
 Exposure to AI-assisted creative tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI or similar platforms. 
 Strong proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint . 
 Good proficiency in English, Hindi, and Bengali . 
 Professional, confident, self-motivated, and responsible approach to work. 
 Sharp memory and strong organizational skills to manage multiple sample revisions, client feedback, design changes, and project requirements. 
 Punctual and deadline-oriented with the ability to work within production timelines. 
 High professional integrity and respect for: Company policies Intellectual property Confidential client information Brand guidelines 
 Passion for fashion, creativity, technology, innovation, and continuous learning . 


 Good to Have : 
 Understanding of digital fashion and virtual garment visualization . Knowledge of AI-powered image generation and image enhancement. Interest in emerging Fashion Tech, Generative AI, and digital design technologies . Understanding of AI-assisted fashion styling and content creation. Experience with additional creative software or digital fashion tools. Knowledge of CLO 3D or 3D garment visualization. 


 Preferred Educational Institutes : 
 Candidates from reputed fashion, design, and creative institutes will be preferred, including: 
 NIFT (National Institute of Fashion Technology) J.D. Birla Institute iLEAD Bhawanipur Design Academy Amity University FDDI Kolkata ESEDS IIFD 
 Candidates from other recognized Fashion Design, Apparel, Textile, or Design institutes are also welcome to apply. 


 What You Will Get : 
 Opportunity to work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies such as Myntra and Amazon . Exposure to projects associated with leading fashion and lifestyle brands including Raymond, Park Avenue, Dressberry, Roadster, Reebok, HRX, Turtle, Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, and Allen Solly Kids . Hands-on exposure to AI-powered fashion design and creative technologies . Practical experience in digital fashion styling and fashion quality control . Exposure to real-world client projects, campaigns, product development, and production workflows. Collaborative and creative work environment. Opportunity to work at the intersection of Fashion + AI + Digital Technology . Strong learning and career-growth opportunities in emerging AI-enabled fashion workflows . 


 Location Preference : 
 Kolkata / West Bengal

title: Creative Designer | UI/UX & Visual Design
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly creative and versatile Designer who can work across UI/UX, product visuals, social media creatives, branding, and marketing designs . 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who can take a simple feature list, requirement, or idea from our team and turn it into a beautiful, intuitive, modern, and highly engaging visual experience . 
 We are looking for a designer with strong creative thinking not someone who simply executes predefined designs. 
 1. What You'll Do 
 Understand product features and requirements and convert them into intuitive UI/UX designs . Think from the user's perspective and create simple, engaging, and visually appealing experiences. Design app screens, user flows, feature experiences, dashboards, and other product interfaces. Create high-quality social media posts, campaigns, advertisements, banners, promotional creatives, and marketing materials . Create visually consistent designs across product, marketing, and brand communication. Develop creative concepts and multiple design directions when required. Suggest improvements to the product experience and visual presentation. Work closely with developers, marketing, and product teams. Ensure designs are practical, polished, consistent, and ready for implementation. Stay updated with modern UI/UX, graphic design, branding, and social media design trends. 
 2. What We're Looking For 
 2-4 years of experience in UI/UX + Graphic/Visual Design . Strong knowledge of Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator , or equivalent tools. Excellent understanding of: UI/UX principles Typography Color theory Layout & composition Visual hierarchy Spacing & grids Branding Design systems Social media creative design Strong creative and visual problem-solving skills. Ability to transform a rough idea or feature requirement into a polished design . Ability to independently suggest better design solutions instead of only following instructions. Strong attention to detail. Excellent portfolio demonstrating both product/UI work and graphic/creative work . 
 3. Example of the Work 
 We may give you a requirement like: "We need a new feature where users can compare two players." You should be able to: Understand the requirement Think about the user journey Create the UX Design the UI Make it visually engaging Deliver a polished final design Similarly, for marketing we may say: "Create a social media campaign for this new feature." You should be able to independently develop the creative concept, visual direction, layout, typography, graphics, and final post designs . 
 4. Important 
 This role requires a combination of UI/UX thinking and strong graphic/visual design skills . 
 We are NOT looking for: Web Designers focused primarily on websites Web Developers / Frontend Developers Designers who only create basic social media posts Designers who only execute predefined layouts Candidates with UI/UX knowledge but weak visual/graphic design skills 
 5. Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver and visual thinker who can move comfortably between: 
 Product UI/UX App Screens Feature Design Branding Social Media Marketing Creatives 
 You should have the ability to take a blank canvas + a feature/idea and turn it into something that looks and feels premium, intuitive, modern, and engaging . 
 6. Portfolio Required 
 Portfolio is mandatory. 
 Your portfolio should ideally demonstrate: UI/UX & product design Mobile app designs Creative social media posts Marketing creatives Branding/visual design Ability to create original concepts 
 Candidates with a strong and diverse portfolio will be preferred.

Key Skills: Ui/Ux,Figma,Mobile UI,Photoshop,Wireframing,Xd,UX Design
